title: Rinku Rathwa - young sports talent at Gunata school (stop on 8 June) (slide 76)
text: [Slide 76] 'Rinku Rathwa - the Harmanpreet Kaur of tomorrow!' During the 53rd Shodhyatra, on 8 June, our halt was at Gunata school. That day we had completed a walk of about 21 kilometres and everyone was tired, but our young shodhyatri Akshar Vasani's energy did not drop - Akshar kept playing with the children with the same enthusiasm. Meanwhile a little girl surprised everyone with amazing sporting skill: her agility, grip on the ball and excellent shot-making style enchanted everyone. Her name was Rinku Rathwa. Seeing her sportsmanship and style, it felt as if we were watching the future Harmanpreet Kaur play.
text_original: [स्लाइड 76] रिंकू राठवा — आने वाले कल की हरमनप्रीत कौर! 53वीं शोधयात्रा के दौरान, 8 जून को हमारा ठहराव गुनाटा स्कूल में हुआ था। उस दिन हमने लगभग 21 किलोमीटर की पदयात्रा पूरी की थी, जिससे सभी थक चुके थे। लेकिन हमारे युवा शोधयात्री अक्षर वसानी की ऊर्जा में कोई कमी नहीं थी — वे उसी उत्साह से बच्चों के साथ खेलते रहे। इसी बीच एक नन्हीं बच्ची ने अपने अद्भुत खेल कौशल से सबको चौंका दिया। उसकी चुस्ती, गेंद पर पकड़ और शॉट मारने की शानदार शैली ने हर किसी को मंत्रमुग्ध कर दिया। उसका नाम था — रिंकू राठवा। उसकी खेल भावना और शैली को देखकर ऐसा लगा की हम उसे भविष्य की हरमनप्रीत कौर को खेलते हुए देख रहे हों।

Title: Rinku Rathwa - young sports talent at Gunata school (stop on 8 June) (slide 76)
Entities: Akshar Vasani; Rinku Rathwa; Gunata Primary School; Gunata
English: [Slide 76] 'Rinku Rathwa - the Harmanpreet Kaur of tomorrow!' During the 53rd Shodhyatra, on 8 June, our halt was at Gunata school. That day we had completed a walk of about 21 kilometres and everyone was tired, but our young shodhyatri Akshar Vasani's energy did not drop - Akshar kept playing with the children with the same enthusiasm. Meanwhile a little girl surprised everyone with amazing sporting skill: her agility, grip on the ball and excellent shot-making style enchanted everyone. Her name was Rinku Rathwa. Seeing her sportsmanship and style, it felt as if we were watching the future Harmanpreet Kaur play.
Hindi (original): [स्लाइड 76] रिंकू राठवा — आने वाले कल की हरमनप्रीत कौर! 53वीं शोधयात्रा के दौरान, 8 जून को हमारा ठहराव गुनाटा स्कूल में हुआ था। उस दिन हमने लगभग 21 किलोमीटर की पदयात्रा पूरी की थी, जिससे सभी थक चुके थे। लेकिन हमारे युवा शोधयात्री अक्षर वसानी की ऊर्जा में कोई कमी नहीं थी — वे उसी उत्साह से बच्चों के साथ खेलते रहे। इसी बीच एक नन्हीं बच्ची ने अपने अद्भुत खेल कौशल से सबको चौंका दिया। उसकी चुस्ती, गेंद पर पकड़ और शॉट मारने की शानदार शैली ने हर किसी को मंत्रमुग्ध कर दिया। उसका नाम था — रिंकू राठवा। उसकी खेल भावना और शैली को देखकर ऐसा लगा की हम उसे भविष्य की हरमनप्रीत कौर को खेलते हुए देख रहे हों।

title: Two children of Gunata build a moving toy car in 2.5 minutes (slide 77)
text: [Slide 77] 'A wonder made in 2.5 minutes - a lesson from two children of Gunata'. That day of the Shodhyatra will always be remembered. We were walking on the road to Gunata; sweat was pouring, but curiosity and hope grew with every step. At one place we saw two small children sitting in the dirt with some scattered materials - a cold-drink bottle and caps, broken slippers, wire and pieces of wood. We went close and asked, "What are you making?" The children smiled and, without answering, got on with their work. Just 2 minutes 30 seconds later they had a moving toy car in their hands that ran here and there when pushed. The IIT students walking with us were amazed. Rajkush said proudly, "They made this car in front of us in 2.5 minutes." An IIT student replied with a smile: "We take two days to make such a toy..." That moment was silent but said a lot: what these children made without any training, resources or technical facilities taught us that innovation is born not only from degrees but from curiosity and imagination.
text_original: [स्लाइड 77] 2.5 मिनट में बना कमाल गुनाटा के दो बच्चों से मिली सीख शोधयात्रा का वो दिन हमेशा याद रहेगा। हम गुनाटा के रास्ते पर पैदल चल रहे थे। पसीना बह रहा था, लेकिन जिज्ञासा और उम्मीद हर कदम के साथ बढ़ रही थी। तभी एक जगह दो छोटे बच्चे मिट्टी में कुछ बिखरे सामान के साथ बैठे दिखे कोल्ड ड्रिंक की बोटल और ढक्कन, टूटे चप्पल तार और लकड़ी के टुकड़े। हमने पास जाकर पूछा “क्या बना रहे हो? ”बच्चे मुस्कराए और बिना कोई जवाब दिए, अपने काम में लग गए। सिर्फ 2 मिनट 30 सेकंड बाद उनके हाथ में एक चलती-फिरती खिलौना गाड़ी थी — जिसे धक्का देते ही वो इधर-उधर दौड़ने लगी। हमारे साथ चल रहे IIT के छात्र यह सब देखकर चकित रह गए। राजकुश ने गर्व से कहा, “इन्होंने ये गाड़ी अभी हमारे सामने 2.5 मिनट में बना दी।”IIT के छात्र ने मुस्कराते हुए जवाब दिया: "हम ऐसा खिलौना बनाने में दो दिन लगाते हैं… "वो पल मौन था — लेकिन बहुत कुछ कह रहा था। बिना किसी प्रशिक्षण, संसाधन या तकनीकी सुविधा के इन बच्चों ने जो बना दिया, उसने हमें यह सिखा दिया कि नवाचार केवल डिग्री से नहीं, जिज्ञासा और कल्पना से जन्म लेता है।

title: Kamleshji Patel - 5000 trees on Hathipav hill, Jhabua (slides 79-80)
text: [Slide 79] Kamleshji Patel. Kamleshji Patel, the Vyapari Mahasangh (traders' federation) and other collaborators together planted 5000 trees on the Hathipav ghati (hill) in Jhabua and nurtured them, and today have also done very big work for birds. Work has also been done for the people who come there. Complete arrangements of water and food have been made for animals and birds. [Slide 80] Photographs (no text).

title: Rajendra Shrivastav - 20 years of helping mentally ill and destitute people; 500+ reunited with families (slide 83)
text: [Slide 83] Rajendra Shrivast[av]. For 20 years Rajendra Shrivastav has been finding mentally ill and helpless people and, out of more than 800 people from about 10 states, has reunited more than 500 with their families; 300 people have been successfully taken to various ashrams. Rajendra works fully to solve whatever health problems there are nearby. Even today Rajendraji's financial condition is not strong, but the work continues; there is not even a good vehicle. title: Sandhya Kulkarni - cycling records (slide 84)
text: [Slide 84] Sandhya Kulkarni. 'Sadhyaji' [as written] is a nature lover who has done a lot of work in life and keeps healthy by cycling, and has set records of 123 km in one day and 25 km in 2 hours 25 minutes. A newspaper clipping on the slide (Patrika, Indore edition, Tuesday 03 June 2025) is headlined 'Cycle brought a new dawn into the life of 62-year-old Sandhya'; it says she completed 1423 km in a virtual India Gate to Gateway of India event (e-certificate and medal), completed 118 km in one day in a cycle yatra in Ujjain and received the honour of oldest woman participant in 2023 and 2024, covered 25 km in 2 hours 25 minutes on the extra leap-year day, and has served as a government employee in the tribal area of Jhabua for 40 years.

title: Gopal bhai Rathwa - retired soldier training youth for army/police recruitment; training women in organic processing (slide 85)
text: [Slide 85] 'Gopal bhai Rathwa - came back to the village, brought change'. After retiring from the army most people choose a life of rest, but Gopal bhai Rathwa returned to the village and chose a different path - the path of change. Direction for youth: Gopal bhai now gives the village's youth free training for army and police recruitment, preparing children every morning in physical exercise, discipline and selection. Because children coming from nearby villages had difficulty arriving on time, Gopal bhai has also started a small hostel at personal expense where children can stay and prepare. Employment for women: Gopal bhai has also opened a path to employment for the village's women, training them in organic farming and processing - such as pickles, spices and processing of medicinal plants - so that women can become self-reliant.
text_original: [स्लाइड 85] गोपाल भाई राठवा – गाँव लौटे, बदलाव लाए आर्मी से रिटायर होने के बाद ज़्यादातर लोग आराम का जीवन चुनते हैं, लेकिन गोपाल भाई राठवा ने अपने गाँव लौटकर कुछ अलग ही रास्ता चुना — बदलाव का रास्ता। युवाओं के लिए दिशा गोपाल भाई अब गाँव के युवाओं को आर्मी और पुलिस भर्ती की निःशुल्क ट्रेनिंग दे रहे हैं। वे रोज़ सुबह बच्चों को शारीरिक व्यायाम, अनुशासन और चयन की तैयारी करवाते हैं। आस-पास के गाँवों से आने वाले बच्चों को समय पर पहुंचने में कठिनाई होती थी, इसलिए उन्होंने खुद के खर्चे से छोटा हॉस्टल भी शुरू किया है, जहाँ बच्चे रहकर तैयारी कर सकते हैं। महिलाओं के लिए रोज़गार सिर्फ युवा ही नहीं, गोपाल भाई ने गाँव की महिलाओं के लिए भी रोज़गार की राह खोली है। वे उन्हें ऑर्गेनिक खेती और प्रोसेसिंग की ट्रेनिंग देते हैं — जैसे अचार, मसाले, औषधीय पौधों की प्रोसेसिंग, जिससे महिलाएँ आत्मनिर्भर बन सकें।

Hindi (original): [स्लाइड 85] गोपाल भाई राठवा – गाँव लौटे, बदलाव लाए आर्मी से रिटायर होने के बाद ज़्यादातर लोग आराम का जीवन चुनते हैं, लेकिन गोपाल भाई राठवा ने अपने गाँव लौटकर कुछ अलग ही रास्ता चुना — बदलाव का रास्ता। युवाओं के लिए दिशा गोपाल भाई अब गाँव के युवाओं को आर्मी और पुलिस भर्ती की निःशुल्क ट्रेनिंग दे रहे हैं। वे रोज़ सुबह बच्चों को शारीरिक व्यायाम, अनुशासन और चयन की तैयारी करवाते हैं। आस-पास के गाँवों से आने वाले बच्चों को समय पर पहुंचने में कठिनाई होती थी, इसलिए उन्होंने खुद के खर्चे से छोटा हॉस्टल भी शुरू किया है, जहाँ बच्चे रहकर तैयारी कर सकते हैं। महिलाओं के लिए रोज़गार सिर्फ युवा ही नहीं, गोपाल भाई ने गाँव की महिलाओं के लिए भी रोज़गार की राह खोली है। वे उन्हें ऑर्गेनिक खेती और प्रोसेसिंग की ट्रेनिंग देते हैं — जैसे अचार, मसाले, औषधीय पौधों की प्रोसेसिंग, जिससे महिलाएँ आत्मनिर्भर बन सकें।

title: Amar Shaheed Chandrashekhar Azad (born at Bhavra, Alirajpur) (slides 92-93)
text: [Slide 92] Amar Shaheed Chandrashekhar Azad. Born: 23 July 1906 at Bhavra, district Alirajpur. Father: Shri Sitaram Tiwari; mother: Jagrani Devi. Martyrdom: 27 February 1931. [Slide 93] Amar Shaheed Chandrashekhar Azad was the Commander-in-Chief of the Hindustan Socialist Republican Army. He lit the flame of armed revolution in the Indian revolutionary movement and prepared a generation of revolutionaries, envisioning taking the freedom struggle to independence through armed revolution. After the Kakori conspiracy and the hanging, as its consequence, of Ramprasad Bismil, Rajendra Lahiri, Ashfaq Ulla Khan, Thakur Roshan Singh and others, he led almost the entire armed revolutionary movement from 1925 to 1931. He began his revolutionary life in 1921 in Banaras by taking part in the Non-Cooperation Movement; [the slide states he turned towards armed revolution from Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru, son of Motilal Nehru - as written]. Joining the Hindustan Republican Army led by Ramprasad Bismil, he carried out many revolutionary actions. After successfully carrying out the Kakori incident on 9 August 1925, the killing of Saunders in Lahore on 15 December 1928 and the Assembly bomb incident of 8 April 1929, he planned safe places for revolutionaries to defend the Lahore accused, and planned training for a Balochistan revolution and delivery of a bomb list. After these actions he made Allahabad, Banaras, Shahjahanpur, Ghazipur, Ilalabad [as written], Jhansi, Bulandshahr, Ramgarh, Ballia, Agra, Tekariganj, Kanpur, Delhi, Lahore and other places centres of revolution, and filled youth with enthusiasm for freedom. On 27 February 1931, together with fellow revolutionary Sukhdev Raj, when surrounded by police at Alfred Park in Allahabad, he fired the last bullet at himself and sacrificed his life, living up to the name 'Azad' and becoming immortal.

[स्लाइड 93] अमर शहीद चंद्रशेखर आज़ाद हिन्दुस्तान सोशलिस्ट रिपब्लिकन आर्मी के कमाण्डर इन चीफ़ थे। उन्होंने भारतीय क्रांतिकारी आन्दोलन में सशस्त्र क्रांति की ज्योति प्रज्वलित कर क्रांतिकारियों की पीढ़ी तैयार की। उन्होंने स्वतंत्रता संग्राम को सशस्त्र क्रांति के माध्यम से आज़ादी तक पहुँचाने की कल्पना की। उन्होंने काकोरी षड्यंत्र तक तथा षड्यंत्र के परिणामस्वरूप रामप्रसाद बिस्मिल, राजेन्द्र लाहिड़ी, अशफाक़ उल्ला खाँ, ठाकुर रोशनसिंह आदि के फाँसी के बाद 1925 से 1931 तक लगभग पूरे सशस्त्र क्रांति के आन्दोलन का संचालन किया। अमर शहीद चंद्रशेखर आज़ाद ने अपने क्रांतिकारी जीवन की शुरुआत 1921 में बनारस में असहयोग आन्दोलन में भाग लेकर की। मोतीलाल नेहरू के बेटे पं. जवाहरलाल नेहरू से सशस्त्र क्रांति की तरफ मुड़े।उन्होंने रामप्रसाद बिस्मिल के द्वारा संचालित हिन्दुस्तान रिपब्लिकन आर्मी से जुड़कर कई क्रांतिकारी घटनाओं को अंजाम दिया। 9 अगस्त, 1925 को काकोरी काण्ड, 15 दिसम्बर 1928 को लाहौर में सांडर्स की हत्या, 8 अप्रैल 1929 की असेंबली बमकाण्ड को सफलतापूर्वक अंजाम देकर कई स्थानों पर बने लाहौर के अभियुक्तों के बचाव हेतु क्रांतिकारियों के लिये सुरक्षित स्थल की योजना बनाई। बलोचिस्तान क्रांति का प्रशिक्षण तथा शाहीयों की बम सूची पहुँचाने की योजना बनाई। क्रांतिकारी कार्यों को अंजाम देने के पश्चात उन्होंने इलाहाबाद, बनारस, शाहजहाँपुर, ग़ाज़ीपुर, इलालाबाद, झाँसी, बुलंदशहर, रामगढ़, बलिया, आगरा, झाँसी, टेकारीगंज, कानपुर, बनारस, दिल्ली, लाहौर आदि जगहों को क्रांति के केन्द्र बनाया। युवाओं में उन्हें स्वतंत्रता के लिए उत्साह भरा। 27 फरवरी 1931 को अपने प्रमुख क्रांतिकारी प्रयासों में क्रांतिकारी साथी सुखदेव राज के साथ इलाहाबाद के अल्फ्रेड पार्क में पुलिस से घिर जाने पर उन्होंने अंतिम गोली स्वयं पर चलाकर बलिदान दे दिया। हिन्दुस्तान रिपब्लिकन एसोसिएशन के सशस्त्र विंग हिन्दुस्तान सोशलिस्ट रिपब्लिकन एसोसिएशन पर गोलीबारी शुरू हो गई। जब उन्हें गोली लगी तो उन्होंने आत्मबलिदान कर दिया और आज़ाद नामधारी पर खरा उतरते हुए अमर हो गए।
text_en: [Slide 92] Amar Shaheed Chandrashekhar Azad. Born: 23 July 1906 at Bhavra, district Alirajpur. Father: Shri Sitaram Tiwari; mother: Jagrani Devi. Martyrdom: 27 February 1931. [Slide 93] Amar Shaheed Chandrashekhar Azad was the Commander-in-Chief of the Hindustan Socialist Republican Army. He lit the flame of armed revolution in the Indian revolutionary movement and prepared a generation of revolutionaries, envisioning taking the freedom struggle to independence through armed revolution. After the Kakori conspiracy and the hanging, as its consequence, of Ramprasad Bismil, Rajendra Lahiri, Ashfaq Ulla Khan, Thakur Roshan Singh and others, he led almost the entire armed revolutionary movement from 1925 to 1931. He began his revolutionary life in 1921 in Banaras by taking part in the Non-Cooperation Movement; [the slide states he turned towards armed revolution from Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru, son of Motilal Nehru - as written]. Joining the Hindustan Republican Army led by Ramprasad Bismil, he carried out many revolutionary actions. After successfully carrying out the Kakori incident on 9 August 1925, the killing of Saunders in Lahore on 15 December 1928 and the Assembly bomb incident of 8 April 1929, he planned safe places for revolutionaries to defend the Lahore accused, and planned training for a Balochistan revolution and delivery of a bomb list. After these actions he made Allahabad, Banaras, Shahjahanpur, Ghazipur, Ilalabad [as written], Jhansi, Bulandshahr, Ramgarh, Ballia, Agra, Tekariganj, Kanpur, Delhi, Lahore and other places centres of revolution, and filled youth with enthusiasm for freedom. On 27 February 1931, together with fellow revolutionary Sukhdev Raj, when surrounded by police at Alfred Park in Allahabad, he fired the last bullet at himself and sacrificed his life, living up to the name 'Azad' and becoming immortal.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 1: 360 METALLURGY FLEXIBLE DRILLING MACHINE
text:
Project: 360 METALLURGY FLEXIBLE DRILLING MACHINE
Participants: Mr. kolekar Maruti; DhargudeMahesh Mahadev; Ritund Sagar Vijay; Chavare Rajkumar Laxman
Institution: Karmayogi Polytechnic College
Abstract: Drill machine have been the heart of every industry drilling holes in the parts of sheets and structure is regular industrial work perfect and well aligned drilling needs fixed and strong drill some parts cannot be drilled using fixed drill due to low space between drill bit and drill bed we need to use hands drills in such case but hands drill in case but hand drill have alignment problem while drilling so here we propose a 360 flexible drill that can be mounted on the table or wall and can be used to drill hole horizontally, vertically or ever upside down so this makes it possible for easy drilling in even complicated parts and surfaces . Thus we use rotating hinges and connectors with motor mount and supporting structure to design and fabrication a mini 360 degree flexible drilling machine for easy drilling operation.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 2: AUTOMATIC LIME LINE MARKING MACHINE FOR DIFFERENT SPORTS GROUNDS.
text:
Project: AUTOMATIC LIME LINE MARKING MACHINE FOR DIFFERENT SPORTS GROUNDS.
Participants: Sameer Manohar Mute; prajwal Ramesh Nagpurkar; Kunal Gajanan tople
Institution: G. H. Raisoni polytechnic, Nagpur
Institution as written in this record: G.H .Raisoni polytechnic, Nagpur
Abstract: lines are typically used to mark relatively flat surfaces . A lime is a tool for marking long, straight lines on relatively flat surfaces, much farther than is practical by hand or wirth a straight edge. Previously it is done with string across the surface to be marked and pulled tight and lime is poured. Next, the string is then plucked or snapped sharply. They may be used to lay out straight lines between two points, or vertical lines by using the weight of the line reel as a plumb line.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 4: CONTINUOUS VARIABLE TRANSMISSION
text:
Project: CONTINUOUS VARIABLE TRANSMISSION
Participants: Belgi Akanksha Manoj; Chandavale Saurabh Jalindar; Keripale Shruti Rajkumar; Pawar Shubhangi Vilas
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Miraj
Institution as written in this record: Government Polytechnic Miraj
Abstract: In a transmission system, transmission of power from a rotating power source to a rotating load takes place. Conventional Transmission allows for the selection of discrete gear ratios,thus limiting the system to provide maximum power or efficiency for limited ranges of transmission output speed. A continuously variable transmission however is a type of transmission that allows An infinitely variable ratios change within a finite range, thereby allowing the system to continuously operate in its most efficient or highest performance range. Tthe mechanism works by moving the reinforced belt up and down the inverted cones during rotation to provide a changing set of gear ratios. The inverted cone shaped pulleys provide a large amount of gear ratios for smooth transmission which is important for the low end torque required fir initial tilling. When the motor is started , The motor pulleys drives the input shaft which in turn rotates the holder rings and the sprocket bars engaged in the holder rings. The sprocket bars engaged in the teeth of the transmission belt give motion to the transmission belt . The transmission belt is guided in the rollers mounted on the speed change nut. The belt Teeth engaged in the sprocket bars of the output cone shaft drive the sprocket bars and thereby the holder rings and the output shaft.

Abstract: Abrasive jet machining is an advance technique of non traditional machining . Abrasive particles at very high velocity are directed on the work piece which leads to rupture of the work piece. Analysis of the different parameters which affect the dimensional accuracy of the hole is also carried out.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 8: Project:INTERNAL KEYWAY SLOTTING ATTTACHMENT ON LATHE MACHINE
text:
Project: Project:INTERNAL KEYWAY SLOTTING ATTTACHMENT ON LATHE MACHINE
Participants: Sagar Vijay Chavan; Karan Jitendra Mane; Babgonda Satgonda Patil; Rushikesh Pravin Thanedar
Institution: Latthe Polytechnic Sangli
Abstract: Mechnical engineering without production and manufacturing is meaningless and inseparable.Production and manufacturing process deals with conversion of raw materials inputs to finished products as per required dimensions specification and efficiently using recent technology. In order to perform different operation in the lathe such as different type of turning, chamfering, polishing, grooving , thread cutting, filling, knurling etc. In this project we have to decide that the keyway operation can be done using conventional lathe with help of keyway attachment . Our project is based on the need for the work holding devices. This attachment will enable the operation keyway process easier. In enerally the slotting/milling operation can be performed by slotting machine but in this case the keyway operation can be done using conventional lathe through keyway attachment. Our project have the following objectives:1. To reduce the lead time 2.To increase the productivity by using keyway attachment which is attached in the lathe 3.Even an unskilled technician can use them 4.No need for purchasing special machine for keyway i.e. slotting/milling .With these features ,we sincerely hope that our project serve as a valuable project .We welcome the correction ,comments based on our project.

Institution as written in this record: Gramin Polytechnic Vishnupuri, Nanded
Abstract: This project work titled 'FABRICATION OF ROTARY KALLER' has been conceived having studied the difficulty in powder the any type of harden spices powder substance. Our survey in the regard in several home/hotel revealed the facts that mostly some difficulty occurs I powder huge amount of spices powder .The powdering of huge amount of spices in hand is taking more time ad high manual force. Now the project has mainly concentrated on this difficulty ,and hence a suitable device has been designed. Such that the species powdering operation can be done without application of any impact force.

Institution: Marathwada Mitra Mandal's Polytechnic, PUNE-33
Abstract: This machine relates to a mask suitable for preventing carburization , nitriding or oxidation which I used in the case of carburizing or nitriding o portion of a steel or other metallic part to harden the portion while preventing the carburization or nitriding of the other portions to maintain the toughness of the other portion , or used for preventing a metallic part or the like from surface oxidation or carburization due to heat treatment, and relates also to a method pf preventing carburization or nitriding by the use of mask. In these type of machine or model we perform the activity is followed. First of all we set or fitted a job in to the set of job holding box then we give a motion to the tank which is upward then the bottom side of the job is masked at particular depth as we required . Then the same procedure is continue flor top side of the job. When we Dipped the ,job in the paint , then at a time 100 jobs are ready. But manually it requires more time to mask for all the jobs by hand by using brush or spray ,painting etc.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 12: PANTOGRAPH ENGRAVING MACHINE
text:
Project: PANTOGRAPH ENGRAVING MACHINE
Participants: Shreyas Pramod Manure; Tukaram Kamgonda Kalkile; Avinash Chandrakant Baigalalu; Mahesh Yamunappa Pawar
Institution: A.G. Patil Polytechnic Institute, Solapur
Abstract: In subject of theory of machine four bar mechanism is very important pantograph is one of the examples of four bar mechanism .Generally it is nothing but the parallelogram used for the engraving the required material . A pantograph is a simple powerful tool which can enlarge the scope of engraver. We can engrave images to reduced or enlarge scale with a pantograph depending on how the parts are measured and assembled. In this topic we design ,develop and analyze the portable pantograph for engraving letters on wood and fiber .Our pantograph is light weight and portable . Also engrave with that different scaling of letters is main work of this pantograph . This is low cost machine which compare to conventional pantograph . It may be old mechanism but still it has vast scope . In present days it has many beneficial uses. A pantograph is a simple and powerful tool which can enlarge the scope of artwork and crafting. The pantograph in the illustration would produce a copy smaller than the original .By changing distance between the pivot points you can change the percentage of enlargement your pantograph provides.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 13: PORTABLE CNC MACHINE
text:
Project: PORTABLE CNC MACHINE
Participants: Rohit Sandip Patil; Ranveer Ranjay Patil; Amol Ravindra Mestry; Mahesh Hindurao Padalkar
Institution: Institute of Civil and Rural Engineering, Gargoti
Abstract: IN manufacturing industry, portable CNC milling machine is important to produce a product. This project describes design and fabrication of portable CNC milling machine. This project utilized operating principles of CNC milling machine where it can move in 3 axes specifically X,Y,Z. For this project Master CAM software was used to generate the G-code for milling cutting construction testing. The most important part is the holder of the spindle, without a strong spindle holder it is difficult to produce good quality products. This project develop CNC machine in combination with the computer. Parallel port was utilized together with intermediate Mach3 software to move the machine during cutting process . The purpose of this project is to develop a low-cost project portable CNC milling machine. It can be transported using minimum manpower, easily handled and also suitable for small industry . AC power supply is used to sent to the noise filter to reduce signal interference before sent to the stepper motor to allow axes X,Y,Z move .CNC machine structure movement is controlled by the DC steeper motor. For example, when DC steeper motor gets signal ,it was sentr to the gear box and turn the ball screw that connect with each drivers X,Y,Z moving to start cutting process according to the computer instruction until the cutting done.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 18: ALL TERRAIN VEHICLE
text:
Project: ALL TERRAIN VEHICLE
Participants: prathamesh Prasanna Bhole; Vikas Sunil Palte; shubham Sanjay Jadhav; Akshay Vilas Sawant
Institution: Sahyadri polytechnic Sawarde
Abstract: an all terrain vehicle (ATV),also known as a quad ,quad bike ,three_ wheeler ,four wheeler or quadricycle as defined by the American national standards institute (ANSI) is a vehicle that travels on low _pressure tires , With a seat that is straddled by the operator ,along with handle bears for steering control.as the name implies ,it is designed to handle a wider variety of terrain than most other vehicles by the current ANSI definition, ATVs are intended for use by a single operator ,although some companies have developed ATVs intended for use by the operator And one passenger .the passenger is not required to have a helmet. These ATVS are referred to as tandem Atv's, the rider sits on and operates these vehicles like motorcycle, but the extra wheels give more stability at slower speeds. Although most are equipped with three or four wheels ,six wheels models exist for specialized applications.

Institution: Hi-Tech Polytechnic College
Abstract: this invention is in automobile sector. Until not any inbuilt system available in vehicle to lift any one side as per our requirement ,we develop pneumatic system in vehicle to lift wheel when we require .we use four different pneumatic cylinder in four different wheel to lift as per suitable height. title: GIAN Nidhi record 22: :COOLING SYSTEM OF SILENCER
text:
Project: :COOLING SYSTEM OF SILENCER
Participants: Suryawanshi Jaydeep Bhimrao
Institution: Government polytechnic, Jalgaon
Abstract: Personal mobility means freedom for the physically challenged. One of the best inventions in the medical field that helped both the elderly and the handicapped is the mobility vehicle. The fact that they are no longer depending on some one else topper form daily duties is a big step forward. A large variety of mobility vehicle are available, from which one is to be selected as per requirements. Mobility vehicles are designed based on the usage i.e. either indoor or outdoor. They make use of conventional energy for recharging . The cost of the require considerable use and control of both arms for operation, thus adaptations are required for individual with asymmetrical use of their arms. Building kupon previous projects ,the goal of this project is to create accessory ,to be installed on a standard wheel chair, which would allow full control of the wheel chair with only one hand while addressing areas lacking in commercial products and previous designs, such as manufacture ability, attendant control user comfort and ergonomics. After preliminary testing and analysis of three arm propulsion designs, the project team developed a design for a removable ,lever operated accessory which could be adapted to fit a range of the most popular standard wheelchair models. The propulsion system, connected to the main lever by a coupler link ,consists a dual gear-pawl assembly in which the desired direction of motion is chosen by moving a shifter to engage one of the two gears press-fit around clutches, each of hich allows motion in only one direction, either forward or reverse . By including a neutral pawl position in which neither clutch is engaged, this design allows at attendant to propel and control the chair .In this paper an attempt is made to fabricate a steering powered wheel chair at an optimal cost which can be utilized both indoor and outdoor environments.

A large variety of mobility vehicle are available, from which one is to be selected as per requirements. Mobility vehicles are designed based on the usage i.e. either indoor or outdoor. They make use of conventional energy for recharging . The cost of the require considerable use and control of both arms for operation, thus adaptations are required for individual with asymmetrical use of their arms. Building kupon previous projects ,the goal of this project is to create accessory ,to be installed on a standard wheel chair, which would allow full control of the wheel chair with only one hand while addressing areas lacking in commercial products and previous designs, such as manufacture ability, attendant control user comfort and ergonomics. After preliminary testing and analysis of three arm propulsion designs, the project team developed a design for a removable ,lever operated accessory which could be adapted to fit a range of the most popular standard wheelchair models. The propulsion system, connected to the main lever by a coupler link ,consists a dual gear-pawl assembly in which the desired direction of motion is chosen by moving a shifter to engage one of the two gears press-fit around clutches, each of hich allows motion in only one direction, either forward or reverse . By including a neutral pawl position in which neither clutch is engaged, this design allows at attendant to propel and control the chair .In this paper an attempt is made to fabricate a steering powered wheel chair at an optimal cost which can be utilized both indoor and outdoor environments.

Institution: Yashwantrao Chavan Institute of Polytechnic, Bid
Abstract: The project as titled is an electric vehicle working on battery stored electricity and DC motor propulsion . The model Is a working prototype created as an outgoing electric vehicle initiative in Yashwantrao Chavan Institute of Polytechnic ,Beed. AS LAST YEARS PROTOTYPE WAS FEATURED IN PREMIERE NEWS CHANNEL SUCH AS ZEE 24TASS and others. This year's electric vehicle has been created by keeping aesthetics and functionality in mind. The vehicle has been designed in such a way that ,it has high load bearing capacity and high construction . This helps the vehicle to be used for personal as well as commercial purposes. The suspension and robust design also deals with the irregularities of the roads often found in rural or underdeveloped regions, helping in the transportation of goods even in harsh condition The model though create as vehicle , is actually designed by keeping different applications in mind hence can be modified to perform different applications as required

title: GIAN Nidhi record 24: Project:MAYORS T-REX.
text:
Project: Project:MAYORS T-REX.
Participants: Yash Shinde; Meet Limbachia
Institution: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Polytechnic
Abstract: The main aim behind the "MAYORS T-REX" is to build a vehicle for bike rider which is safe as a car in the cost comparable to bike .It manoeuvres quickly yet strong enough to with stand accidents. It is made using the 10 gauge MS pipe for chassis and 16 gauge for body which is powered by 250CC rickshaw engine. It has in line gear shifting not like conventional gear shifted system which moves left to rights ,also the clutch is provided on the hand so as to remove the confusion caused by the normal ABC system this makes it extremely user friendly, the vehicle itself can take load up to 500kg and automatic fire extinguisher system is given to eliminate short circuit fire caused near the engine and is equipped with emergency safety device.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 25: POLLUTANT ALARM SYSTEM IN 2 WHEELERS
text:
Project: POLLUTANT ALARM SYSTEM IN 2 WHEELERS
Participants: Marewar Mithul Vishnu; Kulkarni Prashant Pralhadrao; Jondhale Abhishek Chandrakant
Institution: Gramin Polytechnic
Abstract: Now a days the pollution control of vehicle is very important concept in the world ,to this project is developed for indicating the pollutants in exhaust gases in vehicles . It is mainly consist of smoke ,Sensor and micro control unit .The smoke sensor is connected with the silencer of the vehicle. It senses the amount of smoke and sends signal to the micro controller frequently. The values are stored in the micro controller. If the data stored is normal the vehicle will be allowed for FC thus it is very easy to check the status of the vehicle while incepting it. Since the micro controller is used the operation are very sensitive . This can be easily implemented in vehicles.

Abstract: Walking bike is a totally new way of moving with the electric assist it takes no more effort to walk then a walk in a park. These treadmill BIKE is a arrangement of gears and chain mechanism which takes less effort then regular bicycle . When your walking on the walking bike, you push the treadmill backward with your feet. Which runs the sprocket and rear wheels is moved forward using break speed will reduce slowly . The walking bike has a sturdy and balanced base. If there are little pebbles on the road it will just cruise along a regular bike. The rubber of the treadmill has anti slip structure which will prevent you from sliding of bike. We aspired to built a vehicle that is faster than walking and easier to ride than a bicycle

title: GIAN Nidhi record 31: ULTRA LOW COST MINI TRACTOR FOR LOWER INCOME FARMERS
text:
Project: ULTRA LOW COST MINI TRACTOR FOR LOWER INCOME FARMERS
Participants: Avishkar Navnath Jambhale; Krishna Narsu Mule; Sandip Bansi Chandanshiv; Ravindra Ramdas Kadam
Institution: Yahwantrao Chavan Institute of Polytechnic, PUNE
Abstract: As implied in the title, the model is a low cost mini tractor created for lower income farmers specifically .It works on 1500CC petrol engine which powers the vehicle and causes the tractor's self-propulsion. As farmers of India are suffering from debt and are having the worst time ever due to the changing environment , the need ,for increasing the output and quality of produce has become a need of the hour .The harvest can indeed be increased by the use of state of the art machinery and new technology and can prove to be an asset to the farmers. The problem being the higher cost of these machinery and the maintenance cost .To counter this problem ,we have created this mini tractor model which can be used by the farmers for different farming application such as plowing, sowing, harvesting, fertilizer, spreading ,weeding etc. The model is low cost and kept that way ,so that can be affordable to the lower income farmers and as a result could possible increase there income

title: GIAN Nidhi record 32: "Helmet Assisted Ignition System"
text:
Project: "Helmet Assisted Ignition System"
Participants: Ponde Mahesh; Shinde Akshada
Institution: P.Dr.VV.Patil Inst. of Tech. & Engg. (Polytechnic), Pravaranagar
Abstract: This Project presents a new intelligent helmet that ensures that the rider cannot start the bike without wearing it. This helmet uses a simple cable replacement for wireless switching of a bike, using RF operated switch. RED & GREEN LEDs are mounted on the Dashboard of the Bike to indicate its Ignition. IF ignition key is ON & Helmet circuit is closed THEN GREEN LED will glow ELSE RED will lit. The basic principle used is a remotely operated RF switch. The trigger switch is in the helmet circuit which will be activated only when the rider wears it, which in turn switch ON the relay in the bike's ignition circuit, thereby making it mandatory for the rider to wear it in order to START the bike.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 33: SOLAR OPERATED CAR
text:
Project: SOLAR OPERATED CAR
Participants: Devendra S. SawantHarshal; B. ValviSiddheshwar; V. Madhey Mitesh; C. Patil
Institution: Government polytechnic Mumbai
Abstract: Connected to the solar array tracks the available energy into Watts or Volts. The Watts or Volts which are arrested inside the power trackers and the energy is stored in the Batteries. The batters are connected to the Motor Controller. The Motor Controller maintains the speed or the acceleration of the Motor. The Motor Controller is connected to the motor. The motor rotates at the desired speed and is connected to the wheel. The wheel rotates at the desired speed and the car works. Generally if the car is in motion the converted sunlight is delivered directly to the Motor Controller, but there are times when there is more energy coming from the array then the Motor Controller needs, when this happens, the extra energy gets stored in the batteries for later use. When the solar array can't produce enough energy to drive the motor at the desired speed the array energy is supplemented with stored energy from the batteries. Of course, when the car is not in motion, all the energy from the solar array is stored in the batteries. There is also a way to get back some of the energy used to propel the car, when the car is being slow down, instead of using the normal mechanical brakes, the motor is turned into a generated towards and turned into a generator and energy flow backwards through the Motor Controller and energy into the batteries for storage. This is known as Regenerative braking. The amount of energy returned to the batteries is small, but every bit helps.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 34: ECHO-FRIENDLY VEHICLE.
text:
Project: ECHO-FRIENDLY VEHICLE.
Participants: Sanket Shrikant Warudkar; Sakharam Sharadra Deshmukhk; Sanket Dongaonkar; Nilesh Vasantrao Wankhede; Ganesh Kale
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Jalana
Institution as written in this record: Government Polytechnic, Jalna
Abstract: The ECHO-FRIENDLY vehicle is the recent revolution in the field of automobile. In this area of petrol/Diesel crisis, electrical vehicle is going to be best alternative to the traditional IC engines. The IC Engines are having very low efficiency as compared to eves. Due to the high efficiency, ECHO-FRIENDLY vehicle are very economical & hence preferred. The basic principal that we are gaining to use is use of kinetic energy (rotational) if the four wheels of vehicles up till now this rotational energy of wheels is not use of we change the design of wheels to generator then by using this energy generated the vehicle can driven with zero % fuel. A car can be an ideal vehicle for hospital campuses, large company premises, airports, amusement parks and measures, where there are definite roads for it to travel with little other traffic. Charging facilities are also at hand at these places. The noise less, emission less character of the car makes it the best option for safari park rides. Also they find there way to the golf club and children park easily.

text:

Participants: Salve Priyanka Suryakant; Bhise Manjushree Anurath; Sadekar Dipali Gangadhar; Reddy Sailee Sudhakar
Institution: Govt. Residential Women's Polytechnic, Latur
Institution as written in this record: Government Residential Woman's Polytechnic, Latur
Abstract: The basic idea of the project is based upon the lines of black box used in the airplane s& trains. Here the system parameter automobile like speed, engine temperature, gear position, are continuously displayed whereas the fuel level is indicated by LED. As a part of our project we simulate all the parameter using PIC MICRO controller & LCD display. The trust of our project is mainly to keep hardware at minimum, thereby making it compact & easy to mount on the vehicle. This product target the transport owner's of heavy vehicles as a customer.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 36: Automatic Car Lifter (ACL)
text:
Project: Automatic Car Lifter (ACL)
Participants: Shaikh Ubaid; Shaikh Hussain; Palaskar Ravikiran D; Prayag Niraj Kumar; Shaikh Abdul Saeed; Trimbake Mahesh
Institution: Gramin Polytechnic, Vishnupuri, Nanded
Abstract: The operation of lifting the car requires, much more muscle power & human inputs. They are many cases, for which the car is lifted such as for dismantling gear box, suspension Assembly, Housing, Shock Absorbers, at the time of puncture, wheel alignment, Hub Greasing, Catalyst converter & silencer cleaning , detecting ball joint play etc…. Now we are going to introduce a new bracket in front of you people to provide an ultimate solution over all above described problems. This bracket will consist a 1. Ton capacity bottle type hydraulic jack say it "Automatic CAR LIFTER" (ACL) By incorporating this bracket you can easily operate the car & also your mechanic will perform his task without any fatigue & stress. He can put his concentration over the fault detection and remedies not over to lift the car by lifting it with manually operated screw jacks at different position. This may helpful in many emergency cases where the garages or workshops are too far to change the tires or to detect the noise or leakage from bottom assembly. This bracket (ACL) is also having a special rotary attachment which will rotate the car (manually). This will provide ease in a critical rainy situation to bring the car from mud. The tires can be changed or some simple remedial operations can be done at any where not at popular garages. This will save your valuable time to go for workshops and garages. Also it is observed in many garages that there are workers but the ram is not avail to lift your car to do maintenance so this increases the idle time of your so busy car. All these savior situations can be favored by adopting our designed bracket to your front engine front wheel car. E.g. MARUTI 800 INDICA V2, etc

title: GIAN Nidhi record 37: Charcoal Silencer
text:
Project: Charcoal Silencer
Participants: Amol Nandlal Bedmutha; Tarang Mahesh Gharpure; Pratik Kantilalji Bhandari; Amit Prakash Baraskar
Institution: K. K. Wagh Polytechnic, Amrutdham, Panchvati, Nashik
Abstract: Charcoal silencer consists of hollow pipe in which wool is surrounded on the walls from inside. There are several oily baffles arranged in series along the pipe & there is filter at the exit. Working: - Charcoal silencer consists of hollow pipe in which wool is surrounded on the walls from inside. On this wool various chemicals like charcoal powder, calcium carbonate, calcium hydroxide, sodium hydroxide, are applied to it. When due to combustion of fuel in the engine, exhaust gases containing carbon monoxide are released from it. These gases get reacted with the chemicals placed on the wool along the pipe. At last the byproducts obtained are passed through a serially arranged oily baffles. An oil reservoir is provided. The exhaust gases when passed through it, some particles from it gets sticked to the baffles. Then further it is passed through the filter & left to the exit.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 38: BIO-BIKE
text:
Project: BIO-BIKE
Participants: S. K. Chikane; D. S. Sakhare; P. S. Kawarkhe; G. S. Joshi
Institution: Government Polytechnic Risod Road
Abstract: Due to fuel crises and increasing pollution. There is a need of eco-friendly Vehicle. This lead to produce for bio-bike or to convert petrol bike into bio-gas bike with certain modification. Bio bike consist of four main component 1. Gas storage tank. 2. Regulation kit. 3. Filter. 4. Rubber tube 1. Gas storage tank:- it is simply a tank use to store gas and supply to engine. 2. Regulation kit:- it is a kit which regulate or to maintain the flow of gas continuous 3. Filter :- Filter is used for remove the moisture present in gas. 4. Rubber tube: Rubber tubes are used to connect the various devices to engine cylinder. Bio-Gas and petrol are 90% similar for supplying to engine cylinder. Only difference is that Bio- Gas is directly supply in combustion chamber and air is drawn from carburetor. As uses 4-stoke petrol engine so working is similar to 4-stroke engine. 1. Suction stroke: - When piston moves from T.D.C. to B.D.C. pressure is less in cylinder than that of atmosphere so vacuum is created inside the cylinder due to which air is suck from carburetor along with Bio-Gas is enter in combustion chamber. 2. Compression Stroke: - When piston moves from B.D.C. to T.D.C. it compressed the charge present in engine cylinder which rises the temperature and pressure of charge at the end of compression stroke spark will take place. 3. Expansion/power stroke: - In this stroke piston is moved from T.D.C. to B.D.C. due to burning of charge and work done on piston by gases it develops power hence, it is called power stroke. 4. Exhaust Stroke: After the end of power stroke piston moves from B.D.C. to T.D.C. it allows to escape the exhaust gases in to atmosphere through exhaust valve. Bio-Gas fuel is easily obtained from Bio-Gas plant. Its construction is very easy with low skill required e.g. 10 feet depth and 10 feet diameter. The amount required for construction is 10,000 to 15, 000. only the main advantage is that raw material is used for making gas is cattle dung, wastage food.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 39: NEWTON AUTOMATIC CENTRIFUGAL CLUTCH
text:
Project: NEWTON AUTOMATIC CENTRIFUGAL CLUTCH
Participants: Sangramsingh F. Chouhan; Jaykumar S. Bhattad; Bharat Bhutada; Nachiket N. Joshi; Gururaj A. Utage
Institution: S. E. S. Polytechnic, Solapur
Institution as written in this record: S.E.S. Polytechnic Solapur
Abstract: The Newton automatic centrifugal clutch employees only one set of compression springs instead of the usual two seats, with this arrangement it is possible to reduce the weights of the centrifugal members. When the clutch is disengaged & the engine is running at idling speed the hinged bob weights rest against the lower or inward sides of holes in the flywheel. When the engine is accelerated above 700 to 800 r.p.m. , the weights fly outwards and in doing so their leers ends compress the spring, so as to engage the clutch plate. When the full engagement pressure between the clutch member has been attain any further increase in engine speed brings the bob weights against the outsides of the flywheel holes, thus limiting the pressure plate action. The clutch withdrawal levers are of orthodox design so when clutch is operating of speeds above its centrifugal engagement speed the clutch can be disengaged or reengaged for gear changing purpose as in normal band gear change practice.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 40: DESIGN OF QUADRACYCLE WITH QUADRA STEERING
text:
Project: DESIGN OF QUADRACYCLE WITH QUADRA STEERING
Participants: Amey Sawant; Rupesh D. Nathe; Pawan Painjane; Tushar Mokal
Institution: Thakur Polytechnic
Abstract: The design of quadra cycle consists of the mechanisms which helps the cycle to rotate in zero radius. It also consists of low radius turning mechanism. The transmission system is so made that we can obtain the normal movement & zero radius (360 turning about itself) simultaneously by just using differential of auto rickshaw. In zero radius movement the linkage are connected to both front and rear wheel so that the wheel can be turned in desired direction so as to obtain zero radius turning. In low radius two rack and pinion steering mechanism are used at front and rear wheel.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 41: MOBILE CONTROL PICK AND PLACE VEHICLE.
text:
Project: MOBILE CONTROL PICK AND PLACE VEHICLE.
Participants: Nitu Ramdas Khedekar; Jyoti Gopinath Anap; Kavita Baban Gunjal; Archana Jaishing Rajbhoj
Institution: Padamshri Dr. Vitthalrao Vikhe Patil Institute of Technology and Engineering (Polytechnic), Pravaranagar, Loni - 413736
Abstract: Vehicle arm require an "arm controller" to command motors to achieve a coordinated & predetermined motion in an external space with desired accuracy, efficiency & quick response to the controller. In same sense vehicle requires a vehicle controller to command the motor to achieve a linear motion. Specified in the X-Y direction. Today everyone can afford to have a cell phone. Hence using the cell phone users can controlled the arm and vehicle action in the forward, reverse, left & right direction. This system will be at prime importance where the manual fault diagnosis cannot take place the operation controls the vehicle motion via mobile phone. Many mobile vehicle move in straight line 'stop' & 'Go' manner, i.e., the vehicle could travel in a straight line for same distance & then stop while stopped it could run to a new heading once turning finished. The vehicle is then free to make another straight line displacement. In our project we used one mobile at remote side i.e. o a vehicle the mobile has a facility automatic answering mode due to which mobile pick up the call automatically, so the manual pick up is not required the o/p of mobile is connected to an audio power amplifier. They are specifically designed for mobile equipment operating with 5V supply the amplified signal is provide to DTMF i.e. Dual tone multi frequency decoder AC register signaling is used in DTMF telephones. When the number is dialed then it is converted in 4 bit binary code by the DTMF decoder the O/P of the DTMF decoder is given to the i/p of micro controller. First four pin of micro controller are used to interface DTMF decoder.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 42: AIR POWERED CAR
text:
Project: AIR POWERED CAR
Participants: Yogesh Shantaram Shanbhag; Sujit Acchelal Sharma; Jiten Rameshbhai
Institution: K. J. Somaiya Polytechnic, Mumbai
Abstract: Petroline, which has been the main source of fuel for the history of cars, is becoming more and more expensive and impractical (especially from an environmental standpoint). These factors are leading car manufactures to develop cars fueled by alternative energies. While petroline prices have not yet reached their highest point, they have climbed steeply in the past few years. But cost is not the only problem with using petroline as our primary fuel. It is also damaging to the environment, and since it is not a renewable resource, it will eventually run out. One possible alternative is the air-powered car. There are at least two ongoing projects in the world that are developing a new type of car that will run on compressed air. This project is about the technology behind compressed-air cars being developed and how they may replace our petrol guzzler by the end of the decade! However, this being a new concept for the Indians and the need of the hour, we have decided to work on it as our project.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 43: Design and Fabrication of car for Handicap person.
text:
Project: Design and Fabrication of car for Handicap person.
Participants: Chetan Thakre; Ganesh Palatkar; Kalpak Onkar; Amar Kathwate
Institution: G. H. Raisoni polytechnic, Nagpur
Abstract: No doubt that the techniques are developing every aspect of the living beings like telecommunications, aviations, automobiles more and more. But looking towards end users of these development, there are only high class customers. A common person cannot afford to enjoy these sophistications. Similarly there are sufficient amount of development for handicapped person also. But these are all untouched by the middle class customers. So providing these technologies to middle class customers with ease on their pockets is the basic concept going to demonstrate with this project. According to market survey the biggest problem is that the handicapped person cannot go inside the cars available for them; then need help of some other person. This makes them dependent on others. This develops the feeling of underestimation or guiltiness in them. Even if they go inside the car then it is not necessary that he will be comfortable while driving the car. The project "car for Handicap person with wheel chair" is specially designed for the people without legs. Every handicap person have at least wheelchair for his daily activities. In our project wheel chair will get mounted on the chassis of car so easily, as we have designed a unique mechanism for the loading and uploading of that wheelchair with person. The locking arrangement is also provided for th safety. We have to design such wheelchair which will come in the space between the two wheels o four chassis of the auto rickshaw easily. So the person will not be needing anyone's help to climb the vehicle and can ride the car with ease. We are also providing the roof and front glass so as to protect the person from the weather condition. Even if there are some faults in the car such as puncture, lack of petrol, then person to unlock the chair and come down from the chassis of the car and can go with his wheelchair, which we have designed specially and will be given as the standard part of the car. One more problem is to reverse that car, so we are providing the reverse gear arrangement in our car as it is provided in the auto rickshaw. Just by pulling the lever he will be able to reverse the car. This vehicle can be also driven by normal people. This vehicle will prove as the boon for handicapped person.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 44: ADVANCED GSM CAR SECURITY SYSTEM.
text:
Project: ADVANCED GSM CAR SECURITY SYSTEM.
Participants: Sagar Krishna Dhande; Prashant R. Chavare; Sandesh Kathawate; Abhijit Nagare; Yuvraj Pavale
Institution: N.M.V. Polytechnic, Talegaon Dabhade, Vishnupuri
Abstract: GSM Advanced Car Security System is a very brand new car Alarm, it uses the mobile GSM communication networks to Transmit alarm signal and control instruction. It enables you to keep in touch with your car at all times. You could supervise and Control your lovely car at any time and anywhere, just by a phone. In this system, one password keyboard is fitted on the ignition lock. When Car owner leave away fro mthe car the car ios under alert condition. If the password type by the burglar does not matches to the password of the car owner the car is under alert condition. In case of robbery, driver can let the hijacker to drive away the car, he can leave off the car safely and find a normal telephone, dial in the system phone and send out a command, the car can be controlled to stop from running. With the help of GSM network positioning, the lost car could be easily found out.

Project: AN EXPERIMENTAL INVESTIGATION OF FEASIBILITY OF ACYTYLENE AS A FUEL FOR S.I. ENGINE

Institution: Priyadarshani Polytechnic
Abstract: In early stages, a few towns used acetylene for lighting, including Tata in Hungary where it was installed on 24 th July 1897 & North Petherton in England in 1898. Now a days acetylene is used for carburization of steel acetylene lamp, fore cavers and mines, for gas welding and cutting, etc. Acetylene gas is also called as Ethyne and Ethine, was discovered in 1836 by Edmund Davy in England, who identified it as a " New carburet of hydrogen" French Chemist Marcellin Berthelot, who coined the name "Acetylene", rediscovered it in 1860. Now a day, the fuels used for S. I. engine are petrol, kerosene, C.N.G. and L.P.G., etc., which is likely to get exhausted in future and also the cost of the fuel is increasing day by day. It creates pollution; hence it is need of time to investigate an alternate fuel, which is suitable for S.I. engine. The alternative fuel should be easily available in market at low cost. Acetylene due to its good physical, chemical and thermodynamic properties would be used as an alternative fuel. Acetylene (C2H2) is not an air gas, but a synthesis gas; generally produce from the reaction of calcium carbide with water. It is colorless gas, has a strong garlic odor, unstable, unsaturated, and highly combustible and produces a very hot flame (over 3000 o C). Acetylene can solve all the problems like combustion, knocking. Thermal efficiency, and pollution. It is available at low cost (i.e. 1 kg of carbide gives 349 lit. of acetylene which is about only Rs. 30/- approx) Acetylene is used to run S.I. engine. The power generated by engine is utilized for running machines, pumps, vehicles, SPM, etc…

title: GIAN Nidhi record 46: ELECTROMAGNETIC SHOCK ABSORBER
text:
Project: ELECTROMAGNETIC SHOCK ABSORBER
Participants: Sanket Vivek Phalak; Sagar Subhashrao Raut; Hemchandra Ashok Rane; Amol Shridhar Nagpure; Vinit Kashinath Kolte
Institution: K.B.P. Polytechnic, Kopargaon
Institution as written in this record: K.B.P. POLYTECHNIC, KOPARGAON
Abstract: Every automotive suspension has two goals: passenger comfort and vehicle control. Comfort is provided by isolating the vehicle's passengers from road disturbances. Control is achieved by keeping the car body from rolling and pitching excessively, and maintaining good contact between the tire and the road. Unfortunately, these goals are in conflict. In a luxury sedan the suspension is usually designed with an emphasis on comfort, but the result is a vehicle that rolls and pitches while driving and during turning and braking. In sports cars, where the emphasis is on control, the suspension is designed to reduce roll and pitch. For this we are design this electromagnetic (EM) shock absorber. In this damper as the coil assembly moves, the fluid in the direction of travel is pressurized, and flows through the orifice, where it can be activated by the electromagnetic coils. Increasing field strength produces stronger MR particle chains between the two poles of the field, creating a higher resistance to the flow of the MR fluid through the orifice section of the piston. This resistance provides the proper dissipation of force and damps the vibrations properly. During this the accumulator balance the volume of fluid in cylinder (i.e. above the piston & below the piston) In this EM shock absorber we are use magneto-rheological fluid. The magneto-rheological fluid like electrorheological fluid is a king smart material whose rheological properties may be rapidly varied by the application of a magnetic field. This material typically consists of micron-sized ferrous particles dispersed in a fluid or an elastomer. When the MR fluid is exposed to a magnetic field, the liquid state may be changed to semi-liquid or extremely to a solid state. When the magnetic field is removed, the state may recover to liquid. The speed of rheology is an order of millisecond.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 47: THROTTLE BODY INJECTION SYSTEM
text:
Project: THROTTLE BODY INJECTION SYSTEM
Participants: Shrikant Purushottam Kulkarni; Rakesh Bhaskarrao Jagtap; Sanjay Ashok More; Sumeet B. Kunkari; Virendra Brijlal Lohar
Institution: Government polytechnic, Dhule
Abstract: Over recent years, problems such as global warming atomospheric pollution and natural resources, depletion have become ever more obvious. In accordance with these circumstances the vehicle industries has to deal with the tightening of emission and fuel consumption, regulation around the whole world. Aiming to meet this emission and fuel consumption, regulation while contributing to the evolution of the vehicle oriented society and offering various solutions to vehicle fulfillment the better performance. Throttle body injection (TBI) system is very versatile highly adoptable form of electronic control fuel injection system. TBI provides the optimum mixture ratio of air-fuel at all stages of combustion. Throttle body injection system has immediate response characteristics to constantly changing condition and allows the engine to run with the leanest possible air fuel mixture ratio with greatly reducing exhaust gas emission. Because of its air-fuel mixture is so precise best upon much more than simple engine vacuum and other mechanical metering means. TBI naturally enjoys an increased in fuel economy over a simple mechanical form of fuel introduction such as outdated carburetor. The throttle body injection system is form of electronic fuel injection which is controlled by the ECM (electronic control module) which controls the throttle body injection system based on electronic fuel injection system through all stages of operation according to data received regarding the current state of engine performance, speed and load. Means ECM is the brain of throttle body injection system. Now a days the main objectives of an automobile industry is to give a better quality of product in low cost which gives the better relaxation to the common people. Throttle body injection is one of the most system which fulfill the above all things and due to this TBI has certain advantages over the other fuel systems like less fuel consumption, increase in efficiency of engine and reducing the pollution. It is used in the light commercial vehicle, passenger cars and recently in the two wheeler for the better performance. It is also used in Bharat Stage-II or Euro Norms-II and due to this TBI has a bright future in automobile industry.

Institution: ISTE (INSTITUTE FOR STUDIES IN TECHNOLOGY IN ENGINEERING)
Abstract: We have converted a standard bicycle which is readily available in the market converted into electrical drive so that effort of driving for person is reduced. title: GIAN Nidhi record 49: DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT OF DYNAMIC VIBRATION ABSORBER
text:
Project: DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT OF DYNAMIC VIBRATION ABSORBER
Participants: Sagar Shrirant Shewale; Mahendra; Shrikant Baban Chinchkar; Pankaj Hanmantrao Mali
Institution: Padambhushan Vasantrao Patil Institute of technology, Budhgaon
Abstract: The concept of the vibration absorber using variable stiffness beam has two important requirements. 1. The two absorber beams should deform as a single beam in bending as a cantilever. Thus, the two beams should act as a top and bottom fiber of a cantilever and no movement should take place with respect to each other of these two fibers. 2. The opening/closing movement between the rods should be independent of the attached mass. Also, there should not be any relative motion between the beam and mass, when the machine is running. The weight of the absorber should be as low as possible. The resonant device used is a parallel beam combination with one common lumped mass at each end. A mechanical system has been used to change the distance between the parallel beams and hence the moment of area about the neutral axis and thus the natural frequencies. This shaft has right hand and left hand threads on the top and bottom portions. Accordingly two internally threaded (right and left hand) blocks have been mounted on the shaft's top and bottom portions. Further, the sub assembly of the vibration absorber has been mounted on these two blocks. For one complete rotation of the gears, the total liner distance covered is twice the pitch of the thread.
text_original:
Project: DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT OF DYNAMIC VIBRATION ABSORBER
Participants: Sagar Shrirant Shewale; Mahendra; Shrikant Baban Chinchkar; Pankaj Hanmantrao Mali
Institution: Padambhushan Vasantrao Patil Institute of technology, Budhgaon
Abstract: The concept of the vibration absorber using variable stiffness beam has two important requirements. 1. The two absorber beams should deform as a single beam in bending as a cantilever. Thus, the two beams should act as a top and bottom fiber of a cantilever and no movement should take place with respect to each other of these two fibers. 2. The opening/closing movement between the rods should be independent of the attached mass. Also, there should not be any relative motion between the beam and mass, when the machine is running. The weight of the absorber should be as low as possible. The resonant device used is a parallel beam combination with one common lumped mass at each end. A mechanical system has been used to change the distance between the parallel beams and hence the moment of area about the neutral axis and thus the natural frequencies. This shaft has right hand and left hand threads on the top and bottom portions. Accordingly two internally threaded (right and left hand) blocks have been mounted on the shaft's top and bottom portions. Further, the sub assembly of the vibration absorber has been mounted on these two blocks. For one complete rotation of the gears, the total liner distance covered is twice the pitch of the thread.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 50: MINI HOIST
text:
Project: MINI HOIST
Participants: Aniket M. Anavkar; Apoorva V. Aathwale; Kirti L. Saka
Institution: Government polytechnic Pune
Abstract: This is the era of machines where number of activities found difficult by human beings are carried out efficiently by machines. Here we deal with a mini hoist used to lift loads which is a regular activity for numerous workshops, industries, etc. it is a useful machine tool for manufacturing and production operations. The need of such a machine tool arises from requirement of sufficient but small effort against heavy loads. The system uses a hoist drum with 12m long rope, a hook and pulley arrangement, 1440rpm motor, a gear train. The attractions of the system are "low effort – heavy load", minimum human efforts, time saving, single person operation, low installation cost. The hoist finds its applications in shops dealing with lifting gods, e.g. grocery shops, workshops and small industries, garages, civil operations, e.g. building construtions.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 51: ORBITAL CUTTING MACHINE
text:
Project: ORBITAL CUTTING MACHINE
Participants: Harsh B. Kansara; Shantanu S. Walavalkar; Nabil A. Solanki; Abhishek Waruskar
Institution: Thakur Polytechnic
Abstract: Orbital Cutting machine (O.C.M.) WORKING PRINCIPLE: the main principle of the O.C.M. is to cut the weld around the periphery of the pipe welded on a flange. A cutting tool is mounted on a ring gear which is driven with pinion gear with the help of a motor (air or electric). APPLICATION OF THE MODEL AND ADVANTAGE OVER EXISTING VERSION OF THE MODEL: The main working principle is cut orbital around the pipe with accuracy and precision. The advantage of this machine is that it can be clamped from any part of the pipe even with obstructions. IMPORTANT DESIGN ASPECTS: The main design aspects the clamping on which the elements of the O.C.M. is mounted. Also to clamp and unclamp the machine it is easy. Also with as far as future scope is concerned pipes it variable diameter can be clamped with the O.C.M. (with a range).

title: GIAN Nidhi record 52: Development of charting system for methods and analysis
text:
Project: Development of charting system for methods and analysis
Participants: Anjali R. Dhiware; Madhuri C. Pardhe; Mohini N. Sakpal; Jyoti B. Sonawane
Institution: Government polytechnic Mumbai
Abstract: Industrial engineering deals with increasing the productivity of business resources. The critical analysis of process, resources utilization can be done by recording the exiting facts using various charting techniques. The charts can be outline process chart, Flow process chart or two-handed process chart. Charting is observation + recording of facts. Number of times the initial observations may required modification also. The software developed CHARTSYS-1.0 is the fast creating and editing solution to the conventional manual charting method. The helpful of such parallel software are available in western and American countries. But still have many industrial engineering limitations and costly also. This software when fully developed can stand as the impart substitute for such software. The CHARTSYS-1.0 also has data bank and may pull down options to reduce 'keying' tasks.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 53: SHEET ROLLING MACHINE WITH BEEDING
text:
Project: SHEET ROLLING MACHINE WITH BEEDING
Participants: Shishendu S. Chakraborty; Anand S. Chamachi; Manoj M. Borde; Pradeep M. Borkar
Institution: Y.B. Patil Polytechnic, Akurdi, Pune - 44
Abstract: Forming sheet metal cylinders is an important activity for which "SHEET ROLLING MACHINE" is required. In its operation the sheet of metal to be formed is inserted from front of the machine and passes through the two front gripping rollers securing uniform pressure of rollers on material through pressure adjusting screw; so that sheet will ride through rolls freely. The sheet is passing through gripping rolls strikes the top or forming rolls, if adjusted properly it will form a circle. Raising or lowering of the adjustable forming roller will give different diameter of cylinder. Machine is power operated run by a motor that drives a worm gear box whose output shaft is connected to the gripping roller gear train. The pressure or forming roller is adjusted by means of pressure adjusting screws. Another feature is corporated in material is that of "BEEDING". In beeding operations, an semicircular groove is formed on the sheet metal that gives strength and stiffness to the sheet metal component formed. For beeding operation the male and female beeding rollers are fitten on the gripping rollers on the other side of gear train and the sheet metal to be beeded passed through the two rollers.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 54: WABIMAN Walking Biped Humanoid
text:
Project: WABIMAN Walking Biped Humanoid
Participants: Pooja Rajan Tanawade; Shweta Sanjay Panwalkar; Geetanjali Pramod
Institution: Premlila Vithaldas Polytechnic, SNDT Women's University
Institution as written in this record: Premlila Vithaldas Polytechnic S.N.D.T. Women's University
Abstract: WABIMAN Walking Biped Humanoid is a robot having LEGS. The inspiration of this project is a human being itself. Our goal is to develop biped humanoid robot that is capable of working stably in a human living and working space, with a focus on their physical construction and motion control. By observing the defects of the robots having wheels for locomotion this idea was popped up in our minds. The wheels can get stuck in the potholes or craters, thus it will create obstruction for completion of the desired task. If the robot is having legs, it will find its own way out of avoiding or overcoming an obstruction and it can complete the desired task in an estimated time. At the first stage, we have to develop a human like biped robot, WABIMAN (Walking Biped Humanoid) which has ten mechanical degrees of freedom. Its weight is 1 kg here a moment compensation method is described for stability, which is based on a pattern switching technique. By a combination of both methods, the biped robot is able to perform dynamic stamping, walking forward and backward in continuous time. Using WABIMAN human follow walking experiments are conducted and effectiveness of the modes are verified. This paper introduces various applications. Thus it can be called as multipurpose robot. The main purpose is that it can be used for military actions like knowing the positions of the enemies and also can be used to know the secrets about their plans and arms and ammunitions. It is used to study the geology of various corners of earth where human life does not exist. Also it is used to study the undiscovered regions of niverse.

Participants: Pooja Rajan Tanawade; Shweta Sanjay Panwalkar; Geetanjali Pramod
Institution: Premlila Vithaldas Polytechnic, SNDT Women's University
Institution as written in this record: Premlila Vithaldas Polytechnic S.N.D.T. Women's University
Abstract: WABIMAN Walking Biped Humanoid is a robot having LEGS. The inspiration of this project is a human being itself. Our goal is to develop biped humanoid robot that is capable of working stably in a human living and working space, with a focus on their physical construction and motion control. By observing the defects of the robots having wheels for locomotion this idea was popped up in our minds. The wheels can get stuck in the potholes or craters, thus it will create obstruction for completion of the desired task. If the robot is having legs, it will find its own way out of avoiding or overcoming an obstruction and it can complete the desired task in an estimated time. At the first stage, we have to develop a human like biped robot, WABIMAN (Walking Biped Humanoid) which has ten mechanical degrees of freedom. Its weight is 1 kg here a moment compensation method is described for stability, which is based on a pattern switching technique. By a combination of both methods, the biped robot is able to perform dynamic stamping, walking forward and backward in continuous time. Using WABIMAN human follow walking experiments are conducted and effectiveness of the modes are verified. This paper introduces various applications. Thus it can be called as multipurpose robot. The main purpose is that it can be used for military actions like knowing the positions of the enemies and also can be used to know the secrets about their plans and arms and ammunitions. It is used to study the geology of various corners of earth where human life does not exist. Also it is used to study the undiscovered regions of niverse.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 55: MANUALLY OPERATED STATOR WINDING MACHINE
text:
Project: MANUALLY OPERATED STATOR WINDING MACHINE
Participants: Tosif Iqbal Mulla; Abhinandan Shantinath Galatage; Harish Raghunath; Sagar Shankar Patekar
Institution: Walchand college of engineering, Sangli
Institution as written in this record: Walchand College of Engg. Sangli
Abstract: The Electrical stator winding machine is used for winding purpose. This machine consists of number of components. The machine is generally driven by electrical motor. This machine requires perfect setting of Stator before winding. It requires hours of human effort for its loading and unloading of Stator that is positioning the stator at exact location for each groove. This machine is power operated machine; hence it consumes much more electricity. As electric motor is used for running of whole unit, vibrations are generated. And there is great reduction in life of components due to vibrations. Also this machine has more cost. These machines are complicated in construction so maintenance cost is high. Accurate positioning of stator is time spending operation. So the attempt is made which eliminates all the difficulties and disadvantages. This device is applicable for both commercial and industrial fields. This is the manually operated stator winding machine. In this machine there are all the mechanical components so life of machine is longer. As this is manually operated machine, external source of power is totally eliminated. The time required for winding is also less. This device makes the winding at exact location in stator groove. There is no insertion of turns from outside; hence there is not any chance of loosening of wire turns in stator groove. This advantage makes the use of machine for Stator winding. The stator on which turns are prepared gives smooth working of fan. The cost of this device is less as compared to Electrical stator winding machine. The operation of counting the turns to be fitted in the grooves of stator can be eliminated by using digital electronic counter. For overcome difficulties in Electrical Stator winding machine i.e. setting of Stator, we use the Lead screw and screw jack mechanism.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 56: Fixture for croos-hole machining operation of center yoke
text:
Project: Fixture for croos-hole machining operation of center yoke
Participants: More Yogesh Sampat; Shirrsath Chetan Pandurang; Kothwade Bhushan
Institution: K. K. Wagh Polytechnic, Nashik
Institution as written in this record: K.K.Wagh Polytechnic, Nashik
Abstract: 'The name fixture is derived from the fact that it is always fastened to the machine in fixed osition'. As two operations are to be performed on a component at a same dimensions, that are drilling and boring. These two operations are performed on two different CNC machines of same centre heights ( 114.7mm). So, we develop two fixtures, one for drilling and one for boring, considering the specifications of machine as well as the specifications of component. While designing these fixtures the method of location and clamping is such that the idle time on machine is very minimum. We had made the arrangement of fixture for easy and quick loading and unloading of the component. In these fixtures there are no chances for the improper loading of component. The sufficient clearance is provided to hold the component easily and to pass out the swarf (fine chips). The fixture is sufficiently rigid to secure the preset accuracy of machining. There is very fine arrangement in fixture, so that removal of work piece is not obstructed by burr. Here the ejection of component is very easy. The fixture is very safe and convenient in use. Also we have to consider some parameters, which are not the part of the given drawing of the fixture. Sometimes some operations are critical one to perform the machining operation and critical to check the dimension with the measuring devices, at these situations we have to go for the operation, which are not the parts of fixture as far as drawing is concerned. While taking these type of decision of performing these unexpected operations, we have to take care that these operations will not affect the accuracy, function of fixture and the given parameters of the component with respect to fixture. The processes that are carried out on these fixtures while manufacturing are turning, milling, drilling, boring, tapping, heat treatment and grinding.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 57: Advanced abrasive cutting Machine.
text:
Project: Advanced abrasive cutting Machine.
Participants: Bhagavat Suraj Shrikant; Rathod Vipul Ramprasad
Institution: Amrutvahini Polytechnic, Sangamner
Institution as written in this record: Amrutvahini Polytechnic. Sangamner
Abstract: There are various types of cutter, which are used according to their requirement for the particular job. They are made from different material like CI, etc. But the abrasive disc cutter is the type of cutter made up of abrasive material. Our project is totally based on abrasive disc cutter & sliding motion of the motor slides on the disc plate in which the cutter is connected which reduces the manpower as in the older type cutters. There are two types of abrasives. 1) Natural abrasive: The natural abrasives contains certain types of impurities which reduce the cutting abilities & create non-uniformities in abrasive wheel.These impurities not only make difficulty in cutting action but also create non- uniformity in the wheel 2) Artificial abrasive : The artificial abrasive are man made , manufactured abrasive.They are manufagtured electro chemically.The main groups of artificial abrasives are aluminum-oxide (Al203) & silicon carbide(SiC) Here in this project we are using an artificial abrasive, which is suitable for a cutting purpose. In natural abrasives there are non uniformities but the wheels made from artificial abrasives are though so there occurs no problems in cutting. As the abrasives cutters were designed to cut in angular motion , we have designed our abrasives cutters on sliding motion. In this there is base plate on which the sliding motor with abrasive cutter & the holding system in which we can hold the job in any angle is fitted. The sliding motion of the cutter will reduce the man effort for cutting the job that was not is not possible in the cutter which is designed such as abrasive cutter in the angular motion. Here we can hold our job & turn in any angle we required to cut longitudinally.
