title: GIAN Nidhi record 58: Dhoop Stick Making Machine
text:
Project: Dhoop Stick Making Machine
Participants: Kamlesh V. Narnaware; Hrudainath P.Raut; Tushar P. Nagpure; Vivek
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Bramhapuri, Dist-Chandrapur
Abstract: The project name "Dhoop Stick Making Machine" works on principle of extrusion of materials. This machine can be used for production of various sticks of material required for various applications. The machine can be manually power operated by making slight orientation of driver. unit. The extruded units is having material transfer unit having the stages of automatic material dosing system & the screw feeder system, followed by the extrusion die. There after the rotary cutter disc, driven by 1/4HP motor can be used to cut the pieces of finished product. The machine is simple in construction , safer in operation easy for maintenance & repairs & having less cost. Such a machine is very useful a entrepreneurs, for setting a tiny industry. This enterprises can be established in rural areas & it dose not require a highly skilled personnel. For self employment to start business this machine is very useful. By replacing the extrusion die & by attaching an elbow & noodles making dies. The machine can be used for noodles or other similar food products. Thereby this project is very useful for small scale /tiny industry.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 60: Fiber glass reinforced plastic cutting machine.
text:
Project: Fiber glass reinforced plastic cutting machine.
Participants: Shinde Amit; Yargitkar Prasad; Pathak Rohan; Ravi Prashant
Institution: All India Shri Shivaji Memorial Society's Polytechnic
Abstract: Fiber glass reinforced plastic cutting machine is specially designed for cutting of fiber component. Understanding the problems & defects occurred during cutting operation of fiber component by machine having a better surface finish & uniformity. The component if is cut by hand or manually by using cutting frame it requires more time & lead to less productivity. To avoid such problems a special purpose machine is designed. The machine consist of a motor, base, table, cutter, & a reciprocating mechanism The tongue obtained from motor is transmitted to reciprocate mechanism which gives motion to the cutter. Thus the cutter reciprocate & operation is performed by feeding up the work price

title: GIAN Nidhi record 63: ELIMINATING NONPRODUCTIVE TROLLEY MOVEMENT ON THE SHOFP FLOOR BY ADOPTING SYNCHRONISED HANGER.
text:
Project: ELIMINATING NONPRODUCTIVE TROLLEY MOVEMENT ON THE SHOFP FLOOR BY ADOPTING SYNCHRONISED HANGER.
Participants: Sachin Pandurang Ingle; Vikas Shivaji Matkar; Jitesh Gajananrao; S. K. Khan
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Washim
Abstract: Its absolutely a new idea and can bring revolution in manufacturing organization. This concept is basically applied to manufacturing firms which are engaged in assembly line example. Automobile industries, Electronic industries, etc. While making assembly we need inventory. Inventories are brought to the assembly line by martial handling device mainly manual trolleys. Large manufacturing organization like Bajaj Auto, Hero – Honda, Tata motors, etc. required lot of space for this trolleys. Our focus is to eliminate this non-productive activity of trolley movement on the shop floor. What we are suggesting is the overhanding hander maximum possible inventory for each final product. These hanger are suppose to be ergonomically designed. These hangers are attached to overhead belt that would carry inventory needed for finish product. This hanger movement is synchronized with assembly line main belt movement.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 64: Tricycle Fitted With Windmill Reducing Effort Of Pedallers
text:
Project: Tricycle Fitted With Windmill Reducing Effort Of Pedallers
Participants: Vinayak Yeshwant; Vikas Narayan Landge; Nilesh Nivrutti
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Miraj
Abstract: Today tricycle are being looked at as a popular and cheap form of transport. It does not require any fuel and therefore it is environmental friendly. The use of tricycle is now a very common features in villages, towns & cities to carry Gods, LPG Cylinders as well as Passangers. The conventional tricycles require more human effort it becomes very difficult for the pedallar to pull the tricycle on the steep. The effort of the pedallar are reduced with the help of this modified tricycle. In this project we have used wind energy to pull a tricycle having an additional attachment of vertical axis wind mill with Bevel gear to convert wind energy into mechanical movement of a tricycle. It consists two horizontal shaft front and rear shaft. On the front shaft which receives as a rotation from the wind mill through a pair of bevel gears. Sprocket is mounted on front shaft which transmit power to rear shaft by a chain driver. The another driver from pedals to rear shaft. The lever is attached to shaft of wind mill to engage or disengage gears by up and down motion. In conventional tricycle the riders pedaling effort are transmitted to rear wheel shaft through a Sprocket-chain drive and tricycle move forward. But in tricycle fitted with wind mill the rotation of wind mill is transmitted first to the front shaft through a pair of bevel gear enclosed in box and then to rear shaft through Sprocket-chain drive. in case of starting tricycle it is pedaled to give initial starting torque prior to transmitting the power from the wind mill. The lever pressed in downward direction then gear is engaged hence once tricycle gained momentum. The wind mill starts rotating due to displacement of air.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 65: Novel Coupling
text:
Project: Novel Coupling
Participants: Sudhir Chandrakant Maid; Jayant Ashokrao Lasinkar; Rahul Dwarkadas; Abhijit Purushottam Parsewar
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Nanded
Institution as written in this record: Government Polytechnic, Nanded
Abstract: There are various types of couplings available to transmit the power from one shaft to another broadly classified in two categories, one for transmit power between line shaft & another for offset shaft. For various offset distances, novel coupling is best suitable for joining two shafts. Novel coupling can be used for in line as well as offset shafts while working in loading condition. In this coupling, there are 3 discs connected by means of flexible novel linkages, parallel link connections between disks exactly duplicate motion input & output shafts. This is basic new principle used in coupling. This is no sliding part hence efficiency is high connection of links to discs can be done with the help of bearings so frictional losses are reduced a lot. Applications of this novel coupling in automobiles marine, machine tool & rolling mill machinery.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 66: Betel Nut cutting machine
text:
Project: Betel Nut cutting machine
Participants: Swapnil Govind Kulkarni; Dinehs Mohan Zunjarrao; Atul Madhukar Khairnar
Institution: Government polytechnic, Dhule
Institution as written in this record: Government Polytechnic, Dhule
Abstract: The main object of this project undertaken is cutting of betel into regular shapes. One of the major problems in industry is to cut betel nut into various forms and by various methods. For this purpose two different machines are used in industries. In the above two machine, the first machine is used to cut the betel in two pieces and the second machine is used to cut the previous two pieces of betel nut into various small pieces. But the use of two different machines is not economical nad more time consuming. Hence to overcome this problem, we have designed the machine which is used to cut betel in single stroke with required size. Therefore use of this betel-cutting machine increases the productivity at least running cost with least effort.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 67: Metal cutting using E.A.S.E.M. Technology
text:
Project: Metal cutting using E.A.S.E.M. Technology
Participants: Ankit Padhey; Deepika Vhanmarate; Nikhil Kharode; Nikhil Kale
Institution: G. H. Raisoni polytechnic, Nagpur
Institution as written in this record: G. H. Raisoni Polytechnic, Nagpur
Abstract: Working in areas where the metal cutting is done carries heavy risk. Many safety precautions have to be followed. When the metal sheets are cutted the small, fine filings of metals which are very sharp. This can injure the workers. So special uniforms like footwear's eye gears & helmets are provided to the workers while working in such areas. These are very uncomfortable to the workers. Our project " Metal Cutting using E.A.S.E.M. Technology" has focused on the development of microwave cutters that dose not require more power for cutting the metal sheets and does not produce any type of noise. The project team has designed and builds a prototype microwave cutter machine to cut the metal samples. These samples show a significant increase in wear performance. In this technology the electrons at a very high velocity of 3*10^ 8 m/sec emitted from magnetron when strikes on the metal sheet the bonding of metal sheet gets broken and hence the metal sheet is cutted into parts.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 68: Ball Screw Cross Slide for Conventional Lathe
text:
Project: Ball Screw Cross Slide for Conventional Lathe
Participants: Mandar Sanjay Arwade; Abhishek Chandrakant Mahajan; Swapnil Shamrao Lohar
Institution: New Polytechnic, Kolhapur
Abstract: Most of the jobs machined on lathes are having coarse folerance on longitudinal axis but a fine folerance on transverse axis. Today, the conventional lathes are having sliding lead screws on both long and transverse (cross) lead screw with the ball screw. This gives 1. Increased accuracy and pre 2. Increased production rate. 3. Increased Productivity 4. Less tatigue to worker 5. Reduced on line inspection. 6. User friendliness. The only disadvantage is the higher cost of the ball screw. But this is over weighted by the above mentioned advantages. As such, this project is an endeavour to bridge the gap between the conventional lathe and a CNC lathe.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 69: VIBRATION BASED DIESEL FILTER CLEANER
text:
Project: VIBRATION BASED DIESEL FILTER CLEANER
Participants: Kiran Tukaram Devkar; Anil Balu Bute; Nilesh Sampatrao Devkar; Chandrabhan Jalinder Mule; Milind Suryabhan Game
Institution: K.B.P. Polytechnic, Kopargaon
Institution as written in this record: K. B.P. POLYTECHNIC KOPERGAON
Abstract: Working principle of our project is rotary motion is converted into oscillating motion. And oscillating motion is converted in to vibrating motion. First motor is rotated at a speed of 1440 rpm also same pulley is mounted on vertical shaft. Due to electric supply motor is rotated & power of motor is transmitted to vertical shaft through v-belt. Because of axis of motor and axis of vertical shaft is parallel to each other. Due to this arrangement vertical shaft rotate and produce oscillation. Oscillation are produced because of unbalanced weight provided at both the end of shaft. Oscillation produced are transfer to bearing housing. Bearing housing to flange in between flange & bearing housing ball bearing are provided therefore only oscillating motion is converted into vibration through suspension. Top of suspension & frame fuel tank are attached in this tank fuel is filled and filter are dipped in tank. Due to vibration fuel tank also vibrate because of vibration of fuel tank filter are cleaned.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 74: AGRO SEED FLOW CONTROLLER
text:

Participants: Grishma V. Devatar; Krishna B. Bhavsar; Bhranti B. Mehta; Komal V. Modi
Institution: Premlila Vithaldas Polytechnic, SNDT Women's University
Abstract: Agro seed flow controller is an electronic machine to plant seed. This machine helps to control t flow of seed while planting. The distance between two seeds can be varied and controlled. The micro controller will adjust the seed rate based on the tractor ground speed. The rate will be adjusted to match to preset plant population allowing a great efficiency when planting.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 79: COMPACT THRESHER
text:
Project: COMPACT THRESHER
Participants: Vismay V. Panchal; shantanu Kulkarni; Shailesh Mhatre; Alpesh Rawal
Institution: Thakur Polytechnic, Thakur complex, Kandiwali (east)
Abstract: Our project is basically based on crope harvesting. The size of project is compact. So it is cheaper in rate. It can be easily manufactured using the semi skill worker. It is a general purpose machine. It can be transported anywhere in bulk. Harvested crop is loaded onto the tray and fed into the opening between the cylinder and the concave at one end of the machine. The pegs on the threshing cylinder hit the material separating the grain from the straw, and at the same time accelerating them around the cylinder. The majority of the grain is threshed during initial impact but further threshing is performed as the material moves axially until the straw is discharge at the opposite end.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 90: Maglev – A Train without Motors
text:
Project: Maglev – A Train without Motors
Participants: Ashish Parmar; Monik Shah; Sameer Lotalikar
Institution: Shri Bhavubhai Mafatlal Polytechnic, Mumbai
Abstract: Magnetic Levitation train works on the principle of repulsion of magnets. Permanent Magnets having North and South poles are placed below the train, side by side in a row. Similarly, coils are placed in a row over the entire length of the track. The driver IC BA6435 gives the supply to the coils. The Hall ICs are placed between the coils at certain intervals. It senses the polarity of the magnet over it. When power is switched ON, the Hall ICs senses the polarity of the respective magnets of the train over them and provides the corresponding signal to the driver IC. Accordingly, the driver IC gives the control signal to the coils to create the same polarity of the magnetic field in the coils below the train so that the train is repelled and moves ahead. Now the next magnet of the train having an opposite polarity will come over the Hall IC. The Hall IC will detect this change and will give the corresponding feedback to the driver IC and the entire procedure repeats.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 108: Experimental Investigation of partial replacement of concrete below neutral axis of S.S. Beam
text:
Project: Experimental Investigation of partial replacement of concrete below neutral axis of S.S. Beam
Participants: (not listed)
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Reinforced cement concrete is one of the important component in the construction industry. Now a days the use of concrete increased very much. There is acute shortage of raw materials for its preparation. An alternate method of replacing the zone below the neutral axis with inert weightless substances like hollow pipe will not greatly affect the strength and stress characteristics of the beam. Also it will not affect the geometry and shape. In this studies on partial replacement of concrete below the neutral axis by creating hollow cavity. In this experiment attempt is being made to reduce weight and cost of the reinforced concrete structures by replacing the concrete below the neutral axis. However, in RC beams strength of concrete laying below the neutral axis is not fully utilized. So this un-utilized concrete is removed by placing a PVC pipe instead, hence making the beam hollow below the neutral axis. This is an alternative to reduce the use of concrete. The concrete just above neutral axis is less stressed whereas the concrete below the neutral axis serves as a shear transmitting media. The bond between PVC pipe and concrete layers at the pipe concrete interface should essentially be very good. It should be ensured that no slip will occur between the two layers. Experimental work is carried on the reinforced concrete beams with hollow cavity below neutral axis, So a cheap and light material can be used below the neutral axis. Sustainability can be achieved by replacing the partially used concrete. By saving concrete, we can save cement, which reduces the greenhouse gases emissions. So it is considered as environment friendly. Behavior of PVC pipe in filled reinforced concrete beams under 4 point flexure is find out experimentally and the results are compared with the conventional reinforced concrete beam and it is observed that saving of concrete is achieved.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 109: Distillation by Solar Still.
text:
Project: Distillation by Solar Still.
Participants: (not listed)
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Solar Still is impactful method for getting potable water from ground water/ brackish/wastewater in hot climatic condition and/or remote area where is the scarcity of water as well as for electricity. In recent years, attention has been focused on development of various designs of solar still in order to overcome limitations possesses by conventional single basin single slope solar still. Pyramid solar still is one of the outcomes of such a development. In this experimental setup the development in the field of pyramid solar still as well as the various techniques to improve the performance of still. From various researchers, it has been found that pyramid solar still is more efficient and economical in compare to conventional single slope single basin still. Due to environmental issues and limited fossil fuel resources, more and more attention is being given to renewable energy sources solar energy has been strongly promoted as a viable energy source. One of the simplest and most direct applications of this energy is the convergence of solar radiation into heat. A solar still is commonly used device for water purification and it doesn't require any electricity for distillation of water. In a solar still, water is evaporated using solar energy which is a form of renewable energy and collected as a distillate water after condensation of the vapour. This method can produce distilled water after removal of impurities. Thus this Project helps us to find the requirement of pure drinking water to all people, judicious use of available water sources with suitable low cost purification techniques. The energy of the solar radiation is in this case converted to heat with the use of solar panel. title: GIAN Nidhi record 110: Control of Hydraulic Jump using Hump and study Dissolved Oxygen in Jump
text:
Project: Control of Hydraulic Jump using Hump and study Dissolved Oxygen in Jump
Participants: (not listed)
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: A hydraulic jump is a phenomenon which has extensively been studied in the field of hydraulic engineering due to its frequent occurrence in open channel flow such as rivers and spillways. Hydraulic jump is a transition of super-critical to sub-critical with considerable energy dissipation. It is the easiest way for mixing oxygen from environment into any fluvial system (water) without major cost and difficulty. Due to its numerous practical applications, hydraulic jump is an interesting topic that has caught the imagination of many researchers since 18th century to till today. The researchers had done laboratory experiments to develop empirical relations for universal applications, experimental study for characteristics of jump, location of jump and control of jump using weir and other different appurtenances. However to the author's best knowledge no one had given any concluding remark to control the jump using abrupt rise in the bed of the open channel. This is the main motivation for the present study in which experimental investigations have been done to control the hydraulic jump by providing the abrupt rise (hump) at the bed of rectangular open channel (laboratory flume) and also improves the 'Dissolved Oxygen (DO)' content of the same fluvial system (water). To accomplish the aim, various types of humps were designed and fabricated based on the critical velocity analysis based on maximum discharge condition in laboratory flume

title: GIAN Nidhi record 112: Assessment of Groundwater Quality for Potability in and around Waluj MIDC, District Aurangabad using GIS
text:
Project: Assessment of Groundwater Quality for Potability in and around Waluj MIDC, District Aurangabad using GIS
Participants: (not listed)
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Groundwater contamination is one of the significant problems in India. Aurangabad region is an example of an area where the groundwater is contaminated as a result of infiltration of waste water in river and streams adjacent to industrial area. Such contamination poses significant environmental threats for the surrounding environment and groundwater. There are three main sources of river and groundwater pollution in study area which includes domestic waste disposal activities, Industrial effluent disposal, leaks and non point source activities such as agricultural management practices Total generation of sewage in Aurangabad city is 107 MLD. Total quantity of industrial effluent generated from Waluj MIDC area is 10.72 MLD and total domestic effluent generated is 3.928 MLD. (Aurangabad MPCB report -2014). Therefore water quality monitoring is necessary in Aurangabad urban area, There are possibilities of leakage, seepages, spillages from very old ETPs. Aurangabad is one of the critically polluted industrial cluster identified by CPCB and its CEPI score is 77.44. This critically polluted industrial cluster needs further detailed study in terms of the extent of damage and formulation of appropriate remedial action plan. This study will examines the effect of anthropogenic contamination on the quality of groundwater particularly in Waluj MIDC area in Aurangabad City, Aurangabad is the fastest industrial developing city in Marathwada. In order to evaluate the quality of groundwater in study area, 350 bore-well water samples spread over an area 1520 hectares in Waluj MIDC of Aurangabad city are selected to analyze for drinking water quality standards to find out the level of pollutant and their responsible factors.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 113: Policy Assessment Tool Of Rural Drinking Water Supply Schemes At Village Level
text:
Project: Policy Assessment Tool Of Rural Drinking Water Supply Schemes At Village Level
Participants: (not listed)
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Water is the basic essential need of human life. However, whether the drinking water assessment is being properly carried out is a question of issue. According to survey and data studies it has been noted that drinking Water Security has become a challenge for the country, specifically in rural areas. With ever growing population, demand is bound to grow and in recent times climate change has aggravated the problem more. Recognizing the gravity of the situation and considering the "common pool resource" nature of water, governments havestepped in to ensure the drinking water security to their subjects. This has led to evolution of policies and several paradigms shifts in policy formulation. One of them is from 'supply driven to demand driven'. But our own experience and stated by many others; suggests that there is always a huge gap between policy and implementation. This gap is mainly due to absence of regular Assessment, Evaluation and Monitoring in current practice.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 114: Analysis of heat transfer through aluminum fins.
text:
Project: Analysis of heat transfer through aluminum fins.
Participants: 1.Jiwanwal Abhijeet 2. Joshi Shubham
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: The main aim of this project is to design an actual cylinder block using Solidworks and then performing thermal analysis on the engine block using ANSYS to check the rate of heat transfer through the actual engine. Thereby changing the material and by making slight changes in the geometry of the fins and engine block we will introduce the new geometry of the product and then by performing the thermal analysis work we will be comparing the rate of heat transfer between different geometries. After this, by performing the CFD analysis on the cylinder block we will be checking the motion of air at different velocities on the fins of an engine and by merging the result of the thermal analysis in the CFD we will be calculating the rate of heat transfer due to convection. And due to this project the heat transfer rate will increase and also fuel will be used economically and finally the performance of the engine will be enhanced thereby giving benefits to the consumer.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 116: Performance enhancement of Domestic Refrigerator
text:
Project: Performance enhancement of Domestic Refrigerator
Participants: Shaikh Sameer; Shaikh Yunus; Shaikh Nawaj; Shaikh Musavir
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Increasing the Coefficient of Performance is very essential due to energy crisis and there exists a vast scope in domestic refrigerator system. In this study a combination of air cooled and shell and coil heat exchanger for domestic refrigerator is studied numerically. For obtaining higher COP we have to cool down refrigerant below sub cooled region. This can be achieved by use of this heat exchanger to great extent. Designed heat exchanger permits large heat transfer by providing more heat transfer area. The objective of this project work to investigate numerically the effect of water-cooled condenser in a household refrigerator. The study will be done using HFC134a as the refrigerant and Polyol-ester oil (POE) oil as the lubricant. The performance of the household refrigerator with air-cooled and water-cooled condenser will be compared with the same set of conditions for both the set-ups numerically. The water cooled and air cooled condensers are designed on ANSYS workbench and subjected to the same pressure and temperature conditions. The results obtained from the study show increased COP, and efficient performance. Furthermore, the hot water obtained from water cooled condenser could be used for domestic purposes.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 117: Design & Fabrication of paddle operated water pump
text:
Project: Design & Fabrication of paddle operated water pump
Participants: Badgire Dhananjay; Pathak Omkar; Shejul Sanket; Dhamale Nilesh
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Pedal operated water pump will consist of a centrifugal pump operated by pedal power. The centrifugal pump is positioned on its stand in such a way that driven shaft of the centrifugal pump was welded to the bicycle sprocket . By pedaling the bicycle, the bicycle sprocket rotates, thereby rotating the centrifugal pump which in turns discharges water from the sump Pedal operated water pump provides lifting of water and irrigation in remote areas where electricity is not available. Pedal operated water pump is not only free from pollution but also provide healthy exercise. Pedal operated water pump reduces the rising energy costs. Pedal operated water pump will design as a portable one which can be use for irrigation in various place. Main aim of this work is to design, fabricate, investigate the working of pedal operated water pump (powp) which is used to lift water up to 20 feet to 30 feet height. Powp is used to lift water from sump to water tank in city when there is no electric power supply or load shedding. Powp main part is centrifugal pump which is operated by pedal power. The centrifugal pump is placed in such a way that driven shaft of the centrifugal pump is same shaft of pulley which is driven bicycle wheel. When pedaling is done, then bicycle wheel start rotating, so pulley will rotate and therefore rotating the centrifugal pump which will lift water from sump to 20 feet to 30 feet. Powp is used in irrigation in remote areas where there is no electricity. Using powp we can save energy and no pollution. Powp pump can used for exercise purpose also.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 119: Design and fabrication Eco friendly sprayers.
text:
Project: Design and fabrication Eco friendly sprayers.
Participants: SHREEKRUSHAN PATIL; SWAPNIL PAWAR; VAIBHAV JADHAV; SACHIN RAUT
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: To overcome the disadvantages related with previous model, we have designed a model running without any fuel and also easy to operate for a user. In this model we find that we have simply used a sprocket mounted on shaft which will actuate piston inside cylinder. The assembly consists of wheel on which sprocket is mounted on axle. Eco-friendly Sprayer Vehicle is project designed to reduce human efforts which is required operating sprayer pump during spraying pesticides. Also the project is designed to save budget expenditure which is required to be spending on fuels (petrol, diesel, etc.) for driving an engine of sprayer equipment. The most important goal of our project is in the application of agricultural pesticides is to get uniform distribution of the chemicals throughout the crop foliage. Under dosing may not give the desired coverage and control needed. Overdosing is expensive as it wastes pesticide and increases the potential for groundwater contamination and spraying is also time consuming. So prevent this we are going to prepare Eco-Friendly Sprayer.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 120: Design and fabrication Multi-purpose Agri-culture machine
text:
Project: Design and fabrication Multi-purpose Agri-culture machine
Participants: DUKARE GAJANAN; YOGESH JADHAV; YOGESH GAWANDE; ABHIJEET KULKARNI
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: India is an agriculture-based country in which, 70% of people depends on the outcome of farming. Agriculture is the backbone of India. So, for fulfilling the future demands there is need of advancement in techniques and equipment's of farming at economic cost because in India every farmer can't afford tractor and other excessive cost sowing equipment's. Seed sowing, and fertilizer placement is the main activity in farming. In India, two types of agricultural equipment's are used, manual method (conventional method) and mechanized type. Mechanization involves the use of a hybrid device between the power source and the work. This hybrid device usually transfers motion, such as rotary to linear, or provides ample of mechanical advantages such as increase or decrease or leverage of velocity. The entire history of agriculture contains many examples of the use of tools, such as the hoe and the plough. But the ongoing integration of machines since the Industrial Revolution has allowed farming to become much less labor intensive. The biggest profit of automation is that it saves the labour. However, it also saves energy and materials and to improve the quality, accuracy, and precision

title: GIAN Nidhi record 121: Evaluation of mechanical properties of bio composite laminates
text:
Project: Evaluation of mechanical properties of bio composite laminates
Participants: Chandwade Balasaheb; Shinde Nikita; Pale Saurabh; Abhijeet Khodwe
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Recently, there has been a rapid growth in research and innovation in the natural fiber composite (NFC) area. Interest is warranted due to the advantages of these materials compared to others, such as synthetic fibre composites, including low environmental impact and low cost and support their potential across a wide range of applications. Much effort has gone into increasing their mechanical performance to extend the capabilities and applications of this group of materials. This review aims to provide an overview of the factors that affect the mechanical performance of NFCs and details achievements made with them and number of biological materials may be incorporated into polymer materials. In recent years, there has been a marked increase in interest in biodegradable bio-composite material for use in packaging, agriculture, medicine, and other areas. The belief is that polymer bio-composite materials will reduce the need for synthetic polymer production (thus reducing pollution) at a low cost, thereby producing a positive effect both environmentally and economically. This review is intended to provide a brief outline of work that is under way in the area of polymer biocomposite research and development, the scientific theory behind these materials, areas in which this research is being applied, and future work that awaits

title: GIAN Nidhi record 122: Design & Fabrication of Sugar cane lifter.
text:
Project: Design & Fabrication of Sugar cane lifter.
Participants: Chinmay Deshmukh; Balaji Gapat; Shivraj Deshmukh; Chaitanya Watane
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: In today's world of competition, there is need of faster rate production of agricultural products as the agriculture is a backbone of India; farmers are facing problems of labor shortage. Therefore, there is a need of mechanization in the Indian sector as the agriculture sector is still dependent on labors and hence it is labor intensive. Most of the machinery used in Indian sugar mills, particularly those of Uttar Pradesh and Bihar is old and obsolete, being 50-60 years old and needs rehabilitation. But low margin of profit prevents several mill owners from replacing the old machinery by the new one. We have manufactured a sugarcane loader which is compact in size and low in cost. The loader has lifting height up to 7 feet. It has maximum loading capacity of 50 kg at single finger. The total number of fingers is four so it can lift total 80 kg at one single stoke. The time taken to complete one stroke is 20 seconds.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 133: Inventory Management System
text:
Project: Inventory Management System
Participants: Shubham S. More; Nilay A. Ingle; Gajendra s. Patke; Shyam Pradhan
Institution: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Polytechnic, Amravati
Institution as written in this record: Panjabrao Deshmukh Polytechnic, Amaravati
Abstract: There is no sense of using traditional manual inventory system. The manual record keeping, stock maintenance, decision making, handling large data in journals, etc. so to overcome this stress and problem we have present the Advance solution that is Inventory Management System Software. It is capable of doing all tasks effectively and very fluently. We are presenting the system which overcomes traditional systems and having at most future scope. This software is made using Java programming language and SQL language. There is no need of maintaining journals. Each and every information is safely stored here and can be accessible within seconds while traditional systems takes too much time to find particular record. Using this system we can easily store and retrieve information of each different item having different attributes. With the unique auto generated Item Number it is easy for numbering the items and provides facility of storing more than 10 attributes of item so it is very easy to distinguish all the similar nature items efficiently. This system has inbuilt User management sub-module that is capable of managing necessary information about users in very effective manner. If we want to purchase some inventory products for that all the information is available here as Vendor Master. Vendor Master provides necessary information of vendors. title: GIAN Nidhi record 134: Mobile – Based Attendance System
text:
Project: Mobile – Based Attendance System
Participants: Shubham S. More
Institution: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Polytechnic, Amravati
Abstract: Our project aims in implementing software that will help lecturers to take the attendance of students using mobile/Smartphone. Lecturer would just open the app and they will take attendance using mobile phone. After this the attendance records will be saved in the online server-based database. Lecturer will be able to retake attendance by taking the attendance again for the same day and overwrite previous one or just edit up the previously taken attendance. Will have functions to generate and store reports and view students detained according to till date attendance. These days' lecturers in universities and colleges take the attendance manually either by calling out individual's name or by passing around an attendance sheet for student's signature to confirm his/her presence. Using these methods is both cumbersome and time-consuming. This project is based on Android/Java Technology. Teachers can login into their attendance account to access their databases. Teachers can add new Branches / Classes and Subjects and the students in the database. Teachers can take attendances on daily basis. Teachers can view any previously taken attendance of any date. Teachers can view statistical data i.e. they can view the statistics of attendance taken till date or between a selected date range. Teachers can also view the list of students detained till date or between a selected date range and can also export that list into a text file. Teacher also have option to generate reports which contain all the attendance data in table form i.e. into an excel report. The main aim behind making this project is to overcome the difficulties or disadvantages and difficulties faced in the current manual, register – based attendance system and make a small application to help teachers do all the attendance work efficiently and easy which will save the manual work needed in previous manual attendance system.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 135: Advanced power factor correction
text:
Project: Advanced power factor correction
Participants: Injulkar Prakash Ragunath; Methe Amol Prakash; Haval Vaijayanti Deepak; Shah Kuntal Rajendra; Mulla Jilani Mustak
Institution: P. V. P. I. T., Sangali
Abstract: Power factor is ratio between the useful (true) power (kW to the total (apparent) power (kVA) consumed by an item of AC electrical equipment or a complete electrical installation. It is measure how efficiently electrical power is converted in useful work output. A poor power factor usually the result of a significant phase difference between the voltage & current power factor correction can be expressed in two ways. Power Factor (PF) = useful power (kW) divided by the total power (kVA) OR Power Factor (PF) = the cosine of the angle between the useful power & total power. CosO The power factor correction is achieved by addition capacitor in parallel with the load & can be applied at the equipment, distribution board or at origin of the installation. Static power factor correction it can be applied at each individual motor by connecting the correction capacitors to the motor starter. Static PFC must not be applied at the output of variable speed drive, solid state soft starter inverter as the capacitor can cause serious damage to electrical components.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 136: Electric Motorcycle
text:
Project: Electric Motorcycle
Participants: S.K.Shashanka; Anurag S.Suryawanshi; Praveen P. Satyam
Institution: Pillai Polytechnic (New Panvel)
Abstract: The motorcycle will run on simple law of transmission of power from one shaft to another with the means of belt drive. The engine will be replaced by a half horse power D.C. motor, the driver pulley will be connected to the motor shaft and the driven pulley will be connected to the crank shaft (engine shaft). All other riding operations will be similar to a four geared manual transmission motorcycle.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 138: Positional Control System (PCS) using Microcontroller based stepper motor.
text:
Project: Positional Control System (PCS) using Microcontroller based stepper motor.
Participants: Nilesh M. Wadile; Satyajeet R. Kapadane; Rekha P. Thorat; Girish d. Bramhe
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Nashik
Institution as written in this record: Govt. Polytechnic, Nasik
Abstract: Control System plays an important role in development of science and technology. Hence control system may be define as an system whose o/p can be controlled. System is an arrangement of various componant in order to perform a specific task. The stepper motor is special type of synchronous motor electrical pulse, received from its control unit. In above project the use of micro controller at 89651 precise step control or position control is possible. The stepper motor receives the command from micro controller to turn a shaft to specific angle. The advantage is its compatibility with digital system. No sensors are needed for position and speed.

With ever increasing population the emand of goods has also been increasing, same is in the case for electrical energy where the demand is increasing and the generation is not capable for meeting the required demand. Today fossil fuels supply most of the energy consumed like Oil 40%, Natural Gas 22.5%, Coal 23.3%, Hydro-electric 7.0% etc. which are in the verge of extinct. So we have decided to make such kind of project which is optimally utilizing the non-conventional sources which is the future of electrical energy. Each non-conventional source has it's own limitations which can be overcome by the combination of two or more non-conventional sources i.e. HYBRID So in this project we use two sources, Solar panel and Wind turbine to charge the battery.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 140: PC-BASED ENERGY METER
text:
Project: PC-BASED ENERGY METER
Participants: Kamble Anjali Shivajirao; Joshi Amruta Bhaskar; Khan Tarana Taher
Institution: Govt.Residential Women's Polytechnic Latur
Abstract: Analog devices offers an extensive range of metering Ics to serve various needs. Here is an energy meter using analog devices ADE 7757 chip for single phase, 2 wire (phase and neutral) systems used in households. EC ADE 7757 is a low cost single chip solution for electrical energy measurement. Consumer uses energy meter to count the consumption of electricity, so we are measuring current flowing through the number of loads connected in premises. Normally electronic circuits are working with help of shunt resister voltage drop across that resister in propotional flowing through it. Analog to digital converter digital to frequency converter. Analog signal representing current or consumption of electricity is to be converted to digital form using ADC. We get digital data on output on ADC, but consumption is a continuous process & time dependent & we have to count. Thus to convert this digital data to frequency a special IC ADE 7757 does both this process.

Abstract: Now todays world people are very familiar with electronics equipment and also enjoy it. Because of this more need of electricity is required. title: GIAN Nidhi record 142: Digital remote speed control of A.C. motor,
text:
Project: Digital remote speed control of A.C. motor,
Participants: Kottawar Neha B; Chavan Surekha D; Pingalkar Deepali; S.More Sujata
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Nanded
Abstract: The given system "Digital Remote A.C. Motor controller with frequency indicator" provides digital speed Control based on phase control to minimize power loss in vtg. Control by resistive attenuator. It offer soft touch Menu & remote digital control. Here speed control is displayed digitally ever a segment display, alone with speed control this system provide over/under vtg. Protection to A.C. motor varies with variation of supply frequency. Stator vtg & motor resistance. As here phase control technique is used for speed control, frequency should not change & for montoring this confirming of constant frequency a supply frequency indicator is designed basically this system has 3 main section viz speed control section, protection section & frequency indicator, speed control unit operates on IR principals There is as IRT ransmitter Each pulse from transmitter changes firing angle of powder Device used for controller. It is designed for 8 controller stages. Protection ckt. Cut of the wholesystem for over/under voltage. I.e. above 240 V & below 160 v. frequency indicator monitors supply frequency. Entire ckt operates on +5V, +9V & +12 V DC Supply.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 143: Controlling of electrical gadgets using cell phone.
text:
Project: Controlling of electrical gadgets using cell phone.
Participants: Krunal Jagdish Gajjar; Shrikant Rangnath Gangurde
Institution: Shri. H.H.J.B. Polytechnic, Chandwad
Abstract: Here is a controlling circuit, which enables switching "ON" & "OFF" appliances to telephone lines. It can be used to switch appliances from any distance, overcoming the limited range of infrared & radio remote controls. The circuit describe here can be used to switch up to 9 appliances. The DTMF signals on telephone instrument are used as control signals. The digit '0' in DTMF mode is used to toggle between the appliance mode & normal telephone operation mode. Thus the telephone can be used to switch "ON"or "OFF" the appliances also while being used for normal conversation. The circuit uses IC CM 8870P (DTMF to BCD converter.) AS 746 (4 to 16 line demultiplexer) & five CD 4013 (D-flip) Ics Once a call is established the ring detector circuit detects the ring and places 220 loops across the telephone line by energizing relay 1 (RL1). After that dial any number (0 to 9) on the keyboard. For consideration supose key 1 is pressed IC (CM8870P) decodes this as 0001 which is further demultiplexed by IC 2 as o/p 01 (ATPIN 2) off IC s. AS746. This active low output of IC 2 after inversion by an inverter gate of IC 3 (CD4049) becomes logic 1. This pulse toggles the corresponding flip-flop to alternate state. The flip-flop output is used to drive a relay (RL2) which can switch 'ON' or 'OFF' the appliances connected through it's contacts. The ring detector circuit is 'on' for some time after this the circuit is automatically switched off and removes the 220 ohms loop from telephone line. This is same as placing handset on the receiver. Therefore it cuts off the call and save the users money.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 144: Speed Control of Sky Bus using Microcontroller
text:
Project: Speed Control of Sky Bus using Microcontroller
Participants: Kamble Varsha S; Pardeshi Arti V; Pagire Chaitali R; Savekar Vijaya; Sambare Priyanka
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Ahmednagar
Abstract: In our project we use ropes as a tracks, for bus. LEDS & IR sensors are placed on the rope in front of each other. When LED is exited by current it will emits the light of particular wavelength continuously, then IR sensor of matched wavelength senses this light and gives this pulse to micro-controller. When bogie comes in between path of light, IR sensor fails to sense light and this pulse is also given to micro Controller. Then micro controller provides required voltage of appropriate amplitude to motor. In this manner speed of bus will be controlled. Facilites like onstacle detetor and fire detector are also provided to avoid accidents.

Abstract: In our project we use ropes as a tracks, for bus. LEDS & IR sensors are placed on the rope in front of each other. When LED is exited by current it will emits the light of particular wavelength continuously, then IR sensor of matched wavelength senses this light and gives this pulse to micro-controller. When bogie comes in between path of light, IR sensor fails to sense light and this pulse is also given to micro Controller. Then micro controller provides required voltage of appropriate amplitude to motor. In this manner speed of bus will be controlled. Facilites like onstacle detetor and fire detector are also provided to avoid accidents.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 145: ABNORMAL VOLTAGE PROTECTOR
text:
Project: ABNORMAL VOLTAGE PROTECTOR
Participants: Sonar Hemant Vasudev; Shimpi Amol Dharmdas; Kurkarni Bhupendra; Tames Varsala
Institution: K. K. Wagh Polytechnic, Nashik
Institution as written in this record: K.K. Wagh Polytechnic, NASIK
Abstract: In a modern power system,electical form the generating station is delivered to the ultimate consumers though a network of a transmission & distribution for the satisfactory opening operating motor lamps &other load it is desirable that consumer are supplied with the substantially constant voltage. Wide variation of voltage may cause erratic operation or even malfunctioning of consumer appliances. If lower voltage is applied either to motor or a compressor unit of refrigerator it may not be able to start rotor rotating & may lead to burning of the motor winding due to absence of back emf. When the voltage in system increases or decreases the voltage at consumer's terminal increases or decrease. There voltage variation is undesirable which may cause harmful effect on consumer devise. In order to get good services to the consumer with the trend towards larger interconnected system in has become necessary to employ appropriate method of voltage control. So consider all there possibilities we work on these topic & design on equipment which will help to abnormal voltage condition it is very safe, cheap & will vary the voltage from very low to very high value. All the apparatus in the system is replaceable.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 148: Radio Frequency (Rf) Based Robotic Car Control.
text:
Project: Radio Frequency (Rf) Based Robotic Car Control.
Participants: Chillal Rohit.G; Mehta Nikhil.M; Hulgeri Mayuri.M; Patil Anuja.A
Institution: P.V.P.I.T. – Budhghon
Abstract: In today's world of specialization and atomization, where performance & speed hold the key to success, Robotics plays an important role as a practical solution for the specific need. Radio Frequency (RF) refers specifically to the electromagnetic field, or radio wave, that is generated when an alternating current is input to an antenna. A transmitter together with appropriate software is configured in the shape & form of a remote control unit for use with a handheld game player device. The transmitter may use a conventional radio frequency link to transmit commands to a radio controlled device such as a toy car. The remote control unit, consisting of the transmitter and a game cartridge, is inserted into the game device so that the game player device provides control input& display functionalities to & for the remote control unit. The game player may support synthesis, simulation & testing of a route to be traversed by the radio controlled device. Further the robotic arm can be joined to the car which can perform a variety of operations like picking objects, placing it elsewhere, even in difficult situations. It can be used industries to serve a variety of applications.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 149: Remote Operated Stepper Motor
text:
Project: Remote Operated Stepper Motor
Participants: Yashwant Deshmukh; Pratik Gohel; Mukund Motwani; Ankush Jangam
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Khamgaon
Institution as written in this record: Govt. Polytechnic Khamgaon
Abstract: We are representing a stepper motor in which the direction of rotation of the stepper motor (in clockwise & anticlockwise direction) can be controlled remotely. The transmitter circuit, powered by a 6V battery, is built around timer NE555 (IC8), which is work as an astable multivibrator having a frequency of around 38 kHz. The frequency of the astable is decided by resistor R10, preset VR2 & capacitor C3. Preset VR2 is used to set the frequency to 38 kHz. The output of IC8 is fed to an infrared LED via current-limiting resistor R11. When switch S3 is pressed, the IR LED transmits 38 kHz modulated infrared signal. The transmitted 38 kHz modulated signal is received by infrared receiver module TSOP1738 (IC1) & it outputs a clock pulse to D-type flip CD4013 (IC2) via transistor T1. IC2 accepts date when its clock input is low & transfers it to the output on the positive-going edge of the clock. IC2 is configured as a toggle flip flop as its Q output is connected to 'D' input. Thus when TSOP 1738 receives a signal from the transmitter, it clocks IC2 & its Q output changes from high to low & vice versa on alternate clock inputs. Consequently, the state of Q output of IC2 controls the direction of the stepper motor. When Q output is high the stepper motor rotates in clockwise direction, & when Q output is low the stepper motor rotates in anticlockwise direction. The direction of rotation can also be controlled manually by setting Q output high or low with the help of switches S2 & S1, respectively.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 150: Electric Car
text:
Project: Electric Car
Participants: Kushal Makwana; Monil Bhat; Palak Desai
Institution: K. J. Somaiya Polytechnic, Mumbai
Institution as written in this record: K. J. Somaiya Polytechnic
Abstract: Electric automobile is the four-wheeler car in which the motive power to the wheels is provided by the A.C. motor drive. The rpm of the motor can be varied using potentiometer. Here in our project due economy constraint we have used low capacity current inverting device, hence we will get single rpm because we are using the available current to its full extent. The d.c. current which drives the motor is delivered from the electric. We can drive the vehicle up to extent up to the charge holding capacity of the electric. Here we have used single electric. If we would have used couple of batteries we would have increased the capacity (our's being the low capacity sample model). "Battery automobile" is the electrically operated automobile consisting of the following different sub-components:- 1) Electric D.C. Motor, 2) Frame, 3) Startor, 4) Battery, 5) Wheels, 6) Drive, 1) Electric D.C. Motor The motor is having 5 b.h.p. capacity with maximum 500 rpm with torque capacity of 50 Nm.Its pecifications are as per the following:- Current rating – 5 Amp Voltage rating – 12 Volt D.C. Cooling – air cooled Bearing – single row ball Cooling – Air Rating – Continuous

title: GIAN Nidhi record 151: Advanced Embedded Wireless Control System
text:
Project: Advanced Embedded Wireless Control System
Participants: Vyawahare Baban; Syed Arshad; Bhushan .Patil
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Washim
Institution as written in this record: Government polytechnic, washim
Abstract: The project is a kind of embedded system project. The 89c51 micro-controller is used in this system. The logic behind project is to interlace the IR receiver with the controller. The most of consumer electronics, from camcorders to stereo equipment, an infrared remote control is usually always included. Video and audio apparatus, computers and also lighting installations now days often operate on infra-red remote control. The carrier frequency of such infra-red signals is typically in the order of around 36 kHz. The control codes are sent in serial format modulated to that 36 kHz, carrier frequency (usually by turning the carrier on and off). There are many different coding system in use and generally different manufacturers use different code and different data rates for transmission "IR" stand for infrared light is invisible since its frequency is below that of visible red. Otherwise, it is like any other light source, operating under the same laws of physics. In most case, the IR signals are produced by an LED source. TV remotes send commands only one way, in a low- speed burst for distances of up to 30 feet. They use directed IR with LED's that have a moderate cone angle to improve ease-of-use characteristics. The IR signal sent out by those devices is generally modulated to around 38 kHz carrier using amplitude shift keying. The data rate send is generally in range of 100-2000 bps. In this system generally RC5 encoding protocol is used in the transmitting section. On the receiver side a photodiode takes up the signal. The integrated circuit inside a typical receiving chip is sensitive only around a specific frequency in the 32-40 kHz range. The output is the demodulated digital input, the micro controller will sent output to one of its output pin of available 32-I/O pins. To these output pins various home equipments like Bulb, Tube-lights & Fans are interfaced using proper relays or driver circuitry. Some additional facilities such are variable speed control of D.C. Motor with the help of dimmer by incrementing / decrementing the count value in counters by one step.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 153: Remote Operated Stepper Motor
text:
Project: Remote Operated Stepper Motor
Participants: Yashwant Deshmukh; Pratik Gohel; Mukund Motwani; Ankush Jangam
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Khamgaon
Institution as written in this record: Govt. Polytechnic Khamgaon
Abstract: We are representing a stepper motor in which the direction of rotation of the stepper motor (in clockwise & anticlockwise direction) can be controlled remotely. The transmitter circuit, powered by a 6V battery, is built around timer NE555 (IC8), which is work as an astable multivibrator having a frequency of around 38 kHz The frequency of the astable is decided by resistor R10, preset VR2 & capacitor C3. Preset VR2 is used to set the frequency to 38 kHz.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 164: Televideo Controlled Mobile Serviellance van
text:
Project: Televideo Controlled Mobile Serviellance van
Participants: Agarwal Vishalkumar; Kaustaubh Dhamankar; NItin Kukade; Sandip Gaikwad
Institution: Pimpari Chinchwad Polytechnic, Nigdi, Pune
Abstract: This project is developed with the primary intention to explore & develop some of the above features into robots. It aims at designing & implementing a robot, which could perform Path Retracing. The idea is to control the movement of the robot using a remote control, which could be sent to collect data in explorations as cited above. As the robots would be primarily collecting crucial data so a mechanism has to be incorporated by which the robot returns back to the origin (i.e.) (its home position from where it started) in case of loss of communication from the master control station. Hence path retracing is of paramount importance. The path retracing algorithm uses a Stock based LIFO ordering to store the path information. Advancement, of obstacle detection is implemented through a feedback mechanism. The user who controls the robot remotely could get feedback signals from the robot regarding the obstacles ahead. He could subsequently make the robot move in a different path

title: GIAN Nidhi record 166: Suraksha – a vehicle safety device
text:
Project: Suraksha – a vehicle safety device
Participants: Gosaliya Pooja; Karmokar Puja; Borole Komal; Naskar Momita
Institution: P. V. Polytechnic, S.N.D.T. Women's University
Abstract: SURAKSHA – a vehicle safety device is designed as a safety purpose for any four-wheeler. The whole system works on the basic principle of communication. It consists of two parts. I) Park Aid, II) Anti Theft Alarm I) Park Aid : The Park Aid circuit is designed as an aid in parking the car near the parking wall when backing up. It works on the principle of RADAR communication. The circuit gives a visual indication of the distance (in feet) between the car & the wall with the help of small bulbs (LEDs). So the person / driver is alerted & does not have to look back while parking. II) Anti Theft Alarm : The Anti Theft Alarm works on the principle of FM communication. This circuit indicates a person when his car is stolen with the help of buzzer. After getting indication, the stolen car can also be stopped so that the intruder (thief) cannot further drive the car. If by chance, the intruder finds out about the wireless alarm & disconnects the circuit, the buzzer is still active & the car can be stopped. So the burglar alarm is fool proof & highly reliable.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 167: Automatic toll tax system using RFID technology
text:
Project: Automatic toll tax system using RFID technology
Participants: Sartape Niyati; Warke Bharti; Piyush Deo; Vinod Gupta; Rupalin Mane
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Bandra, Mumbai
Abstract: The process of automatic toll collection at toll stations can be accomplished with the help of RFID technology. For automatic toll collection, the RFID tag is attached in the remote area of vehicle. This passive R/W (Read/Write) tag has in it stored all the unique details of the vehicle viz. the chassis no., engine no., registration no., etc. & the prepared amount with these R/W tags, one call write over existing information or add information to them. These tags usually have a serial no. that can't be written over. It can thus be recharged by writing into the tag some amount of rupees using an RFID writer. RFID detectors are employed at toll stations, which are attached to the Microcontroller. These detectors continuously unit electromagnetic waves through air which activate the tag. When tag activates it transmits the data to the detector. The microcontroller checks for the validity & details of the vehicle. It deducts the prepaid amount on bases of the size of the vehicle (for which it is already programmed) & displays the balance amount on LED display. If vehicle is invalid, microcontroller closes the gate & activates the buzzer.

Title: GIAN Nidhi record 167: Automatic toll tax system using RFID technology
Entities: Piyush Deo; Rupalin Mane; Sartape Niyati; Vinod Gupta; Warke Bharti; Automatic toll tax system using RFID technology; Govt. Polytechnic, Bandra, Mumbai
Project: Automatic toll tax system using RFID technology
Participants: Sartape Niyati; Warke Bharti; Piyush Deo; Vinod Gupta; Rupalin Mane
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Bandra, Mumbai
Abstract: The process of automatic toll collection at toll stations can be accomplished with the help of RFID technology. For automatic toll collection, the RFID tag is attached in the remote area of vehicle. This passive R/W (Read/Write) tag has in it stored all the unique details of the vehicle viz. the chassis no., engine no., registration no., etc. & the prepared amount with these R/W tags, one call write over existing information or add information to them. These tags usually have a serial no. that can't be written over. It can thus be recharged by writing into the tag some amount of rupees using an RFID writer. RFID detectors are employed at toll stations, which are attached to the Microcontroller. These detectors continuously unit electromagnetic waves through air which activate the tag. When tag activates it transmits the data to the detector. The microcontroller checks for the validity & details of the vehicle. It deducts the prepaid amount on bases of the size of the vehicle (for which it is already programmed) & displays the balance amount on LED display. If vehicle is invalid, microcontroller closes the gate & activates the buzzer.

Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Programmable logic devices have traditionally been used as a container for the glue logic that binds the processor to peripheral devices & interface components that comprise the complete system. The recent emergence of large capacity FPGAs at relatively low cost has the potential to change the way we think about programmable hardware & to redefine the boundaries between hardware & software. They can be used to implement & consolidate the various peripheral function needed by the processor system or indeed to include the processor itself effectively creating a complete system platform with programmable hardware

Participants: Aher Sachin; Joshi Urmit; Wale Ajit
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: In today's world mobile phone has become the most simplest & effective way of communication. What to do if we want to send a message to our friend. Simple, we write a sms & send it to our friend. That's very cool & handy for us. But, what if one of our friends is blind. Being blind does not mean he should be deprived of the simplest facility available on mobile phone. There should be some way that blind people can also read messages, isn't it? So basically our project aims at enabling blind to read sms

Abstract: Deaf person can depended on vision to understand their environmental , therefore, they usually develop gestures & then express themselves to oyhers through sing language or other modes. Persons, who are blind, can use their intact sense of hearing to receive environmental cause. As a result , blind persons usually have little difficulty in learning to speak & to communicate with others. However, deaf-blind persons function quite different from persons who are either deaf or blind.Due to extreme sensory deprivation, they can not respond normally to their family members & others. Therefore some of them function in some ways like mentally retarded persons. Thus developing some kinds of communication aids to help them communicate with others & to enable them to lead more productive lives is a very demanding challenge.

Institution: Government Poly., Nashik
Abstract: We used two fixed magnets and one moving magnate kept in equilibrium and arranged such that floating magnet get repelled from both fixed magnet. A rod is made of copper because it is non-magnet material. The magnets incorporated in this unit are having a very strong magnetic strength and its material is Neodymium. This is ferromanetic materia.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 189: Power Genration From Biogas Using Bike.
text:
Project: Power Genration From Biogas Using Bike.
Participants: Sonawne Rajesh Sopan; Surwade Kiran Bhagwat; Thete Nitin Ramdas; Shinde Shrinivas Rajan; Padhi Debasis Govardhan
Institution: K. K. Wagh Polytechnic, Nashik
Institution as written in this record: K.K.Wagh Polytechnic, Nashik
Abstract: In this project, research on biogas utilization for residential power generation is discussed. The objective of this project is to design a prototype which can assist biogas produced in back house septic tank or traditional biogas plant for power generation using motor cycle/IC engine. The design of a crude oil based, low fuel consuming, low emissions GEN-SET will lead to an unaffordable solution for Indian rural as well as other middle class communities. Moreover a module like this providing multi-solutions such as treatment of sewage/waste/organic matter, providing bio-fertilizer, preventing global warming due to methane trapping, fulfilling electricity demands at very low cost, reducing emissions and more has always been welcome by nature. This project is presented mostly considering present Indian electricity crisis

title: GIAN Nidhi record 200: Vacuum pick and place system
text:
Project: Vacuum pick and place system
Participants: Vishwanath M. Longani; Madanlal R. Longani; Shrvankumar N. Pusala; Yogesh Y. Nimse; Anil R. Sonwane
Institution: K.B.P. Polytechnic, Kopargaon
Institution as written in this record: K.B.P. Polytechnic Kopargaon
Abstract: Vacuum Pick and place system is a material handling device using pneumatic circuit. This circuit is fully automated by using 3 solonoid valves which either fully open or are fully closed. A venturimeter is also used to create vacuum for picking the object with flat surface. It consist of two consist & cylinder arrangement one vertical & other horizontal which are used for moving the objects in respective directions. Two solonoid valves are stop & start flow through venturimeter in order to create & cancel the vacuum. The special feature is that the piston used in horizontal cylinder is rodless and its cross-section is elliptical. This arrangement reduces chances of leakage and supports the trolley carrying the material from one place to other properly.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 201: Wireless temperature sensing & controlling
text:
Project: Wireless temperature sensing & controlling
Participants: Amey J. Keshkamat; Pankaj P. Badhe; Vishal Doshi; Viraj Khedekar
Institution: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Polytechnic
Abstract: The project is basically divided into to two major units, 1. Temperature sensing and transmitting. 2. Receiving & Displaying Temperature Sensing refers to gauging the temperature of a place and transmitted over a wireless link. The signal is given to the ADC of the micro controller. The micro controller then converts the parallel input signal into serial output which is given to RF Transmitter. The data signal is transmitted over 200 m & received by the corresponding RF receiver. The data is serially given to Rx micro-controller which converts it in signal into parallel output. This parallel stream then drives the LCD display unit.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 202: Digital Heartbeat Monitoring System
text:
Project: Digital Heartbeat Monitoring System
Participants: Manas M. Kapoor; Ashwin M. Panikkar; Prathamesh P. Shirwadkar; Sahaj Dharmaraj
Institution: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Polytechnic
Abstract: Digital Heartbeat Monitoring System is a device, which is used to count heartbeats of a person. This device compares the measured heartbeats with standard limit. If heartbeat of person lies beyond or below the standard limit, then buzzer of the device will be automatically turn on and also glows the LED. It also shows the number of heartbeats counted in a minute on the 7-segment display. Due to this facility, if the condition of the patient becomes critical then doctors can take immediate action on that patient. The main advantage of this device is that the patient whose heartbeats to be measured shall not have particular age limit.

Institution: K.B.P. Polytechnic, Kopargaon

title: GIAN Nidhi record 206: Microcontroller Based Weighing Machine
text:
Project: Microcontroller Based Weighing Machine
Participants: Tejas N.Varsekar; Nitin D. Shetty; Amit C. Shukla; Sudhanshu A. Upadhay
Institution: Sardar Vallabhbhai patel Polytechnic, Boriwali West, Mumbai
Abstract: Working of this system is based on the transducers called Load cell. The strain gage is the heart of a load cell. A strain stage is the device that changes resistance when it is stressed. The gage are developed from an ultra-thin heat – treated metallic foil and are chemically bonded to a thin dielectric layer. Positioning of the gage, mounting procedure and materials used all have a measurable effect on performance of the load cell. Multiple strain gages are connected to create the four legs of a Wheatstone-bridge configuration. When an input voltage is applied to the bridge, the output becomes a voltage proportional to the force on the cell.

Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Aurangabad
Abstract: It is micro controller & serial communication based system. There is a current transformer and a voltage transformer, which sends read data to the micro controller. title: GIAN Nidhi record 212: Speech Controlled Robot
text:
Project: Speech Controlled Robot
Participants: Kadam Vaibhav; Sujit Chaudhari
Institution: Manohar Phalke Memorial Foundation's Poly., Mumbai
Abstract: The Robot is Speech Control (through Wireless) the Basic Principle of Working is that it should be combine with a Transmitter and Receiver. Thus the Transmitter will send the required data and the Receiver will receive the transmitted Data. As our Robot is PC controlled through Parallel Port. Thus the Parallel Port of the PC will send the information to control the robot in the form of Binary bits. These Binary bits are given to the Encoder through Buffer. Buffer is required for the isolation purpose to avoid Loading of PC Mother board. The Decoder will receive the bits means it converts the Parallel data into Serial data and provide these data to Transmitter which transmit data Wirelessly.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 220: Private Branch exchange (PBX) Simulation.
text:
Project: Private Branch exchange (PBX) Simulation.
Participants: Shah Savita; Jaju Snehal; Runawal Pratiksha; Tapkir Supriya
Institution: Government polytechnic Pune
Institution as written in this record: Govt. Polytechnic, Pune
Abstract: The Private Branch Exchange has gone full circle as a term. Originally having started as an organization's manual switchboard operated by the telephone operator or just simply the operator, they have evolved in to VoIP centers that are hosted by the operators or even hardware manufacturers. These modern IP Centrex systems offer essentially the same service, but they have moved so far from the original concept of the PBX that the term hardly applies at all.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 221: PC based unman bus monitoring
text:
Project: PC based unman bus monitoring
Participants: Nehe Kiran; Mandalik Sachin; Shelake Tanhaji
Institution: Amrutvahini Polytechnic, Sangamner
Institution as written in this record: Amrutvahini Polytecnic, Sangamner
Abstract: To send a bus without a person, for example while on war. Some times a traveler travels with passenger. It may require knowing the status where and in what condition the bus is hence unmanned bus concept arising. In this project a passenger bus is traveling without a driver. The bus speed is controlled as the nature of road is sensed by the position sensors. If the road is curvy the sensor provides a logic pulse to processor which indicates for low speed and if the road is a straight path the sensor provides a logic pulse to processor, which indicates for higher speed, and if the bus arrives the station, the bus should stop. After the bus is stopped, the simulation for door opening and closing is provided. The system is based on PC and will use 'Visual basic 6.0' as front end & 'Assembly language' for microcontroller as back end.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 226: PC Sentry
text:
Project: PC Sentry
Participants: Chaugule Harshad Annaso; Bhatter Paritosh Shankar; Jadhav Manojkumar Mohan; Latwade Chetan Appasaheb; Pawar Smita Nivrutti
Institution: Padambhushan Vasantrao Patil Institute of technology, Budhgaon
Institution as written in this record: Padmabhooshan Vasantrao Patil Inst.of Tech., Budhgaon
Abstract: PC Sentry is an institute level, Server based project. It is a combination of two different functionalities namely 1. Desktop locking 2. Internet filtering 1.Desktop locking : Every user in the institute has an individual User Profile. Every time a user starts the PC, he is forced to login before he is given the access to the system. His login information is checked from the user's database for its appropriateness. If he is an authorized user he is given the access to system. 2. Internet filtering: PC sentry is a server based project i.e. it is installed on the server through which all the communication takes place. Every time a user requests for a URL, It is checked to find if it is objectionable. text:
Project: Task Reminder & Manager
Participants: Powar Ranjeet D; Wadekar Manoj S; Yewale Sopan B
Institution: Ekalavya Shikshan Sanstha Polytechnic, Pune
Abstract: The software helps Elite to store the complete database of the client organization. The employee information is acquired from the client organization in the form of excel sheet. The software converts the information into tables in MS-Access. It is this transformed information that helps the software to schedule the task. The Computerised system provides excellent GUI through which the user can store as well as access any required information in the most user friendly form. The system also stores the address details of each employee including the city & location at which he stays and the total time in the days that will be required for the courier to reach the destination.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 228: A Smart Technology Approach for Toll Tax Collection.
text:
Project: A Smart Technology Approach for Toll Tax Collection.
Participants: Atul Kanade; Vipul Tiwari; Vijay Jain; Niladri Roy
Institution: Mahatma Education Society, Pilla's Polytechnic
Abstract: In this project we have automated the Toll Naka Collection with the help of smart card technologies. Smart cards are with contact less interfaces are becoming increasingly popular for payment of money. The smart card is swiped in the machine at the Toll Naka each time the customer passes by it otherwise the gates will not open up and allow the car to move forward. After swiping the card the system will display the car registration number, name of the owner and other details are stored in the machine. The destination id entered and the required money is deducted from the card owner's account. This card can also be recharged, in case if the validity of the card expires.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 229: SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT FOR CALL CENTERS
text:
Project: SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT FOR CALL CENTERS
Participants: Mhatre Hitesh; Panchal Bhavesh
Institution: Pravin Patil College Of Diploma Engg. & technology
Abstract: There are 25 call centers branches of i2i enterprise all over India with head office at Mumbai. The data is send by that centers to the Mumbai and back up is taken here. The data received at Mumbai office is in raw format, which is filtered while uploading in sql server. So it is necessary to avoid 'DATA DUPLICATION'. For this reason we are developing software which will eliminate the duplication which also maintains user friendliness.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 232: Versatile Oxygen Measurement In Breath
text:
Project: Versatile Oxygen Measurement In Breath
Participants: Vaktana Hemagi; Sagvekar Akshata; Patil Rashmi; Mathe Jashree; Pagdhre Revati
Institution: Government polytechnic Mumbai
Institution as written in this record: Government Polytechnic, Mumbai
Abstract: Pneumatic consist three tube, in which two tubes gives two different pressure transducer and tube give input to oxygen sensor .Differential pressure transducer which is use is nothing but flow sensor, it senses difference between two pressure. Oxygen sensor is electro mechanical and senses oxygen in breath. Oxygen signal is amplified by complifier and differential pressure transducers output is amplified by instrumentation amplifier as well as instrumentation amplifier is use for balance output of differential pressure transducer. Low pass filter is required to reduce the noise from signal or filter the signal.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 235: Virtual Keyboard cum Mouse
text:
Project: Virtual Keyboard cum Mouse
Participants: Patil Nkul; Sinalkar Swanand; Bora Pritesh; Hwaldar Samir; Nikam Vinayak; Suryavanshi Sachin
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Nashik
Abstract: The virtual mouse keyboard is based on the reorganization of the interruption of IR rays & this interruption is displayed as the reflective character on the monitor by the interfacing software In this model we have created 8 rows and 8 column of IR rays. It is a 16 model and can be used operated maximum 64 keys. It's a completely noiseless keyboard. There was a strong motivation to develop tedious task of typing in devices such as cell phones PDAs, laptops, etc. also whose layout can be reconfigured by simply manipulating the software such a device is termed "Virtual Keyboard cum Mouse".

title: GIAN Nidhi record 237: TELEMETRY
text:
Project: TELEMETRY
Participants: Pedanekar Sakent; Dhandhukai Davesh; Sayed Mamoon; Ansari Farid
Institution: B. G. I. T., Mumbai
Abstract: The physicalparameter in the process control systemsensed by using an appropriate transducer. The signal conditioning circuit convert this physical parameter into electric signal. This voltage is then applied to a voltage to frequency converter. At the out put of the voltage we get a frequency that is proportional to the input voltage. The frequency variations are used to modulate a carrier to get a frequency modulated output. This RF signal is then transmited via an antenna in air.

text:
