Participants: Kale Amruta Ramesh; Ghonge Mangesh Manikrao; Lodha Sandesh Sumatilalji; Tone Namarata
Institution: Jawaharlal Darda Institute of Engg and Tech. Yavatmal
Institution as written in this record: Jawaharlal Darda Inst.Of Engg & Tech
Abstract: It will be a RDBMS which will provide base feature of a RDBMS It will work in Client Server Environment. The DBMS server will manage all the DBMS operations. It will create XML database and we will be able to add table to that database. Also we will be able to add, delete, edit, and update data. We can also query the database on given condition. The client tool will work in two modes. 1. Interactive mode, 2. Common mode. In this project we are using : 1. JAVA for Networking, 2. Multithreading, 3. SAX (simple API XML)

title: GIAN Nidhi record 248: Gray-Level Grouping (GLG)
text:
Project: Gray-Level Grouping (GLG)
Participants: Amruta Gajanan Chakkarwar; Yogesh Virendra Keshawowar; Pradip Shriram Chavan
Institution: Jawaharlal Darda Institute of Engg and Tech. Yavatmal
Abstract: Contrast enhancement has an important role in image processing applications. Conventional contrast enhancement techniques either often fail to produce satisfactory results for a broad variety of low-contrast images, or cannot be automatically applied to different images, because their parameters must be specified manually to produce a satisfactory result for a given image. This paper describes a new automatic method for contrast enhancement . the basic procedure is to first group the histogram components of a low-contrast image into a proper number of bins according to a selected criterion, then redistribute these bins uniformely over the grayscale, and finally ungroup the previously grouped gray levels. Accordingly, this new techniques, but is also fully automatic in most circumstances, and is applicable to a broad variety of images.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 249: Signature analysis of power system by using simulink in MATLAB
text:
Project: Signature analysis of power system by using simulink in MATLAB
Participants: Mahesh Revan Ghadge; Mahesh Chandrakant Khulage; Sudhir Prabhakar Ubale; Ashish Arvind Bele; Romesh Rai Nigam
Institution: Shri Sant Gadge Baba College of Engg. & Technology, Z.T.C. Bhusawal
Abstract: Development of signature analysis techniques for use on a power system is rare. Hence we decided to simulink the fault in power system & recording current signatures. These signature will extract features such as harmonics content & compare with faulty signatures and if fault is at some location then its specific signature will tell us the location of fault.

Institution: J.D.I.E.T. Near MIDC, Yavatmal

title: GIAN Nidhi record 255: VHDL implementation of discrete wavelet transform for image compression
text:
Project: VHDL implementation of discrete wavelet transform for image compression
Participants: Priya Zade; Shradha S. Hinge; Shital R. Hajare; Harshad V. Deshmukh; Swapnil S. Kothal; Vishal P. Lalwani
Institution: J.D.I.E.T. Yavatmal
Abstract: This project presents an approach towards VHDL implementation of the discrete Wavelet Transform (DVT) for image compression. The design follows the JPEG2000 standard and can be used for both lossy and lossless compression. In order to reduce complexities of the design, linear algebra view of IDWT and DWT has been used which need very less resources. Discrete wavelet transform transforms discrete signal from time domain and frequency domain. This transform provides high speed and better performance as compare to any other transforms. This design can be used for image compression in a robotic system, digital camera & medical imaging

title: GIAN Nidhi record 258: Smart Cloud For Effective Load Balancing Using Artificial Neural Network"
text:
Project: Smart Cloud For Effective Load Balancing Using Artificial Neural Network"
Participants: Ashwini Y. Gudadhe
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Abstract: Cloud computing is a type of Internet based computing that provides processing resources and data to computers and other devices on demand. Distributed systems have seen tremendous advancement in performing various operations and cloud has been efficacious to provide a flexible and scalable approach. Cloud computing is an extensive distributed computing standard and is widely adopted by organizations. Virtual machines create many logical resources and workstations/servers. These apart from the physical nodes are managed by Datacentres. The Datacentres hosts network's most critical systems and are vigorous to the continuity of daily tasks. The scalable property of cloud has forced these data centres to adapt optimal techniques to manage/balance the load. The objective of load balancing is to optimize resource utility, to provide high throughput, maximize response time and elude overloading of resources.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 259: Pro?t Maximization in Cloud Computing with Guaranteed improved Quality of Service
text:
Project: Pro?t Maximization in Cloud Computing with Guaranteed improved Quality of Service
Participants: Prachi Arun Walke
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Abstract: Now a days, there is continuous demand for cloud computing as effective and efficient way to provide computing resources and services to customers on demand. From the perspective of cloud service providers, pro?t is one of the essential considerations, and it is completely depends on con?guration of a cloud service platform under given market demand. To achieve more profit different scheme are generally implemented. This paper presents provides guaranteed scheme for profit maximization. In this paper, a double resource renting scheme is designed ?rstly in which short-term renting and long-term renting are combined aiming at the existing issues. This double renting scheme can effectively guarantee the quality of service of all requests and reduce the resource waste greatly. Secondly, a service system is modeled by queuing model and the performance is measured on average charge, need of temporary servers that affect the pro?t so forth. Thirdly, highly secured authentication scheme are provided customers in order to prevents unauthorized access. For a pro?t maximization problem is formulated for the double renting scheme and the optimized con?guration of a cloud platform is obtained by solving the pro?t maximization problem. The results will show that our scheme will give guaranteed the service quality for all requests also obtain more pro?t than other schemes.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 260: SMS based Smart Placed and Wireless Electronic Notice Board using GSM
text:
Project: SMS based Smart Placed and Wireless Electronic Notice Board using GSM
Participants: Mr. Dhiraj Rajurkar; Mr. Akash Lanjewar; Ms. Shabda Deshmukh; Prof. Anup Gade
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Abstract: In the last few decades, communication technology has developed by leaps and bounds. The employ of "Embedded System in Communication" has given rise to many appealing applications. There are numerous places which need very important notice to be displayed like colleges, hospitals, restaurants, shopping malls, theaters, public transportation, share-market, traffic signs, highways signs etc. Several firms are mechanized audio / video systems like public announcement system, CCTV, programmable sign boards etc. However of these systems are generally hardwired, complicated in nature and not easy to expand. So, by adding wireless communication interface like GSM to those systems, we will overcome their limitations. This work contains a mixture of wireless technology with LED Display Boards formalized by designing and integrating the hardware and software with AT89S51 microcontroller, GSM module, and moving LED display. The message is distributed through a mobile phone which is accepted by the GSM module SIM. Number authentication is finished by AT89S51 microcontroller and the stored numbers in EEPROM is compared with the incoming number. Authentication result is displayed on LED whether the number is matched or not matched and the message is finally displayed on moving LED (Light emitting diode) display. Additional a similar SMS is itself sent by GSM module to Multiple LED Display Boards that are connected via completely different GSM modules.

Title: GIAN Nidhi record 260: SMS based Smart Placed and Wireless Electronic Notice Board using GSM
Entities: Mr. Akash Lanjewar; Mr. Dhiraj Rajurkar; Ms. Shabda Deshmukh; Prof. Anup Gade; SMS based Smart Placed and Wireless Electronic Notice Board using GSM; Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Project: SMS based Smart Placed and Wireless Electronic Notice Board using GSM
Participants: Mr. Dhiraj Rajurkar; Mr. Akash Lanjewar; Ms. Shabda Deshmukh; Prof. Anup Gade
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Abstract: In the last few decades, communication technology has developed by leaps and bounds. The employ of "Embedded System in Communication" has given rise to many appealing applications. There are numerous places which need very important notice to be displayed like colleges, hospitals, restaurants, shopping malls, theaters, public transportation, share-market, traffic signs, highways signs etc. Several firms are mechanized audio / video systems like public announcement system, CCTV, programmable sign boards etc. However of these systems are generally hardwired, complicated in nature and not easy to expand. So, by adding wireless communication interface like GSM to those systems, we will overcome their limitations. This work contains a mixture of wireless technology with LED Display Boards formalized by designing and integrating the hardware and software with AT89S51 microcontroller, GSM module, and moving LED display. The message is distributed through a mobile phone which is accepted by the GSM module SIM. Number authentication is finished by AT89S51 microcontroller and the stored numbers in EEPROM is compared with the incoming number. Authentication result is displayed on LED whether the number is matched or not matched and the message is finally displayed on moving LED (Light emitting diode) display. Additional a similar SMS is itself sent by GSM module to Multiple LED Display Boards that are connected via completely different GSM modules.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 261: Advanced Online Examination System
text:
Project: Advanced Online Examination System
Participants: Ms. Pranali Nandanwar; Mr. Mangesh Choudhari; Mr.Shubham Bhadke; Mr.Akash Kulkarni; Prof. Anup Gade
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Abstract: Advanced Online Examination System (AOES) is an on-line test portal used to take online examinations in an efficient manner and to avoid time wasting for manually checking of the test papers. The important objective of this web based online examination portal is to efficiently evaluate the student thoroughly through a fully automated system that not only saves lot of time but also gives fast and accurate results. For students they give papers according to their convenience from any place by using internet and time and there is no need of using extra thing like paper, pen etc.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 263: Green cloud for efficient power consumption under maximum Load
text:
Project: Green cloud for efficient power consumption under maximum Load
Participants: Ms.Ruchika Wankhede; Mr.A.H.Gade
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Abstract: Cloud computing is an expanding area and most discussible in the field of research, industry and development today, which involves virtualization, distributed computing, internet, and software and web services. While a large body of work now a days has recently focused on reducing energy expenses of data center's, there exists no prior work on investigating the trade-off between minimizing energy expenditure of data center's and increase the processing speed for various Internet and cloud computing services that they may offer. This paper presents an approach for scheduling algorithms that can maintain the load balancing. In this research work we have developed power optimization (RR) algorithm which over comes the limitations of the previous algorithm. We implements strategy known as Round Robin (RR) scheduling algorithms which will give better result than existing one.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 265: Advance Steganography for Hiding Data and Image using Audio-Video
text:
Project: Advance Steganography for Hiding Data and Image using Audio-Video
Participants: Madhuri R. Shende; Prof. Amit Welekar
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Abstract: Steganography is an art of hiding the secrete message that is being send in the other non secret text. The benefit of steganography is that the expected mystery message does not pull in thoughtfulness regarding itself as an object of investigation. Our point is to conceal mystery data and picture behind the sound and feature document individually. This system will have better security by using steganography. Here in video steganography the data will be hidden in video frames and the key will be stored in audio. This system will have low PSNR than the other systems and have better efficiency. Sound records are generally compacted for capacity or speedier transmission. Sound records can be sent in short remain solitary portions.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 266: Hybrid Segmentation Approach for Irregular shape Fruit images under Natural Illumination
text:
Project: Hybrid Segmentation Approach for Irregular shape Fruit images under Natural Illumination
Participants: Monali R. Dahapute; Prof. Amit Welekar
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Abstract: The goal of computer vision is to form, imitate, and to exceed human vision using computer software and hardware at different levels. This has brought great development in the agriculture field and fruit industries for recognizing fruits from its background images for various purposes like grading, defect recognition. In this paper a computer vision based system is studied for image segmentation of various Irregular shaped fruit images (e.g. Banana, papaya , mango, guava etc) captured under three illumination condition i.e. low, medium and high intensity. Study and discussion is carried out to enhance knowledge about irregular fruit image segmentation techniques, limitation and an enhancement to overcome previous limitation is studied. Each paper had considered images of only one kind of fruit for segmentation (i.e. apple, papaya and jatropa etc.), that may be individual one for defect segmentation or in a bunch for Fruit detection and counting (bananas and tomatoes). The segmentation task is difficult for isolating the images that captured in outdoor environment. There are many enhanced segmentation methods that have been developed over the past years, for fruit images which taken under natural illumination. These methods are sensitive to the variation of colour intensity which influenced by the sunlight illumination. This condition leads to low quality segmented images and therefore reduces the accuracy of object classification. A ruled based segmentation had limitation on images of non-circular shaped object with various colours. So Hybrid Segmentation Approach For Irregular Shape Fruit Images Under Natural Illumination will help to work for segmentation on Non Circular shaped fruits of various colours. New algorithm is generated to segment Irregular Shape Fruit Images under Natural Illumination. This algorithm will be using the combination of Improved Thresholding and Adaptive K-means with some modifications.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 267: Implementing Application for History Based Ranking Algorithm For Personalized Search Queries By using Crawler Intelligence
text:
Project: Implementing Application for History Based Ranking Algorithm For Personalized Search Queries By using Crawler Intelligence
Participants: Namrata M Gaurkar; Prof. Parul Bhanarkar
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Abstract: The web search engine has long become the most important portal for ordinary people looking for useful information on the web. However, users might experience failure when search engines return irrelevant results that do not meet their real intentions. Such irrelevance is largely due to the enormous variety of users' contexts and backgrounds, as well as the ambiguity of texts. Personalized web search (PWS) is a general category of search techniques aiming at providing better search results, which are tailored for individual user needs. As the expense, user information has to be collected and analyzed to figure out the user intention behind the issued query. The solutions to PWS can generally be categorized into two types, namely click-log-based methods and profile-based ones.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 268: Analysis of Image Feature Selection Using Group Structure
text:
Project: Analysis of Image Feature Selection Using Group Structure
Participants: Namrata Naik; Prof. Jayant Rohankar
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Abstract: The global feature space has be achieved in advance . In real world applications, the features are actually generated dynamically. To induce the original high quality image from the degraded image is the fundamental principle of image restoration. Thus, it is necessary to perform feature selection by their arrival, which is referred to as online feature selection. The main advantage of online feature selection is its time efficiency and suitable for online applications, therefore, it has emerged as an important topic. Online feature selection assumes that features flow into the model one by one dynamically. The feature selection is performed by the arrival of features. The group information can be considered as a type of prior knowledge on the connection of the features, and it is difficult to be discovered from merely data and labels. Therefore, performing selection on feature groups can perform better than perform selection on features individually. Therefore, we first formulate the problem as online group feature selection. There are two challenges for this problem: 1) the features are generated dynamically; 2) they are with group structure. To the best of our knowledge. We propose a novel criterion based on spectral analysis. The criterion is proven to be efficient in the online intra-group feature selection.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 269: framework for Effective Data Processing Using Flaw Triage
text:
Project: framework for Effective Data Processing Using Flaw Triage
Participants: Nikita Hiwase; Prof. Jayant Rohankar
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Abstract: Normally, all software projects are affected by software Flaws. New flaws in software are found and reported every day, fixing flaws is a highly expensive process for developer's and so here is the remedy for such problems. Many software development projects have the flaw report repository; in this flaw reports are added. The project manager is responsible for assigning projects to the users and the testers for testing the code, when a customer requests for a software to be developed. The developer develops the project as per customer requirements. In the testing phase the tester will identify the flaws. The flaw details in the database table are accessible to both project manager and developer. Flaw Tracking System plays a vital role in all the phases as it provides separate environments for project manager, developer and tester. If another developer faces the same flaws so by using the classifier (SVM) it access from the database and there is no need to fix them again and we also introduce PCA(principal Component Analysis) algorithm for feature extraction.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 270: A Survey on Design and Approach for Finding the Similarity between the Documents
text:
Project: A Survey on Design and Approach for Finding the Similarity between the Documents
Participants: SHILPA A. SATONE; PROF. JAYANT ROHANKAR
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Abstract: Information on internet is very huge in size. Web users need support to manage information easily. This makes the user's time consuming because there are many near-duplicate results. The efficient detection of near-duplicate articles is very important in many applications that have a large amount of data. we introduce algorithms of extracting keyphrase and matching signatures for near-duplicate articles detection. Based on N-gram(i.e. bigram & trigram) algorithm for key phrase extraction & jaccard similarity for finding similarity between documents. Algorithms are applied on article. Results show that our proposed methods are more effective than other existing method.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 271: Assessment And Purification of Water Supply System
text:
Project: Assessment And Purification of Water Supply System
Participants: Roshan Sawarkar; Shubham Bhagat; Shubham Gedam; Karan Shrivar; Suryakant Todase
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Institution as written in this record: Tulsiramji Gaikwad Patil College of Engineering & Technology
Abstract: Design, construct & maintain structures , fly ash ,This project covered major aspect of concrete mix design as the quality control measure of concrete production, as per the Indian Standard Code IS: 10262-1982. It is aimed at highlighting the important of designed concrete as compared to an ordinary ratio analyzed concrete in concrete production for any civil/structural concrete work. It equally include the whole laboratory test analysis, to determine the physical and geotechnical properties of the materials needed for the mix design in order to attain the required data for the design procedure, in accordance to the parent material types and location, and the specific density of the designed concrete, that will be suitable, adoptable, durable, economical, workable and generally safe for the structural design objective of the weather condition in any specified locality. The design covered concrete grade 20N/mm2, and were designed to attain the required strength grade after 7days, 14 days and 28 days of curing specially with water as the minimum strength. Basically the designs were done by replacing marble dust as sand and partial replacement of fly ash as cement with different percentage of replacement in which marble dust is replaced by fine aggregate by 10%, 20%, 30%, 40% and project fly ash is replaced by cement by 10%, 15%, 20% and 25%.It was equally considered as a factor that all the grade of concrete designed for, should achieve 65% strength after been cured for seven days in water. The individual result of the design mix were adequately presented and have shown that generally mix design of concrete before production as measure of quality control of concrete work is very important in any civil project either for Government and individual. Quality control should be applicable, to control structural failure:-

title: GIAN Nidhi record 272: RS Jack
text:
Project: RS Jack
Participants: Ranashashitej Pawar
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Whenever you need to change the tyre, brake lining or the bearing of any vehicle, one can use the RS Jack. The RS Jack reduces the time dramatically. It lifts the vehicle axle faster than any conventional system. In fact the entire process can be achieved in less than 20 seconds. The RS Jack uses the driving motion of the vehicle to lift and lower the axle. As nobody is required to go underneath for the lifting and lowering procedure, the result is far safer working environment. Once the RS Jack is upright, it transforms into an axle support that can withstand a load of the average four wheeler vehicles. Thus with the help of RS jack we easily lift a vehicle without any human effort as compared with the conventional jack.

The RS Jack uses the driving motion of the vehicle to lift and lower the axle. As nobody is required to go underneath for the lifting and lowering procedure, the result is far safer working environment. Once the RS Jack is upright, it transforms into an axle support that can withstand a load of the average four wheeler vehicles. Thus with the help of RS jack we easily lift a vehicle without any human effort as compared with the conventional jack.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 273: Third eye for visually impaired person
text:
Project: Third eye for visually impaired person
Participants: Miss Priyanka Hallale
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Innovation is a challenge because it must meet the characteristics of an entire population. This includes visual impairment, which is the focus of this paper. Considering the interaction capabilities offered by mobile devices, especially smartphones, we asked ourselves this question: what kinds of interaction make it easier for visually impaired people to use mobile apps? To answer this question, we first researched into these persons' smartphone usage habits. Then we developed a prototype for an electronic calendar that provides interaction via voice commands, keyboard and touch. An electronic calendar is a very useful tool especially in business, since it can be used for managing people, resources and events, having a positive impact on productivity. This prototype was analyzed with potential users and we collected their initial impressions about the benefits of using various forms of interaction. The lessons learned with this work are presented and categorized using some of the best-known usability heuristics. Voice or signaled input is inserted through any speech device such as microphone, then speech can be processed and convert it to text hence able to send SMS, also Phone number can be entering either by voice or you may select it from contact list. Voice has opened up data input for a variety of user's such as illiterate, Handicapped, as if the person cannot write then the speech input is a boon and other's too which Can lead to better usage of the application. text:
Project: automated number plate recognition system
Participants: Snehal Mangulakar; Shweta Munde; Deepali Thorat; Sheetal Tupe
Institution: Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies
Abstract: Traffic control and vehicle owner identification has become major problem in every country. Sometimes it becomes difficult to identify vehicle owner who violates traffic rules and drives too fast. Therefore, it is not possible to catch and punish those kinds of people because the traffic personal might not be able to retrieve vehicle number from the moving vehicle because of the speed of the vehicle. Therefore, there is a need to develop Automatic Number Plate Recognition system.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 276: Forest Maker
text:
Project: Forest Maker
Participants: Mansub S. Walekar; Mahesh Nyayadhish; Kanchan Chaudhari
Institution: Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies
Abstract: Tree plantation is the best way to celebrate any occasion, this saves nature and keep surrounding pollution free but after plantation not many trees survive because of natural calamity of caretaker, tree could not help nature that much. Thinking on other side industrial society is growing much faster than tree on earth as well as technology used in these industries Automation is one of those technologies; which is used in almost all industry Automation is used for making automation production which reduces human efforts and it is programmed by device named PL.C (Programmable Logic Control) Forest Maker idea is to connect this technology to nature. To make complete automation for growing up the tree up to extend that tree can grow on its own. This system uses waste water produced by industries, malls, residential areas. Carbon-dioxide, Carbon-monoxide gas produced by industries & Biodegradable waste as fertilizer for trees. PLC control all automation in system it supplies water, fertilizer and gases to feed trees. It also sprinkles pesticide over trees time to time. PLC controls ropeway robot to supplies fertilizer to tree. All these devisees installed are monitored from remote location using web portal as well as android app. System has future development with multiple options for green power supply such as solar panel and wind mill and as last resort it uses grid power. System stores the power generated from solar panel and wind mill into batteries and add on system as Wi-Fi as wireless communication.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 277: Pomegranate Fruit Disease Detection And Prevention
text:
Project: Pomegranate Fruit Disease Detection And Prevention
Participants: Deshmukh Shweta; Pachpol Kalyani; Raagi Prabhjyotkaur; Talekar Tejas
Institution: Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies
Abstract: Smart Farming Pomegranate Fruit Disease Detection And Prevention" is an application which detects disease caused to fruit depending on the symptoms that can be seen on fruits by observing is texture, size, color and features Determining and identification of type of diseases occurred to fruit accurately is difficult. At present, in the agriculture sectors, diagnosis of disease of fruits are based on human expert. Whereas still conventional methods are applied using test device and performing laboratory test which is time consuming and even all farmers couldn't get those services. Many time identification of disease lately, causes huge loss to fruit farms and production this is all due to lack of guidance and awareness. Therefore there is need of such a system which could automate the work of fruit detection with easy access and availability which would help to classify disease caused to fruit and treatment need to be taken The Smart Farming: Disease Detection and prevention on pomegranate' is a real time web application. This proposed web application mainly focuses on detecting the diseases on pomegranate with image processing techniques .This application would ensure to provide guidance to farmers by detecting diseases caused to their fruits by image processing technique such as Preprocessing, Filtering. Segmentation, Morphology and Classification on Images and Using K-Mean Algorithm. Farmer would upload image of fruit which He/she want to detect by using digital device or phones and then system would extract disease part of image by applying various technique and further classification of diseases would ensure that wheatear the disease has been present or not by using pattern matching of diseased image with original standard images of diseases stored in the database which would ensure disease type and accordingly provide preventive measures and suggestions to cure them This proposed system will definitely benefit to farmers as they share a major contribution for development of country

title: GIAN Nidhi record 278: I clean Incredible India
text:
Project: I clean Incredible India
Participants: Gauri Phatate; Divya Kabra; Rashmi Kulkarni; Shraddha Naik
Institution: Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies
Abstract: In India we don't have any direct communication between the government and public in an efficient way for solving the problems i.e. for getting a problem solved in our place we have to bribe the officials and get them solved in 2 months which can be solved in one month time. In order to overcome this problem we decided to make an android application through which public can post the pictures related to their complaints in the application and get them solved in a specified time and can also know the status of the complaint at any time. Initially phones were merely used for calling or texting.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 279: Pilgrims Tracking System
text:
Project: Pilgrims Tracking System
Participants: Kanchan U. Chungade; Sneha J. Waghmare; Swati V. Zendewale; Aboli A. Ambekar
Institution: Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies
Abstract: Pilgrim tracking system is an android application which is used to provide the detailed information regarding pilgrim. This application provides the live pilgrim status. The system relies on a dedicated delay-tolerant wireless sensor network. Each pilgrim is given a mobile sensor unit which includes a GPS chip, a microcontroller, GSM and antennas. The use of GSM and GPS technologies allows the system to track object and provides the most up-to-date information. For health monitoring issue, a mobile monitoring system can be designed and implemented to accomplish the transmission of temperature and heart rate signal of a pilgrim which employs Short Message Service accompanied by low cost hardware equipment's. GSM and GPS based tracking system will provide effective, real time pilgrim location, and reporting

title: GIAN Nidhi record 280: Route Planning in road network
text:
Project: Route Planning in road network
Participants: Diksha Banswal; Aarti dhole; Prasanna Jadhav; Lukesha Ferwani
Institution: Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies
Abstract: This Project "Route Planning in real Road Networks" is aimed to solve the vehicle routing problem that is most prominent today in cities due to huge traffic that is growing during the peak hours this application shows the shortest route along with all the possible routes to the user so that user if not chooses the shortest path can opt for other different routes as well. This application also shows the distance in kilometer along with shortest path and list of possible routes that are available in map. Speaking technicalities this Application uses a classical research based algorithm that is Dijkstra algorithm. The Dijkstra algorithm effectively addresses the shortest path problem There different categories of shortest path these different categories are many to many shortest path single source shortest path the Dijkstra algorithm falls short of many to many shortest path in this case an attempt is made to increase the boosting efficiency of this algorithm over many to many shortest path where the source is many spots added by admin and destination is many stop added by admin.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 282: Swayampurn
text:
Project: Swayampurn
Participants: Madhuri V; Kulkarni; Shubhangi S. Pathade; Vaishali M. Garje
Institution: Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies
Abstract: SWAYAMPURN is an android application which will help Anganwadi workers by atomizing all their work such as daily attendance, BMI calculation, awareness among people regarding child health and nutrition as well as women health etc. Anganwadi were started by Indian government in 1975 as a part of the Integrated Child Development Service Scheme (ICDS) is one of the initiatives taken by the Central Government, which provides a package of six services supplementary nutrition, immunization, health checkups, referral services, nutrition and health education for children. In proposed application will allow them to maintain daily attendance of the children, provide estimation of ingredient required to cook food for available children, calculates BMI as per health status of child and provides required dietary plan to every child as per BMI. Anganwadi worker needs to maintain all the information nearly in 11-14 different registers without any mistake increases which is overhead for them as it is needed for reporting to higher authorities. Hence this application will provide all the data concise in database at one location Also facility to download any details regarding attendance, BMI of student etc in pdf format Advantages of the Application This "SWAYAMPURN application" is beneficial to society in various directions as below General users or Youngsters can get proper information regarding government scheme under Anganwadi in a state. Anganwadi Workers are managing all their work manually that will get minimized through this application The exchange of information between Anganwadi workers and Supervisor will be ease Estimation of food quantity in Poshan Ahar module will significantly reduce wastage of food. Anganwadi scheme is implemented in root of India i.e. villages due to this app Anganwadi system will be technically improved

title: GIAN Nidhi record 283: Virtual Dressing Room
text:
Project: Virtual Dressing Room
Participants: Aaliya Naeem Ahmed Shaikh; Prachi Pradip Lavekar; Priya Rajendrasingh Pardeshi
Institution: Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies
Abstract: With the introduction of smart phones and tablets we can enjoy online shopping anytime and while sitting in any part of the world. Online shopping has certainly replaced the traditional way of shopping for daily goods and clothing. When we choose online shopping, we get the benefit of credibility. Today, almost every online store offers cash on delivery. Free shipping and discounted prices. These online shopping stores eliminate the hassles of parking. Getting stuck in traffic jams and standing in long queues for billing. They have also benefited those people who always complain of shortage of time. This is the reason, majority of the people have turned to online shopping. Easy access to an attractive price range, prompt customer support, and free home delivery. There is no doubt that these are some of the attractive features that catches the attention of the consumers. Although there is one small issue that could make people loses interest in online shopping, it might not be possible to try-on clothes in such cases. Our motive here is to increase the time efficiency and improve the accessibility of clothes try on by creating a virtual dressing room environment. This virtual dressing room application enables the user to try on virtual clothes through already uploaded photos. A virtual representation of user appears on the screen and the user can select the different clothes through either the various tabs provided in the application or by voice recognition technique. Afterwards, the selected clothes appear on the particular image uploaded by the user, so that he may visualize how she will look in different dresses. This app is also adding security to girls while changing the clothes in malls where there is a chance of having hidden cams.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 284: "Master on Duty Portal"
text:
Project: "Master on Duty Portal"
Participants: Kishor S. Joshi; Shubham V. Salunkhe; Ajay D. Sirsat; Prasanna S. Akkewar
Institution: Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies
Abstract: "Master on Duty" is a web based application for Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya to automate their daily work. Developing this application will reduce manual work for school, MOD and all other staff members to do their day to day activities online. Developing the "Master on Duty" to provide the convenient way to manage and maintain the details of students, staff members, creating and maintaining the exam duty schedule, MOD duty schedule etc. The present system is a manual system or a semi-automated system which requires more time and paper work. Due to its ever growing and competitive nature, the education sector has always been in need of a quality solution to manage and serve the school resources efficiently. IT sector is giving number of solutions to schools like smart classroom, digital learning solutions and school management system to make learning easier and manage school administration effectively. Today educational institution is not limited to imparting education alone, but it is adapting latest trends in IT for improving the quality of education and handling various activities of school including admission's, mod duty management, counting management, residential management, Saturday cleaning competition etc. We offer School an automated solution which simplifies and automates schools administration process. The Master on Duty System is accurate and reliable and can be conveniently accessed from school intranet as well as from the public internet. It is fully browser based web application system.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 285: Tweet Segmentation and Sentiment Analysis
text:
Project: Tweet Segmentation and Sentiment Analysis
Participants: :- Shivani Banswal; Ganesh Ghonsikar; Snehal Sonwane
Institution: Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies
Abstract: Twitter, as a new type of social media, has seen tremendous growth in recent years. It has attracted great interests from both industry and academia. Many private and/or public organizations have been reported to monitor Twitter stream to collect and understand users' opinions about the organizations. Nevertheless, due to the extremely large volume of tweets published every day, it is practically infeasible and unnecessary to listen and monitor the whole Twitter stream. Therefore, targeted Twitter streams are usually monitored instead; each such stream contains tweets that potentially satisfy some information needs of the monitoring organization. Targeted Twitter stream is usually constructed by filtering tweets with user-defined selection criteria depends on the information needs. For example, the criterion could be a region so that users' opinions from that particular region are collected and monitored; it could also be one or more predefined keywords so that opinions about some particular events/topics /products/services can be monitored.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 287: Accident Detection and security System
text:
Project: Accident Detection and security System
Participants: Priya Harale; Kiran Deshmukh; Ankita Wankhede
Institution: Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies
Abstract: Accident Detection And Security System is followed by any sequence of actions defined by the user, such as sending accident details via SMS or e-mail, or making an automated phone call to the emergency services, with a Global Positioning System (GPS) receiver and cellular network connectivity, mainly the Global System for Mobile Communications (GSM), connected to the sensors. We usually come across drink and driving cases where drunk drivers crash their cars under the influence of alcohol causing damage to property and life. So here we propose an innovative system to eliminate such cases. Our proposed system would be constantly monitoring the driver breath by placing it on the driver wheel or somewhere the drivers breath can be constantly monitored by it. So if a driver is drunk and tries to drive the system detects alcohol presence in his/her breathe and locks the engine so that the vehicle fails to start. Human lives can be saved from an accident by detecting an accident before it occurs. But this need advance accurate human detection and also accident detection capability. At present there are several works regarding pre crash detection & avoidance system from obstacle. But we are lacking to priorities crash with human or animals compared to obstacles.These systems have the ability to detect obstacles but the most important to detect human being or animals and avoid them are missing. This sensing technology can reduce a large number of bikers, cyclist and passerby death

title: GIAN Nidhi record 288: IOT Based Soil Irrigatiom Monitoring and Controlling System
text:
Project: IOT Based Soil Irrigatiom Monitoring and Controlling System
Participants: Akshanda Bhavasar; Yogeshwari Bulbule; Sonali Pawar; Radha Waghmare
Institution: Deogiri Institute of Engineering and Management Studies
Abstract: Interconnection of Number of devices through internet describes the Internet of things (IoT). Every object is connected with each other through unique identifier so that data can be transferred without human to human interaction. It allows establishing solutions for better management of natural resources. The Smart objects embedded with sensors enables interaction with the physical and logical worlds according to the Concept of IoT. In this project proposed system is based on IoT that uses real time input data. Smart farm irrigation system uses android phone for remote monitoring soil moisture data, temperature data, humidity data through wireless sensor network and on the basis of above data motor pump automatically on or off. Thingspeak is used for communication between sensor nodes and base station . Real time sensed data handling and demonstration on the server is accomplished using web based ThingSpeak graphical user interface

title: GIAN Nidhi record 295: Furanace Temperature Control using microcontroller.
text:
Project: Furanace Temperature Control using microcontroller.
Participants: Mujawar Paigamber Mahammad; Gulavani Swapnil Ramakant; Kulkarni Amey Krishna; Gaikwad Prasad Mhahadeo
Institution: P.V.P.I.T. – Budhghon
Institution as written in this record: P.V.P.I.T. Budhgaon
Abstract: A description is given of furnace temperature controller which easily adapted for use with electric furnace of widely differing power consumption & design. Three position controls is provided & the furnace temperature can be maintained within (+1/-1)c. This system is user friendly. We can save energy by using this project. This project can be widely used. The system can be adjusted to control the furnace at any temperature from room temperature to 400c & has been found that it is reliable over number of hours for continuous operation. The circuit modification necessary to convert the circuit to controlling the predetermind variation of temperature with time is given. When the temperature of furnace reaches to 400c The controller given commands & it will turn off the flame.when the temperature of furnace reduces to 395c then the controller given commands & it will turn on the flame. To reduce pollution due to incomplete fuel consumption we can using special provision through which have supply fuel from fuel tank through sharp nozzle which supplies oil as sharp spray stream which fire immediately then single drop let & burnes fuel at 100% level. Using this project the effect of overheat is also reduced. In this way loss of energy gets reduced & project gives full efficiency.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 296: AN EXPERIMENTAL INVESTIGATION OF THERMAL PERFORMANCE OF GRAPHITE WATER.
text:
Project: AN EXPERIMENTAL INVESTIGATION OF THERMAL PERFORMANCE OF GRAPHITE WATER.
Participants: Sunil Sawarbandhe; Surendra Rawate; Sarang Gosewade; Roshan Jangam
Institution: Shri K. R. Pandav Polytechnic, Nagpur
Abstract: Graphite is a crystalline forms of carbon. In the graphite each carbon atom is covalently bounded to three carbon atoms to give trigonal geometry in graphite. The parallel layer arranged, which bounded into hexagonal structure after investigating, it is clearly found that the graphite material has outstanding heat transfer properties. The thermal conductivity of the graphite is high like parent material copper and Aluminum. The specific gravity of the graphite is much low as compared to copper. The graphite withstand temperature as high as 3000-degree centrigrade. The hexagonal structure of the graphite material gives open cellular form like foam. Due to such type of structure it posses high thermal conductivity & Thermal Diffusivity. The graphite material is very cheaper than other material. Since it is very essential to replace the other costly material form the various equipment like, water heater, heat exchanger, high power electrical equipments, cooling devices, radiators for reducing the complexity, cost packing size and weight. By using graphite, we designed a water heater. In this water heater the graphite material is arranged in such a way that the water molecules come in more contact with graphite material in order to improve the water heating rate as compared to other type of water heaters. In other type of water heater different material is used for hating purpose, which increased the cost, size, complexity, weight etc. but in case of graphite such problems are totally eliminated because, it has excellent corrosion resistance, non contaminating material, light in weight, reasonable price simple joining in construction and highly heat transfer rate. The operation of water heater is not harmful to the environment and human beings. Also it is a noiseless system.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 297: HYDRAULIC DRESSING ATTACHMENT FOR GRINDER
text:
Project: HYDRAULIC DRESSING ATTACHMENT FOR GRINDER
Participants: Avinash Atmaram Deshmukh; Rajesh Mansaram Jadhav; Sachin Ramchandra Kangane
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Nashik
Institution as written in this record: Government Polytechnic, Nasik
Abstract: Problem in existing machine: dressing of grinding & regulating wheel is done by manually. It causes serrations on surface of th ewheel. It takes more time and more rejection of job. Alternative: manual operation is replaced by hydraulic system. Construction & Working: The input component of the system is vane pump and output component is hydraulic cylinder. Power source is electric motor. The liquid pumped by vane pump through a closed system of hoses which is called as hydraulic circuit. The liquid under pressure is forced into the hydraulic cylinder. The to and fro motion of the piston is obtained by pressurized liquid. For forward stroke of the piston is the pumped on the head end and for return stroke the liquid is pumped on the rod end so the actuation of dresser is done. The direction of flow of liquid is control by the use of direction control valve. The relief valve is used in the circuit to reduce damage during high pressure.

Entities: Avinash Atmaram Deshmukh; Rajesh Mansaram Jadhav; Sachin Ramchandra Kangane; HYDRAULIC DRESSING ATTACHMENT FOR GRINDER; Government Polytechnic, Nashik
Project: HYDRAULIC DRESSING ATTACHMENT FOR GRINDER
Participants: Avinash Atmaram Deshmukh; Rajesh Mansaram Jadhav; Sachin Ramchandra Kangane
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Nashik
Institution as written in this record: Government Polytechnic, Nasik
Abstract: Problem in existing machine: dressing of grinding & regulating wheel is done by manually. It causes serrations on surface of th ewheel. It takes more time and more rejection of job. Alternative: manual operation is replaced by hydraulic system. Construction & Working: The input component of the system is vane pump and output component is hydraulic cylinder. Power source is electric motor. The liquid pumped by vane pump through a closed system of hoses which is called as hydraulic circuit. The liquid under pressure is forced into the hydraulic cylinder. The to and fro motion of the piston is obtained by pressurized liquid. For forward stroke of the piston is the pumped on the head end and for return stroke the liquid is pumped on the rod end so the actuation of dresser is done. The direction of flow of liquid is control by the use of direction control valve. The relief valve is used in the circuit to reduce damage during high pressure.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 300: Adujesttable Compression Ratio & Compression Ignition Engine
text:
Project: Adujesttable Compression Ratio & Compression Ignition Engine
Participants: Shirole Goraksha Nivrutti; Rahane Santosh Prabhakar; Walwe Mangesh Ramesh
Institution: Amrutvahini Polytechnic, Sangamner
Abstract: There is no question that a two stroke internal combustion engine is infinitely simpler to manufacture, has less moving parts & it's principle of operation is less complicated than a four stroke internal combustion engine of equal power. A two stroke engine is timed so that the rotary crankshaft valve hole is opening when the position is going up & creating a negative suction pressure, which drows in air fuel mixture during the compression at top dead center (B.D.C.) creating a positive pressure in the crankshaft. The air fule mixture then travels up the bypass where it scavenges the remaining burnt gases trough exhaust port & files the top chamber of the cylinder ready for the next compression & consequent power stroke. It may be noted that all the four working operation viz-1)induction of air-fuel mixture 2) compression of the full charge. 3) power stroke 4) exhaust of the burnt gases are carried out in one revolution of the crankshaft.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 301: Hydraulic Lifter Trolly
text:
Project: Hydraulic Lifter Trolly
Participants: Chaudhari Ajit Popat; Kherodkar Abhishek; Warkar Sagar
Institution: Bharati Vidyapeeth Institute of Technology
Abstract: The material handling is specialized activity for a modern manufacturing concern. The main purpose of material handling is to achieve an effective & economical handling system right from the introduction of raw material to the time when products are finally put to use. It has been estimated that about 50-75 percent of the cost of the production is spent in material handling. As the majority of time of production is spent in material handling before & after the production. This cost can be reduced by proper selection , operation & maintenance & also lay out of the material handling device, but it cannot be totally eliminated. "Material handling "refers to the moving to the of materials from the storeroom to the machine to the next during the process of manufacturing. the material can be referred as the techniques employed to move , transport , & store or distribute materials with or without the aid of mechanical appliances. Its general objectives can be summarized in the aphorism "Getting the right goods safety to the right place at right time at right cost" Materials handling devices. These devices increase output , improve quality, speed up the delivers & therefore , decrease the cost of production. Since the hydraulic lifter trolley is the material handling device which is used to move the goods from tone space to another space.

text:
Project: Clay Cool (Zero power Refrigerator)
Participants: Lohar sadanand G; Bagwan Nadim I; Bhokare Arshad F
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Miraj
Abstract: The water based refrigerator is the modification of one of the oldest traditional method used in ancient Indian obtains cold water for drinking purposes in summer season. The same approach is used in this project titled" Clay Cool" The refrigerator doesn't use any energy input. Hence, in this era of energy awareness the project provides zero concept of consumption. The refrig is provided with vertical cabinet . This cabinet is used to store the food vegetable etc.The cabinet is provided with water around the walls. The water tank kept on top of refrigerator is provided with small holes water drops on clay bricks The porosity allows craporating effect & hence refrigerating effect. The refrigerator is uniquc concept of it sum as it cool the object without any energy input The refrigerator can used in urban as well as rural areas as we are facing problem of electricity power The refrigerator is purely "Ecofriondly".

title: GIAN Nidhi record 303: Rotating Solar Collector As A Steam Genrator.
text:
Project: Rotating Solar Collector As A Steam Genrator.
Participants: Pratik Mehta; Swapnil Borgaonkar; Ajaykumar Ray; Kirti Godbole
Institution: Priyadarshini Polytechnic, Nagpur
Institution as written in this record: Priyadarshini Polytechnic Nagpur
Abstract: Rotating solar collectors are a new type of solar collector. The boiler consists of two concentric tubes. The inner tube absorbs sunlight and boils water. Thi stube is called the absorber. The outer transparent tube is filled with air and called the cover. The cover is made from transparent plastic. The empty space created between the absorber and cover is called the air layer. The end caps are used to support the cover and insulate the absorber tube. The motor is used to rotate the boiler and the reflexors are used to maximize the sun rays incident on the absorber. The air between the cover and the absorber rotates with the same rotational speed as the cover and the absorber. This causes a centrifugal acceleration to act on the air layer. The effect prevents convection completely when the centrifugal acceleration is greater than the gravitational acceleration. The operation temperature (100 o C) could not be established without the reflectors. Several important conclusions can be drawn from the experiments 1. Rotation prevents convection in the air layer. 2. The electrical power consumption is not prohibative. 3. Overall efficiency is around 46%. 4. The boiler has enough potential to justify further investigation. Economical analyses were performed as well. These analyses showed that any solar boiler should be very lightweight in order to reduce material cost. The rotating solar boiler can be lighter and cheaper than convectional flat plate collectors and evacuated tue collectors.

Entities: Ajaykumar Ray; Kirti Godbole; Pratik Mehta; Swapnil Borgaonkar; Rotating Solar Collector As A Steam Genrator.; Priyadarshini Polytechnic, Nagpur
Project: Rotating Solar Collector As A Steam Genrator.
Participants: Pratik Mehta; Swapnil Borgaonkar; Ajaykumar Ray; Kirti Godbole
Institution: Priyadarshini Polytechnic, Nagpur
Institution as written in this record: Priyadarshini Polytechnic Nagpur
Abstract: Rotating solar collectors are a new type of solar collector. The boiler consists of two concentric tubes. The inner tube absorbs sunlight and boils water. Thi stube is called the absorber. The outer transparent tube is filled with air and called the cover. The cover is made from transparent plastic. The empty space created between the absorber and cover is called the air layer. The end caps are used to support the cover and insulate the absorber tube. The motor is used to rotate the boiler and the reflexors are used to maximize the sun rays incident on the absorber. The air between the cover and the absorber rotates with the same rotational speed as the cover and the absorber. This causes a centrifugal acceleration to act on the air layer. The effect prevents convection completely when the centrifugal acceleration is greater than the gravitational acceleration. The operation temperature (100 o C) could not be established without the reflectors. Several important conclusions can be drawn from the experiments 1. Rotation prevents convection in the air layer. 2. The electrical power consumption is not prohibative. 3. Overall efficiency is around 46%. 4. The boiler has enough potential to justify further investigation. Economical analyses were performed as well. These analyses showed that any solar boiler should be very lightweight in order to reduce material cost. The rotating solar boiler can be lighter and cheaper than convectional flat plate collectors and evacuated tue collectors.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 304: ECONOMICAL DOMESTIC GAS GEYSER
text:
Project: ECONOMICAL DOMESTIC GAS GEYSER
Participants: Prasad D. Vatni; Md. Ibrar Kazi; Shahenawaj Kazi; Pradeep Kamble
Institution: T.B.G. Polytechnic, Ambejogai - 431517
Abstract: ECONOMICAL DOMESTIC GAS GEYSER as name indicate that that geyser means water heater, water heating is daily requirement for domestic purpose. Our main theme is to heat water and use for a domestic purpose. Now a days it is very fast world & we want give the result fastly, so we are made the project which is use less fuel consumption and more efficiency in less time. It require less capital investment as well as very less running cost. It is very useful for middle class people now a days there is so many geysers available in market but they required. One separate gas cylinder but this geyser does not require separate gas cylinder & it is portable. It is very simple in construction. It consist two dome shaped copper plates constructed as to maintain 20 mm gap between them and spiral shaped copper pipe having 12 mm diameter is attached in the middle of the bottom of dome shape copper plate. The inlet port is attached to the dome shaped copper plate, where the cold water is in and from the dome shaped plates the copper pipe come out like as outlet port where the hot water come out. This whole assembly is fixed in the stainless steel body and this is want to kept on the gas stove and tart the burner as well as water flow. Due to principle of heat exchange the water is started heating and hot water is come out and this process is continue so, heated water is continuously come out so, in short our project is economical, portable, and efficient. In the design of our project, we have tried to incorporate a Transformer, an Inverter, a Storage Device controlled by a Microprocessor which is programmed according to the electrical consumption of various devices. It also consists of a representation program which represents the past electrical consumption.

text:
Project: Manufacturing of Ethyl from Dairy Waste
Participants: Harge Mahesh Rajendra; Dixit Mandar Dattatray; Patil Sagar Subrao
Institution: Padmabhushan Vasantdada Patil Institute of Technology
Abstract: The recovery of ethanol from Whey is good example of technology being applied to rectify an environmental problem. The Whey must be cooled from 60 C to 34 C to prevent the bacterial contamination in the first step of process and then the yeast (kluvermyces fragilis or saccharanyces cereviciae) isadded to ferment the lactose in two reactions, first splitting the lactose in intothe two sugars of which it is composed and secondfermenting the sugars to ethanol.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 310: Automation In Bottling Process
text:
Project: Automation In Bottling Process
Participants: Chavan Harshal C; Chaudhari Smita M; Patil Rohini U; Dharmashale Vaishali B; Ahire Kanchan H
Institution: Government Poly. Mumbai
Abstract: The bottles are kept manually on the slat type conveyor belt the bottles are sensed at particular position using plain lever limit switches the bottles are filled unto the set ping using function of ti8mer in the plc the bottles are sealed using the Guala caps, which are the latest trend of caps used to stop piracy. Institution: P.V.P.I.T. – Budhghon

Abstract: As the entire world is rapidly switching towards the new technology. The digital designing used in must now days. So we are going to introduce digital technology which is used in water tank. In the existing system level of water is measured by traditional way. PH of the water is also measured by the chemical reactions. Status of the motor is controlled by manual power. In this project we use PH sensors, Level sensors, Microcontroller and LCD display. PH sensor is used for the measurement hardness of water level sensors placed at the top middle & bottom stage of tank. This working is controlled by microcontroller. This microcontroller signal given to computer through Max232 which converted available signal into compatable signal. This software is developed in Vistual Basic 6.0 This data is given into LAN & anybody can gate this data through net at main office.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 312: Highway speed security system
text:
Project: Highway speed security system
Participants: Sumeet Meharchandani; Abhishek Malvankar; Akshay Jadhav
Institution: Institute of Technology, Viharnagar
Abstract: It works on the principle of batch counter, which is basically a speed checker. This speed checker will come handy for the highway traffic police as it consist of sound alarm, a digital display of speed with the digital image of vehicle. This speed checker will sense the speed of the vehicle running on the highway & if the speed of the vehicle is more than the maximum permissible speed on highway (which can be programmed on the model), than the sound alarm will start & the digital image of the vehicle will be taken. The speed will be displayed on the digital panel. Side-by-side it also counts the number of the vehicle passed from the highway. This will automatically sense the problem in the region of the sensor i.e. if any vehicle stops in front of the sensor.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 313: Control & security on ship
text:
Project: Control & security on ship
Participants: Adivarekar Ashwini Ashok; Bendre Vibha Vijay; Desale Vishakha V; Ingole Aarti Sudhakar
Institution: Government polytechnic Mumbai
Institution as written in this record: Govt. Polytechnic, Mumbai
Abstract: 230 V ac is applied to the SMPS & get the O/P in dc, to the VCC of the 89c51 which is core based on 8051 & family. Here the reset pin is also their which is if we applied the any pulse to this pin then the microcontroller is again Reset. When the all signal is inputed to the ADC0809 then the all is goes to microcontroller & then by the program. Inside the microcontroller is detected any default between set value & getted value. Difference between getted value controlled by program. The program written in the microcontroller in the form of ROM chip. For more program location E'PROM is used. Hence the all parameters are detected & controlled & given to computer.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 314: Two channel oscilloscope using "PIC controllers"
text:
Project: Two channel oscilloscope using "PIC controllers"
Participants: Thakare Dhanashree Santosh; Thube Rohini Balkrishna; Pawar Sunil Ukhardu; Gosavi Deepak; Kapse Sarika Uttamrao; Watwe Gayatri Deepak
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Nashik
Institution as written in this record: Govt. polytechnic, Nashik
Abstract: PC that operates at up to 10KHz with +16v input vtg. It has much more improved feature than PC based oscilloscope & LED scope for audio servicing publish in Dec. 2002 the oscilloscope uses to PIC18F 2550. From microchip as the main controller, which makes the oscilloscope compact as there is no. need of additional power supply for the entire circuit board. The heart of this oscilloscope is USB 2.0 complaint microcontroller PIC 18F2550 from microchip. You can also use PIC18F2445 in place of PIC18F2550. Specification of this microcontroller are given here in the box the microcontroller has a USB 2.0 complaint transreceiver & a CPU running up to 12MIPS. Two channel oscilloscope using PIC controller on PC based from Microchip technology is an analog programmable gain amplifier that is well suited to driving analog to digital converter & analog I/P to PIC microcontroller gain is 1:1 to 32:1 & features of PIC 18F2550 that programming flash memory 32KB. 2kB RAM & 256 byte EFPROM.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 315: Identity detector & automatic toll controller
text:
Project: Identity detector & automatic toll controller
Participants: Dhamdhere Sachin Kundlic; Giri Pawan Ranjit; Shrivat Ganesh Ramchandra; Satav Yogesh
Institution: S. R. G. S. Institute of technology, Pune
Abstract: IDATC its application, standardization & innovation are constantly changing. Its adoption it still relatively new & hence there are many features of the technology that are not well understood by general people. Development in IDATC technology continue to yield memory capacities, wider reading ranges & faster processing. It's highly unlikely that the technology will ultimately replace bar code even with the inevitable reduction in raw material coupled with economics of scale; the integrated circuit in an RF tag will never be coast effective's bar code label. However IDATC will continue to grow in its established niches where bar code labels. However IDATC will continue to grow in its established niches where bar code or other optical technologies aren't effective. If some standards commonality is achieved, where by IDATC equipment from different manufacturers can be used interchangeably. The market will very likely grow exponentially. This project tries to set out the basic information about application on RFID in our day to day life in a simple format that can be understood by everyone.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 317: GSM based mobile health check – up kit
text:
Project: GSM based mobile health check – up kit
Participants: Lakhapati Kunal; Desai Pratik; Mistry Paras; Pillay Karthika
Institution: Thakur Polytechnic
Abstract: Project comprises of 2 sensors – a thermocouple for temperature sensing & a combination of LDR & LED for heart beat sensing. If the recorded values do not match with the preset reference values then the microcontroller sends a pulse to the GSM modern & it sends a message to the pre-assigned number so as to indicate an abnormal reading.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 320: Digital fuel meter
text:
Project: Digital fuel meter
Participants: Patil Avadhut Pandurang; Patil Ranjeet Shahaji; Bhat-Shinde Omkar Pandurang; Patil Deepak; Chougale Nilesh Mahadev
Institution: Institute of Civil and Rural Engineering, Gargoti
Institution as written in this record: Institution of civil & rural engineering Gargoti
Abstract: In our project we have to use simple techniques. In maruti 800 or any two wheeler motor cycle the level of fuel is indicates in analog form but in this techniques we do not understand exact level of fuel. So overcome this problem we make our project. In our project the float sensor are used. Which change its space according to level of fuel. The float sensor is like potentiometer. It's resistance changes according to level of fuel. It is used in wheaston bridge in one arm. One arm gives input vtg. & another arm gives the output vtg. Which fed to differential amplifier. The differential amplifier amplifies difference of inputs & produces resultant output vtg which is in analog form. Then it fed to A.D. convertor which converts the vtg. Into digital form & its output fed to 89c51 microcontroller which process & produces output which gives to display & display the exact level of fuel.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 322: Speed checker for highway using microprocessor
text:
Project: Speed checker for highway using microprocessor
Participants: Shingade Nitin V; Kumbhar Ganesh M; Jadhav Vijay T; Upadhye Vishal A
Institution: Walchand college of engineering, Sangli
Abstract: Now a days on the highway accidents accruing due to speed violation. To avoids accidents and limit speed of vehicle for their permitted lane. In our project the distance keep constant (10m) & the time is proportional to the vehicle crosses these 10m distance two transmitter & receiver pair installed on highway 10m apart. When vehicle crosses 1 st Beam then counter starts & vehicle crosses 2 nd Beam then counter stop counter count the no. of pulses. These purpose we are use IC 8253 (16 bit counter) these no. of pulse interfaced to up using interfacing ckt. & compare these No & standard No which is already stored in the register or memory location by using software & when the comparator o/p zero then these no taking into consideration & display final o/p in terms of speed.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 323: Embedded webserver for temperature control
text:
Project: Embedded webserver for temperature control
Participants: Pawar Kiran Subhash; Sharma Vikas Narad; Shedge Vaibhav Janardhan; Kane Dedar; Kulkarni Parag Arvind
Institution: Pimpri – Chinchwad Polytechnic
Abstract: In our project front end module consist of PC connected to internet & running a web server such as internet explorer. The user can be authenticated via password. By sending control signal or information through internet we can control any appliance or equipment which is used in industry or at home or anywhere. We have used temperature sensor. These temperature sensor senses the temperature of room. This temperature sensors are connected to microcontroller via 12c bus. By using lamp and fan we can increase or decrease the temperature of room. And we can control this temperature via the internet. For all those control actions we have developed an embedded web server for an application of temperature control. The word embedded is used because we have embedded a microcontroller with TCP/IP stack. It simply means transfer control protocol. Protocol means basic set of rules those are used in networking. We have chosen internet for control, because Ethernet interface makes it duplex, high speed, highly cost effective & easily available.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 324: Breath alcohol detector
text:
Project: Breath alcohol detector
Participants: Rogye Shweta Prakash; Pawar Mansi Pradip; Sanas Poonam Prakas; Rahate Madhavi Balu
Institution: S. N. D. T. Women's University
Abstract: The Breath Alcohol Detector detects the Breath Alcohol Content (BAC) of human body. By simply blowing into mouthpiece it starts to takes the sample of person's own foul. If there is alcohol present then it will detect by the alcohol sensor & that content will be displayed on the display in PPM form. It is able to overcome on crude estimation which are used to know the BAC. There are some method to determine it like urine test which may takes the time or by standing on one leg the person has to touch the nose which may cause an injury, hence our product is very easy to operate & it display the content very quickly. Here, we have to set one reference point & if content is more than that then LED will glow & buzzer will create sound for indication. It can be used at hospital & at travel agency. It can be also use at traffic police station, for this purpose we have to set the reference point which is an unsafe to drive. The product can also work on battery & it is in compact size.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 327: Intelligent Traffic Light Control System Using PLC
text:
Project: Intelligent Traffic Light Control System Using PLC
Participants: Awade Prathamesh; Hulyalkar Rohan; Mujumdar Prasad
Institution: MAEER's Sri Savitribai Phule Polytechnic, Pune
Abstract: This system is fully controlled by Programmable Logic Controller (P.L.C.). P.L.C. will control the sequence and timing of the signals at various squares depending upon the request as per the appropriate situation. This system is programmed in such a way that, it provides priority to a particular group of vehicles to go without having to stop at the intermediate squares of the road. It means that particular time slot is assigned to each square by calculating time required to travel between different square. According to particular assigned time slot of each square, one by one green signal gets "ON" in order to provide continuous flow of traffic.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 332: Smart security system
text:
Project: Smart security system
Participants: Joshi Swapnil Shrikant; Darange Rushikesh Madhukar; Langhe Pravin Prakash; Bhosale Vaibhav Dattatraya
Institution: All India Shri Shivaji Memorial Society's Polytechnic
Abstract: Now a days electronic security system is become more essential so that, we decide to do project in this field. Our system has there layer security system, first is key pad entry, then electronic lock & sensors. In this system if key & codeward match, with predetermined code ward then only individual can get entry. In this security system we use temperature sensor, metal sensor, smoke sensor & motion sensor. All this sensors are directly interface with microcontroller & microcontroller will take control action. The highlight of the project is the motion sensor. This type of sensor uses pyrometer type of highly sensitive sensors that defect body heat & are smart because of the use of the microcontroller. The alarm is supplemented by a voice o/p circuit to warn of critical situations. The o/p which is activated in case of certain emergencies consist of an alarm circuit of a smart automatic dialer. Connected to the telephone line. Depending the type of emergency situation raised the microcontroller initiates a call to the concerned authorites such as the police etc.

Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Aurangabad
Abstract: Flood Intimation System works on Microcontroller based interface with computer & GSM Mobile Technology. Microcontroller is heart of the system. Namely high level sensor, medium level sensor, low level sensor. All these sensors have different functions. Because of voltage drop across wire & microcontroller understand only digital input, so we have to use signal conditioner.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 335: Tripping sequence recorder cum indicator
text:
Project: Tripping sequence recorder cum indicator
Participants: Chandiwala Vali Mohammed; Pranav Doshi; Chauhan Dhruv; Ebrahim Habiya
Institution: Babasaheb Gawde Institute of Technology
Abstract: In applications like power stations & continuous process plants, a protection system is used to trip a faulty system to prevent damages & ensure the overall safety of the personnel & machinery. But this often results in multiple or cascade tripping of a number of sub-units. Looking at the tripped units does not reveal the cause of failure. It is therefore very important to determine the sequence of events that have occurred in order to exactly trace out the cause of failure & revive the system with minimal loss of time. The project that we have made stores the tripping sequence in a system with upto eight units/blocks. It uses an auxiliary relay contact point in each unit that closes whenever tripping of the corresponding unit occurs. Such contact points can be identified easily, especially in systems using Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs). This circuit records tripping of up to eight blocks & displays the order in which they tripped.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 336: PC based flexible web camera
text:
Project: PC based flexible web camera
Participants: Verma Pramod; Prem Prakash
Institution: Padmashri Dr. Vitthalrao Vikhe Patil Institute of tech., & engg., Pravarangar
Abstract: This project is a software-hardware based project. It could be the best alternative for CCTV system recorders, surveillance or security cameras. This camera provides 360 view over horizontal plane and 300* view over vertical plane i.e. by covering X-Y plane and Y-Z plane, camera can take images & can perform audio / video recording anywhere in its 3-D surrounding space.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 338: Electro guard ( Car lock to unlock system)
text:
Project: Electro guard ( Car lock to unlock system)
Participants: Mihir Prabhaka; Kartik Vinod Parmar; Shehbaz Aziz Chowgule
Institution: Radio electric institute, Mumbai
Abstract: Electro guard is a car lock to unlock system, which is used to overcome the drawbacks present in existing car auto locking systems.Basically it consists of sensors for level, smoke & temperature detection. When these sensors are sensed in their desired sequence the output signal is used to operate the relays that will drive both the motors & the door will get unlock & the glasses will slide down.

text:

Participants: Nair Sreenath Sreeraj; Inamdar Mazhar Asad; hadange Nilesh Shantaram; Chandgude Girish Ganpatrao

Institution as written in this record: K. B. P. Polytechnic, Kopargaon
Abstract: Many circuits of water level controller have been available. In all those, probe type sensor is used for level sensing. In this project we use the capacitive sensor as the bagas sensors. The system is used as the bagas filling plants also the number of bagas pots fills can be counted. By using micro-controller based system it becomes sophisticated and flexible for further modifications. This system provide timer mode and level mode of a operation since LCD display is used and number of bagas pots are counted on LCD display the machine efficiency be noted. It is designed and developed using latest technology. It is mainly design for home-industry and further applications are sugar industry, tea plants, and pharmaceutical and chemical industries etc. The main advantage of this project is cost very low. It is being designed by latest technology sophisticated and flexible.
