title: GIAN Nidhi record 341: "Shirodhara" an Ayurvedic medical treatment with automisation.
text:
Project: "Shirodhara" an Ayurvedic medical treatment with automisation.
Participants: Lakde Amol Dattatray; Garge Uday Vilasrao
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Amravati
Abstract: Shirodhara it is the word which deals with an Ayurvedic treatment. In this treatment the medicine which is used for treatment is falls on the forehead of the patient. The medicine is in the from of fluid. Drop by drop the flied is falls on the forehead of patient. The persons who suffering from the diseases such as skin disease, psychological problem are treated. In this project, which we have performed, the procedure is made automatic. For the circulation purpose of fluid the copper tube is used. With the help of motor the fluid is circulated through the copper tube. The first valve is nearer to the motor. The purpose of that valve is to control forced of fluid because of the motor pressure. The another valve is the Electronic solid state valve. The electronic valve is operated automatically with the help of Digital Temperature Controller with sensor. A heating coil is wound on the copper tube. The tamp. of coil is controlled by digital temperature controller. The required value of tamp. of fluid is first set up then with the help of the sensor the temp. of heating coil is made equal to the required temp. The temp. of coil is equal to set up value, the Electronic valve is automatically open & then the fluid start to falls on the forehead of patient. Because of the sensor & digital temperature controller the temp. will control, if the temp. is equal to set up value of the heating coil will be off automatically. When the temp. of fluid starts decreasing then coil will gets ON automatically, starts heating the fluid. There is no chance t increase of temp. beyond the set up value.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 344: Design & fabrication of sensor based escalator
text:
Project: Design & fabrication of sensor based escalator
Participants: Mr. Shirbhate S. S; Burnure V.V. Dhake G.P; Datar G.S; Ihare
Institution: Jawaharlal Darda Institute of Engg and Tech. Yavatmal
Institution as written in this record: Jawaharlal Darda Institute of Eng. & Tech
Abstract: Whenever a person approaches the up going escalator & steps in the weight sensor. The signal is catches by the programmed IC & it starts the corresponding motor to run the escalator via the gearbox. The escalator starts running & the person also steps in the escalator. The escalator run for a specific time interval as provided by the 'variable timer'. This variable timer is manually adjustable. The adjustment is carried out by trial and error basis according to the length of the escalator & thus the specific timer interval is set. Thus specific time interval should be sufficient enough to allow the escalator run into approximately ¾ length or 0.75 revolution of the entire escalator belt.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 349: Manufacturing of ethanol from MSW
text:
Project: Manufacturing of ethanol from MSW
Participants: Pankaj D. Junghare; Dhundiraj P. Deshpande; Alok Khanzode; Avinash Belgamwar; Sameer Bhore; Devidas Mahajan
Institution: Jawaharlal Darda Institute of Engg and Tech. Yavatmal
Institution as written in this record: Jawaharlal Darda Institute of Engg. & Tech., Yavatmal
Abstract: Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) is the waste generated in a community with the expectation of industrial & agricultural waste. Therefore, treatment of these waste is an important component of an integrated solid waste management strategy & reduces both the toxicity & volume of MSW requiring final disposal in land fill. The representative average molecular formula for organic waste is C6H10O4. The anaerobic decomposition of organic material yields principally methane (CH4), Carbon dioxide (CO2), & the solid compost material that can be used as a solid conditioner. The ethanol manufacture is done by fermentation. Yeasts & Bacteria are unicellular and of very small dimensions. They are used for fermentation of MSW. Other byproducts are acetaldehyde, fuel oil etc. Rapid industrialization & urbanization has increased the pollution. Instead of land filling this fraction, it is advisable, both from economic & environmental view points, to recover energy from the non-recyclable, combustible materials instead of consigning them to land fills.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 351: Design of Industrial load Management using Automatic Control with Zigbee Wireless Technology
text:
Project: Design of Industrial load Management using Automatic Control with Zigbee Wireless Technology
Participants: Ms.Pratiksha Bhusari; Sachet Shambharkar
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Institution as written in this record: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engg. & Tech
Abstract: Today's world is facing deficiency of getting the regular power. In order to cope up with this demand load shedding is done. This paper presents the solution to overcome/limit the problems regarding power contingencies, load shedding, failure in providing sufficient power towards the load center, etc. by distributing the load in three categories low, medium, high. This paper contains the controller which is used to check the load demand and as per set value it will turn on/off the load. In this paper the ZIGBEE is used for data transmission as well as communication between transmitter and receiver as per IEEE 802.15.4 Standard. The controller is programmed in such a way that, the supply to load will never be zero. To overcome the problem of power distribution this paper provides an overview of wireless sensor network by managing the equal power distribution by using Zigbee network sensor

text:
Project: Microcontroller Integrated Crop Management system by using Solar Panel
Participants: Mr Tanu Mazumdar; Sanket Pureddiwar
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Institution as written in this record: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engg. & Tech
Abstract: The smart irrigation system is developed to optimize water use for agricultural crops. The system has a distributed wireless network of soil-moisture and temperature sensors placed in the root zone of the plants. In addition, a GSM module is provided which sends the values of parameters through message. An algorithm is developed with values of temperature and soil moisture that is programmed into microcontroller-based gateway to control water quantity. The system is powered by solar panels and has a duplex communication link based on a cellular-Internet interface that allowed for data inspection and irrigation schedulingKeywords: EXR file format, stego HDR.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 354: Error Detection in Majority Logic Decoding of Euclidean Geometry Low Density Parity Check (EG-LDPC) Codes.
text:
Project: Error Detection in Majority Logic Decoding of Euclidean Geometry Low Density Parity Check (EG-LDPC) Codes.
Participants: Ms. Sana Sheikh
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Institution as written in this record: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engg. & Tech
Abstract: Error detection in memory applications was proposed to accelerate the majority logic decoding of difference set low density parity check codes. This is useful as majority logic decoding can be implemented serially with simple hardware but requires a large decoding time. For memory applications, this increases the memory access time. The method detects whether a word has errors in the first iterations of majority logic decoding, and when there are no errors the decoding ends without completing the rest of the iterations. Since most words in a memory will be error free, the average decoding time is greatly reduced. In this brief, the application of a similar technique to a class of Euclidean geometry low density parity check (EG-LDPC) codes that are one step majority logic decodable. Extensive simulation results are given to accurately estimate the probability of error detection for different code sizes and numbers of errors.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 355: Robust Face Recognisation Using Largest Matching Area for Illumination and Occlusion
text:
Project: Robust Face Recognisation Using Largest Matching Area for Illumination and Occlusion
Participants: Ms.Akshata Bansod
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Institution as written in this record: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engg. & Tech
Abstract: While there has been an enormous amount of research on face recognition under pose/illumination/expression changes and image degradations, problems caused by occlusions attracted relatively less attention. Facial occlusions, due, for example, to sunglasses, hat/cap, scarf, and beard, can significantly deteriorate performances of face recognition systems in uncontrolled environments such as video surveillance. The goal of this paper is to explore face recognition in the presence of partial occlusions, with emphasis on real-world scenarios (e.g., sunglasses and scarf). In this paper, we propose an efficient approach which consists of first analysing the presence of potential occlusion on a face and then conducting face recognition on the nonoccluded facial regions based on selective local Gabor binary patterns. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art works including KLD-LGBPHS, S-LNMF, OA-LBP, and RSC. Furthermore, performances of the proposed approach are evaluated under illumination and extreme facial expression changes provide also significant results.

Entities: Ms.Akshata Bansod; Robust Face Recognisation Using Largest Matching Area for Illumination and Occlusion; Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Project: Robust Face Recognisation Using Largest Matching Area for Illumination and Occlusion
Participants: Ms.Akshata Bansod
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Institution as written in this record: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engg. & Tech
Abstract: While there has been an enormous amount of research on face recognition under pose/illumination/expression changes and image degradations, problems caused by occlusions attracted relatively less attention. Facial occlusions, due, for example, to sunglasses, hat/cap, scarf, and beard, can significantly deteriorate performances of face recognition systems in uncontrolled environments such as video surveillance. The goal of this paper is to explore face recognition in the presence of partial occlusions, with emphasis on real-world scenarios (e.g., sunglasses and scarf). In this paper, we propose an efficient approach which consists of first analysing the presence of potential occlusion on a face and then conducting face recognition on the nonoccluded facial regions based on selective local Gabor binary patterns. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art works including KLD-LGBPHS, S-LNMF, OA-LBP, and RSC. Furthermore, performances of the proposed approach are evaluated under illumination and extreme facial expression changes provide also significant results.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 356: To Combining Left and Right Palmprint Images for More Accurate Personal Identi?cation
text:
Project: To Combining Left and Right Palmprint Images for More Accurate Personal Identi?cation
Participants: Ms. Sarika Pimple
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Institution as written in this record: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engg. & Tech
Abstract: Multibiometrics can provide higher identi?cation accuracy than single biometrics, so it is more suitable for some real-world personal identi?cation applications that need high-standard security. Among various biometrics technologies, palmprint identi?cation has received much attention because of its good performance. Combining the left and right palmprint images to perform multibiometrics is easy to implement and can obtain better results. However, previous studies did not explore this issue in depth. In this paper, we proposed a novel framework to perform multibiometrics by comprehensively combining the left and right palmprint images. This framework integrated three kinds of scores generated from the left and right palmprint images to perform matching score-level fusion. The ?rst two kinds of scores were, respectively, generated from the left and right palmprint images and can be obtained by any palmprint identi?cation method, whereas the third kind of score was obtained using a specialized algorithm proposed in this paper. As the proposed algorithm carefully takes the nature of the left and right palmprint images into account, it can properly exploit the similarity of the left and right palmprints of the same subject. Moreover, the proposed weighted fusion scheme allowed perfect identi?cation performance to be obtained in comparison with previous palmprint identi?cation methods.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 357: A Methodology For Extracting Standing Human Bodies From Single Images Using Multi Segmentation
text:
Project: A Methodology For Extracting Standing Human Bodies From Single Images Using Multi Segmentation
Participants: Ms. Avanti Pawar
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Institution as written in this record: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engg. & Tech
Abstract: Extraction of the human body in unconstrained still images is challenging due to several factors, including shading, image noise, occlusions, background clutter, the high degree of human body deformability, and the unrestricted positions due to in and out of the image plane rotations. Knowledge about the human body region can benefit various tasks, such as determination of the human layout, recognition of actions from static images, and sign language recognition. Human body segmentation and silhouette extraction have been a common practice when videos are available in controlled environments, where background information is available, and motion can aid the segmentation through background subtraction. In static images, however, there are no such cues, and the problem of silhouette extraction is much more challenging, especially when we are considering complex cases Moreover, methodologies that are able to work at a frame level can also work for sequences of frames, and facilitate existing methods for action recognition based on silhouette features and body skeletonization.

text:

Participants: Ms. Shweta Mehar
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Institution as written in this record: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engg. & Tech
Abstract: The aim of our research paper is to represent our project which makes human driving safer and to overcome accidents. This project is developed by integrating alcohol sensor with Arduino board. Arduino processor ATmega328 is able to handle more functions than conventional microcontrollers. The alcohol sensor used in this project is MQ3 which to detect the alcohol content in human breath. Since sensor has fine sensitivity range around 2 meters, it can suit to any vehicle and can easily be hidden from the suspects. This project is fitted inside the vehicle. The project is designed for the safety of people sitting inside the vehicle. Arduino ATmega328, alcohol detector, MQ3, LCD, Buzzer.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 359: Design and Development of Solar Based Android Controlled Pesticide Dispenser
text:
Project: Design and Development of Solar Based Android Controlled Pesticide Dispenser
Participants: Ms. Aboli Moroney
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Institution as written in this record: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engg. & Tech
Abstract: Pesticide dispensing systems in agriculture are becoming technology-driven due to the human health hazards involved in spraying toxic chemicals. Conventional pesticide dispensing systems are operated by humans in the agricultural fields. In this paper, we present design and development of solar based android controlled pesticide dispensing robot. The design of the system includes three parts: design of solar charging system, android pesticide spraying system and pesticide flow control system. Shortage of non renewable fuel is an upcoming global issue, so renewable solar energy has replaced non renewable energy. Solar charge circuit is designed to charge the system. This pesticide dispensing robot in android controlled mode is controlled using remote buttons on android app. We use Bluetooth as communication media to interface controller to the android. Pesticide flow quantity is controlled through android mobile while the robot is moving in the path defined by the user. The proposed pesticide dispensing system efficiently covers the plants evenly with spray in set dosage using the concept of PWM.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 360: IMPROVING THE POWER SYSTEM PERFORMANCE USING FACTS DEVICES WITH HARDWARE APPROACH
text:
Project: IMPROVING THE POWER SYSTEM PERFORMANCE USING FACTS DEVICES WITH HARDWARE APPROACH
Participants: Pranjali R. Nirvikar
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Institution as written in this record: Tulsiramji Gaikwad Patil College of Engineering & Technology
Abstract: Abstract: The project entails simulating a model of a complete FACTS controller using STATCOM device. FACTS devices like STATCOM, it is designed based on voltage source converter (VSC) electronic device with gate turn off thyristor and dc capacitor coupled with step down transformer tied to a transmission line. The complete model either converts ac power into dc power by VSC as a control rectifier or convert the dc power into ac power by VSC as a PWM converter, during the time of transient faults especially when there is any change in reactive power. STATCOM provide controlled VAr compensator for grid voltage support. STATCOM can be designed to also act as an active filter to absorb system harmonics. The main objective of power project is deals with the reactive power compensation that is when reactive power in the power system is decreased then STATCOM will inject the reactive power in the power system network and when surplus reactive power available in the power system is increased beyond some limits then STATCOM will absorb the reactive power. The capacitor will charged or discharged according to control logic applied to VSC in control rectifier mode or inverter mode as per the reactive power variation in the power system. For prevention of large fluctuation in dc due to variation in ac system voltage maintaining the direct voltage near the rated value and prevention of commutation failure in inverter, we use the PWM method for firing of the VSC

For prevention of large fluctuation in dc due to variation in ac system voltage maintaining the direct voltage near the rated value and prevention of commutation failure in inverter, we use the PWM method for firing of the VSC

Abstract: Design, construct & maintain structures to perform at earthquake exposure up to the expectations.Earthquake is a natural phenomenon occurring with all uncertainties. Among all the natural calamities, the most devastating one is earthquake. During the earthquake, ground motion occurs in a random fashion, both horizontally & vertically in all direction regarding from epicenter. These ground motions cause structures to vibrate & induce inertia forces on them. Hence structures in such locations need to be suitably designed & detail to ensure stability & hence we take this project Their procedure is as follows:- In this project, we made earthquake proof building for (G+1) floor.In this building we use 'BASE ISOLATION' & 'SHEAR WALL' & DAMPERS' technique.This base isolation is provided at substructure between column and plinth beam and shear wall is provided at place of wall.For that we made a model, For making building we took fabric sheet & cut it according to shape & size.Then, were taken springs as a base isolation & provide it between plinth slab & bottom slab. After that, we made shake table& for making shake table we used wood, rods & motor.Thus the model was prepared –Advantages- It prevents structure from collapse It gives people a sense of security.It makes structure stable to stand the expectation magnitude of earthquake.Social Impact – Earthquake is a natural phenomenon occurring with all uncertainties. India is a large country. Nearly two third of its area is earthquake zone. Most loss of life & property due to earthquakes occur due to collapse of build So, this technique can be use at these earthquake zone areas & due to this the loss of life & property will be prevent.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 363: "UNDERGROUND CABLE FAULT DISTANCE LOCATOR WITH ALARM SYSTEM"
text:
Project: "UNDERGROUND CABLE FAULT DISTANCE LOCATOR WITH ALARM SYSTEM"
Participants: Pushpak y. Paunikar
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Institution as written in this record: Tulsiramji Gaikwad Patil College of Engineering & Technology
Abstract: Due to the faults the cables get damage which affects the resistance in the cable. If it allowed to persist, this can lead to voltage breakdown. To locate the fault in the cable, the cable must tested for faults. This uses the simple concept of OHMs law. The current vary depending upon the length fault of the cable. This is assembled with a set of resistors representing cable length and fault creation is made by set of switches at every known kilometer (km). The fault occurring at which distance and which phase is displayed on a 16X2 LCD display which is interfaced with the microcontroller. The program is run into ROM of microcontroller. The power supply consists of a step down transformer which is 230/12V, which step down the voltage to 12V AC. This is converted into DC using a Bridge rectifier. The pulsating dc voltage is removed using a capacitive filter and it is then regulated to +5V using a voltage regulator LM7805 which is (+5V) required for the operation of the microcontroller and other components.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 364: 'AUTOMATIC CONTROLLING OF WATER IRRIGATION'
text:
Project: 'AUTOMATIC CONTROLLING OF WATER IRRIGATION'
Participants: Shehal Gondane
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Institution as written in this record: Tulsiramji Gaikwad Patil College of Engineering & Technology
Abstract: The project we have undertaken is " Automatic controlling of Water Irrigation System " . This project is taken up as India is an agriculture oriented country and the rate at which water resources are deflecting as dangerous threat hence there is need of smart and efficient way of irrigation . The motivation of this project come from the countries where economy is base on agriculture and the climate condition lead to lag of rains and scarcity of water . The farmers working in the farm land are solely dependent on the rain bore wells for irrigation of the land. Even if the farm land has a water pump manual intervention by farmer is required to turn the pump on/off whenever needed. In the world advance electronics, life of human beings should be simpler hence to make like more simpler and convenient, We have made this system. A model of controlling irrigation facilities to help millions people. This model uses sensor technologies with microcontroller to make smart switching device. The model shows the basic switching mechanism of water motor using sensors from any part of field by sensing the moisture present in soil. In this project we have implemented sensor which detect the humidity in the soil (agriculture field) and supply water to the field which has water requirement. The project is 8051 microcontroller base design which control water supply and the field to be irrigated. There are sensors present in each field which are not activated till water is present on the field.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 366: "UNIQUE POWER BANK FOR E-CART"
text:
Project: "UNIQUE POWER BANK FOR E-CART"
Participants: Shubham Gomase
Institution: Tulsiramji Gaikwad-Patil College of Engineering and Technology
Institution as written in this record: Tulsiramji Gaikwad Patil College of Engineering & Technology
Abstract: Rickshaw are three wheel battery operated vehicle, since are battery powered have zero emission, it is to be much better than other rickshaw as they are consider almost pollution free since the battery charging cost is for lower than any other fuel. E-rickshaw are usually slow in speed and it runs around 30-35 kemps and thus, it is unable to meet the speed of other vehicle. It is not a prepared mode of transportation in emergency period, as discharging the battery and no one mode are available to travel continue and so many are problems are faced at this emergency condition. As we are using dynamo and solar panel to generate the power and charge the secondary battery and give the emergency back-up to the E-rickshaw due to these no such problems are faced such low speed, failure of E-rickshaw at any placed. As we in that e-rickshaw implemented sensor in between such feet's to sense a obstacle to avoid accidents. This article is about electric auto rickshaw whose only means of propulsion is one or more electric motors. For human-powered cycle rickshaw (pedicels') equipped with both pedals and an auxiliary electric motors, see electric-assist cycle rickshaw. Electric rickshaws (also known as electric tuk-tuks or e-rickshaws have been becoming more popular in some cities since 2008 as an alternative to auto rickshaw and pulled rickshaws because of their low fuel cost, and less human effort compared to pulled rickshaws. The electric automobile did not easily develop into viable means of transportation.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 367: AUTOMATIC PESTICIDE MIXING AND SPRAYING ROBOT
text:
Project: AUTOMATIC PESTICIDE MIXING AND SPRAYING ROBOT
Participants: SHRADDHA RAUT; NIKITA BAGUL; AARTI SOLANKE
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Compared of spraying pesticides manually outdoors. the environment is more closed and has a high temperature, humidity and so on for operating the spray work in green- house. In order to protect the labor and reduce labor intensity, we develop a project for automatic pesticide mixing and spraying robot specially used in green-house as well as in agricultural purposes and in chemical industries. Our robot is basically controlled by Bluetooth module for the movement of robot. Designing the basic robot which works on the actual field with the pair of Bluetooth transmitter and receiver pair According to the commands received by controller it operates specifically on the instructions which we are giving in the programming. The consistent output of our robotic system enhances the quality of product.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 368: 3D MODELLING ROBOT
text:
Project: 3D MODELLING ROBOT
Participants: DHANASHREE KULKARNI; MANJIRI KULKARNI; SHIVANI MAHAJAN
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Robots are becoming more and more common in daily lives showing up in the farm or everything from children's toys to robotic vacuum cleaners to home security robots; robots have been doing outo-mated tasks in Factories for decades. We develop Tele operated robotic 3-D mapping (TeRoMs) system' which enables efficient human-guided mapping of remote environments for realistic rendering and visualization Robot specifically deals with autonomous robots which use sensors (in this case ultrasonic) to create a 3D map of their surroundings Autonomous robot systems depend highly on their ability to recover durable spatial model of their surroundings from sensors information and use it in robot planning and control All these abilities enable the robot la make its own temporary decisions based on the data collected by the sensor. The data received from the sensors can be used to create a 2D/3D model for later use in different research programs and studies. Initially the sensors will used for gathering data that will produce a 2D image of its surroundings. The robot can be used for mapping known as well as unknown indoor or outdoor locations based on its need.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 369: AUTONOMOUS VISUAL CONTROL WITH POWER SAVING ALGORITHM FOR SMART BUILDING
text:
Project: AUTONOMOUS VISUAL CONTROL WITH POWER SAVING ALGORITHM FOR SMART BUILDING
Participants: SUMEET KAKARWAL; BHUSHAN JADHAV; TEJAS JADHAV; KEDAR PATIL
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: The main aim of this system is to analyse and control the resource utilization like electricity and water without affecting daily work we use to do in our house. Thus considering this analysis, we designed some energy saving schemes to be integrated with buildings through PLC. The "Autonomous Visual Control with Power Saving Algorithm for Smart Building" consists of various smart features like climate control, lighting control, water supply management, disaster safety and involvement of 'IoT' factor which will bring us a supervisory control on our building including the power utilization, water utilization, ongoing processes and settings. There are many measure taken with all this feature that every feature will act as an energy saving protocol in system. .

title: GIAN Nidhi record 371: CONTROLLOLING AND MONITORING OF COOLANT FOR INDUSTRIAL MACHINES
text:
Project: CONTROLLOLING AND MONITORING OF COOLANT FOR INDUSTRIAL MACHINES
Participants: SANDESH SINGH; YOGESH TAWDE; SUNILPAGARE; RIZWANA SHAIKH
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Excessive coolant is used for operation of machine like. CNC. SMED etc. Also due to the improper amount of coolant is used so machine parts can be damaged/burst/burned. Here we proposed a system to monitor and control the coolant level . The proposed system is monitor and control the coolant level in a main storage tank and in respective machine coolant storage ,with a the help of or by using ARDUINO/ATMEGA/PLC controller. This project propose implementation of level monitoring and controlling of coolant use in industrial machine. The system is Iow cost, easy to operate, robust and resources saving which can be used in industrial machine like CNC's, SMED's and etc. The system works in Auto and Manual mode on priority based. It saves the wastage of coolant and also eliminates the operators/ manpowers. The system is based on ATMEGA micro-controller with RF communication. It accurately performs the level monitoring and controlling for a series of machine using master and slave modules. Final result indicate a low cost solution will achieve for coolant level controlling over a different industrial operational conditions.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 373: LOW COST INTELLIGENT MILEAGE INDICATOR IN TWO WHEELERS
text:
Project: LOW COST INTELLIGENT MILEAGE INDICATOR IN TWO WHEELERS
Participants: VAISHALI HALGE; NEELAM MESHRAM
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Most of the vehicle drivers seek for economical fuel consumption. Moreover fuel saving is also an important factor in today's world? In this scenario we thought it would give fruitful results if we can show mileage on display as the vehicle runs Presently their is mileage recorder available in some vehicles (like Bajaj pulsar) But it can give only the mileage that is obtained between two successive refueling Moreover it will give only the distance traveled in terms of kilometers. Its nothing but another kilometer indicator with a reset button, from which mileage will be calculated manually. Our electronic mileage indicator will show the mileage in Km/lit on o display that will be obtained if the vehicle travels at a particular load and speed. In other terms suppose. if the Driver is driving the vehicle with a load say 120 kg at a certain speed on a tar road, our mileage Indicator will give how much km the vehicle will per litre of FueI. Thus the driver can know the optimized driving condition thereby saving fuel. The design of "Low Cost intelligent Fuel Mileage Indicator in two wheelers" is intended to developing a low cost device that can actively display the fuel mileage of a motorbike and display it in real time onto a display, which is attached/placed on the dashboard of a vehicle along with other driver information system. A unique method and system has been devised for giving instantaneous mileage readings in real time during both driving conditions and idling conditions corresponding to the amount of fuel consumed and the distance travelled by the motorbike. This device can be added as an enhancement to existing motorbikes to which, works on carburetor and even on bikes with fuel injection technology.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 374: SIGN TO SPEECH CONVERSION USING ANDROID PHONE FOR DUMB PEOPLE
text:
Project: SIGN TO SPEECH CONVERSION USING ANDROID PHONE FOR DUMB PEOPLE
Participants: POOJA R. KANDE; RADHA TIWARI; RUCHIRAKULKARNI
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Technology has always been of great help to the disabled and given them a helping hand to allow to live a normal and healthy life like others. We have come up with a novel idea of a sign to speech conversion using android phone that will convert hand movements into text and allow the dumb to express themselves better. The glove needs to be attached on the palm of dumb person hand and depending on the variation of movements, the device will convert it intelligently into voice for the other person so that other person can understand it easily. The flex sensors are attached to the glove using needle and thread. Glove sense the movements through the flex sensors pads which detect the different pattern of motion and the way of finger curls. The device can sense carefully each resistance and each movement made by the hand Currently the device can convert only the 26 alphabets, but depending on the success of this device more words may be added later onto this expressive system. The Gesture can be converted to voice by using APR 9600 voice storage and retrieval chip. prerecorded voices are stored into APR memory and when corresponding gestures are received, the appropriate voices are reproduced by the APR through the speaker

title: GIAN Nidhi record 375: SMART DUSTBIN
text:
Project: SMART DUSTBIN
Participants: APURVA KULKARNI; ASHVINI KUNTEWAD; NAMRATA S. LANDE
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: As people are getting smarter so are the things. While the thought comes up for Smart cities there is a requirement for Smart waste management. The idea of Smart Dustbin is for the Smart buildings, Colleges, Hospitals and Bus stands. The Smart Dustbin thus thought is an 'improvement of normal dustbin by elevating it to be smart using sensors and logics. Smart dustbins is a new idea of implementation which makes a normal dustbin smart using ultrasonic sensors for garbage level detection and sending message to the user updating the status of the bin using GSM modem. As soon as the dustbin is full, it moves in the predefined path to reach the larger container with the help of Line follower robot

title: GIAN Nidhi record 376: SMART HELMET
text:
Project: SMART HELMET
Participants: SHINY INGLES; SHUBHANGI DIVATE; VAISHNAVI CHIDRAVAR
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: The main aim of this system is to develop a smart helmet and bike to provide bikers with safety and security. People generally prefer motorcycles over car as it is much cheaper to run, easier to repair, easier to park and flexible in traffic. The rate at which number or two wheelers in india is rising is 20 times the rate at which human population is growing. In this scenario fatalities and accidents are inevitable if things do not change fast. The risk of death is much more among riders not wearing a helmet compared with those wearing a helmet in order to provide safety while driving two wheelers this project has been developed. In this project it is compulsory to wear a helmet, without which ignition switch cannot be turned ON. A wireless link is used which enables us to communicate between transmitter and receiver i.e. the helmet and the bike section. If there is any chance of the driver being drunk, automatically ignition switch is locked and will not allow the driver to turn it on. This is achieved by the use of alcohol sensor or more commonly known as a gas sensor which determines the state of drunkenness by calculating the content of alcohol i.e. driver's breath. The RFID module is used to authenticate whether the real owner of the bike is trying to use the bike where the ring is required to be worn by the driver. This will prevent theft of the vehicle by ensuring that no other person tries to use the vehicle if the real owner is present In both cases of drunk driver detection or theft detection an alarm will go off. The GSM module is used for accident intimation to the registered numbers fed by the owner of the bike. The Accelerometer is used for fall detection. If the bike happens to fall due to a mishap or so. The CSM module can be used to inform registered people as well as an alarm will go off to inform nearby people where the accident has taken place. The sweat probe in the bike section of the project will help to check whether the driver is using both hands to drive and hence will tackle the problem of careless driving. Therefore this project will successfully implement all these components to provide security to the bikers.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 378: TRAFFIC CONTROL USING IMAGE PROCESSING
text:
Project: TRAFFIC CONTROL USING IMAGE PROCESSING
Participants: SHRUTI LOHADE; EKTA BHOJWANI
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Many techniques have been developed in Image Processing during the last four to five decades. Most of the methods are developed for enhancing images obtained from unmanned space probes, spacecrafts and military reconnaissance flights. Image Processing systems are becoming widely popular due to easy availability of powerful personnel computers, large memory devices, graphics softwares and many more. Image processing involves issues related to image representation, compression techniques and various complex operations, which can be carried out on the image data. The operations that come under image processing are image enhancement operations such as sharpening, blurring, brightening, edge enhancement .Traffic density of lanes is calculated using image processing which is done of images of lanes that are captured using digital camera. We have chosen image processing for calculation of traffic density as cameras are very much cheaper than other devises such as sensors. Making use of the above mentioned virtues of image processing we propose a technique that can be used for traffic control.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 379: WATER QUALITY MONITORING AND CONTROLLING OF FISHING AGRICULTURE
text:
Project: WATER QUALITY MONITORING AND CONTROLLING OF FISHING AGRICULTURE
Participants: (not listed)
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Demand for fish and the fish processed food is increasing, while the condition of fisheries is currently in stagnation condition, and even tended to decrease production in several regions in different area. Marine environmental degradation as a caused by global climate change, coupled with uncontrolled excessive exploitation decrease the production of marine fisheries. Therefore, alternative suppliers of fishery products are from aquaculture. However, due to a limited area and climatic conditions are not always supported. These are becoming inhibiting the development of aquaculture in most countries in the world, including different area. Therefore, we need a technology that is used to increase the production of this aquaculture for example by monitoring water quality for fish farming. Routinely monitored parameters of liquid quality are temperature, pH, turbidity, conductivity, dissolved oxygen (DO), chemical oxygen demand(COD), biochemical oxygen demand (BOD), ammonia nitrogen, nitrate, nitrite, phosphate, various metal ions and so on. The most common method to detect these parameters is to collect samples manually and then send them to laboratory for detecting and analyzing. This method wastes too much manpower and material resource, and has the limitations of the sample collecting, long-time analyzing the aging of experiment equipment and other issues. To prevent the fish water pollution, first we have to detect the pollutant. In earlier days, the water pollution was detected by chemical test or laboratory test by using this system the testing equipment will be in stationary and samples will be given to testing equipment. In order to increase the pervasiveness, testing equipment can be placed in the water and detection of pollution can be made remotely This project proposes a Sensor-Based Water Pollution Detection, which will detect the pollutant present in the water and senses pH, turbidity and DO, Hardness, conductivity, TDS will be kept in the water surface and the data captured by the sensor will be given to ATmega328 controller. In addition. Neutral water can improve fish productivity can be accessed every time and can be placed everywhere.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 380: WOMEN SAFETY BAND
text:
Project: WOMEN SAFETY BAND
Participants: SURENDRA GAYKE; AMOL PRADHAN; GAJANAN MANE
Institution: (not stated in the source record)
Abstract: Rape is fourth most common and frequently happening crime against women in India. Among metro cities, has more number of rape cases and compare to developed countries like Latin America developing countries like India bas less number of such incidences, where very good security facilities are provided by government and ratio of education is higher So it proves that illiteracy or security is not major reason behind such assaults but the unawareness about self-protection and inefficient self-protection weapons currently available like Ninja key chain , pepper spray, handgun etc. It is also revealed that in 98 rape cases, culprit is someone close to victim like neighbor or relative, where bureaucrats can't do much to control as it is not possible to keep watch on each house every time. This paper summarizes current safety weapons available for women self-protection in situations like rape. Assaults and adds new perspective of using GPS system and android smartphones for women safety. By implementing and using our proposed system, not only safety of women but also of valuable things will be just a click away at very cheap price and that don't need to be carried separately.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 382: Modern solar water heater using PCM
text:
Project: Modern solar water heater using PCM
Participants: Khatik Sultan Bashir; Bhtakande Bhushan; Charoliya Sakir; Hiragude
Institution: P. V. P. I. T. Budhgaon, Sangali
Abstract: In consists of collector, highly insulated water storage tank & well insulated pipes circulation occurs in natural convection as water is heated in its passage through collector water from bottom of tank has higher density tends to sink. The density difference between hot & cold water provides driving force for circulation of water through collector & storage tank. After sunset a system can reverse its flow directions loss heat to environment during height to provide heat during long cloudy periods electric immersion heater can be used as back up

title: GIAN Nidhi record 385: Sewage water treatment using PLC
text:
Project: Sewage water treatment using PLC
Participants: Ptil Mandira; Khamakar Sampada; jatre Medha; Sinalakar Harshada; telakhade Sampada
Institution: Government polytechnic Mumbai
Institution as written in this record: Govt. Polytechnic Mumbai
Abstract: Our project comprises of pH control & conductivity monitoring pH is one of the essential element of water which is to be controlled. In our project PLC does the controlling process pH and conductivity sensors sense pH and conductivity of sewage water. Transmitter converts respective signal from sensors into 4-20 MA current which is required by PLC. PLC takes the signal executes the given program and accordingly relays & valves get operated thus opening acidic or basic solution, tank valves. Acidic tank valve is opened when pH is more than 7 & basic tank valve is opened when pH is less than 7

title: GIAN Nidhi record 386: Electric bus transist system with anticollision technology
text:
Project: Electric bus transist system with anticollision technology
Participants: Gaikawad amol; mishra Sujit; Jayesh Shintre; Sammit Shukla; Raunak Patel; Kalpesh Panchal
Institution: K. J. Somaiya polytechnic, Vidyanagar, Mumbai
Abstract: For supporting and controlling the electric bus system we are providing control circuit, which contain micro controller that have four ports i.e. port A, port B, port C, port D. In this module port A has an system programming, in port B there is LCD display in which we can indicate the position of the bus. In port C we connect the relay and in port D the receiver is connected. When we switch on the supply it will make on the controller at 5V as per the programming the controller will work and give the supply to the LCD then it will display when the signal given by the RF transmitter the signal is receive by the RF receiver and then the controller will work as per the programming then it will operate the relay drive IC. This relay drive IC give the supply of 12V to the relay coil and the relay coil operates. The relay coils are connected to the D.C. motor. In motor operation three relay coil is connected per motor. When we give 12V supply the upper motor will operate. In this when upper coil goes in up direction then the motor will go in forward direction, when both motor coil trip in down direction then motor go reverse direction. When upper motor relay coil trip down then motor run in right direction and when down motor relay coil trip down direction then motor run in left direction. This message is shown in display of LCD.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 387: Ozone generator
text:
Project: Ozone generator
Participants: Kumbhakarna Darhsani; Dharmadhikari Snehnkita; Muske Sangeeta
Institution: Govt. Residential Women's Polytechnic, Latur
Abstract: Now a days we all are facing a hazardous problems like air pollution, unsafe drinking water and so many to overcome these problems Ozone is the best solution on it. A complete disinfection of water in any impure form is realized with an Ozone content of 4 mg/litre. Ozone generator presented here has a capacity of producing 10mg/min. ozone. It is small & handy unit which can be used in domestic purpose safely. We can use it in industrial applications also. Now, let's know; how we can generate Ozone. Here we use a discharge tube to which a high electric field is applied using EHT transformer. Oxygen present in air is break down (O2=O+O) & it again combines with oxygen, resulting that ozone forms (O+O2=O3 i.e. ozone). It requires only 120 volts. Power supply since power consumption is less. As compare to its applications its cost is very less which is economical for all of us.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 390: Freon power wheel
text:
Project: Freon power wheel
Participants: Birajadar Vishnukant; Solanke pndurang; Pande wapnil; Dudhmal Trushna; Waghmare Ganesh; Pathak Vishwambhar
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Nanded
Abstract: It constists simply of wheel with a series of six sealed containers fastened around its rim hexagonally Diametrically opposite pairs of containers are connected by tubes a low boiling liquied like freon in sealed into the bottom container & heated by solar energy & subjected to a very mild increase of temperature. Which causes part of liquid to vapourise producing a higher pressure on the surface of remaining liquid. Due to this shift of mass causes the top container to become heavier than bottom of wheel & force of gravity causes rotation of wheel. Thus cycle is repeated again & again with no loss of contents. Hence the power is generated by using solar heating.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 396: Unconventional water heater
text:
Project: Unconventional water heater
Participants: Kulakarni C. P; Pujari S. R; Pialawan A; BIsale S
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Osmanabad
Abstract: The unconventional water heater is device designed by using agricultural waste as a fuel. The complete combustion of fuel is ensured by supplying maximum quantity of the air required for combustion with the help of a battery driven fan. The forced air also helps to circulate the flue gases over the water tubes of the heat exchanger. The multiple pass heat exchanger is used to absorb the maximum energy (heat) of the flue gases and a very less amount is released to atmosphere.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 397: Solar based inverter
text:
Project: Solar based inverter
Participants: Shahu nirav; Vora Chintan; Dedhiya Chintan; yadav Jyaprakas
Institution: Shri Bhagubhai Mafatlal Polytechnic, Mumbai
Abstract: The most commonly solar cell is configured as a large area P-N junction made from silicon. When this cell is exposed to sunlight the photons striking the surface of the cell allows electrons to be knocked out of their orbits & released. The electric field in the solar cell pull these free electrons in a directional current from which metal contact, in the solar cell can generate electricity. This electricity is in the form of DC which can be stored in rechargeable batteries. A PWM Inverter is used to convert this DC voltage to AC and can be connected to any AC load

title: GIAN Nidhi record 399: Partial automation of solar powered escalator
text:
Project: Partial automation of solar powered escalator
Participants: Bhujad Amit; Lote Rahul; gupta Prem; Motinagare Sumit
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Washim
Institution as written in this record: Govt. Polytechnic, Washim
Abstract: Whenever a person approaches say to go upstairs, the weight sensors in between the path senses the weight of the person & continues the trigger of the timer I.C. i.e. it triggers the timer I.C. & the escalator starts working. It works/runs upto the specified time set by the potentiometer. Meanwhile the time is set such that the escalator starts working suddenly after the weight sensor triggers the I.C. & stops a few moments after the person has arrived the destination, thus the time is calculated with a bit of delay period before approaching and after arrival.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 400: Low cost solar tracking system
text:
Project: Low cost solar tracking system
Participants: Lndage Deepali; Mohad Amruta; kansara Preyas; Radadiya Pintul
Institution: K.B.P. Polytechnic, Kopargaon
Institution as written in this record: K. B. P. Polytechnic, Kopargaon
Abstract: The main idea is not to reap energy from the sun but to collect & store maximum amount of energy from it. Thus for maximum efficiency from solar power generation system, solar collection panel should be kept always facing towards the sun. to achieve this continuous monitoring of the position of the panel relative to the sun has to be done & it has to be rotated so that it tracks the sun. this concept can be implemented by dc motor (gear type) system & electronic circuitry. This system is called as solar tracking system. It is basically an attachment with solar panel to give the best result

title: GIAN Nidhi record 401: Solar Operated Car
text:
Project: Solar Operated Car
Participants: Devendra S. SawantHarshal; B. ValviSiddheshwar; V. Madhey Mitesh; C. Patil
Institution: Government polytechnic Mumbai
Abstract: Connected to the solar array tracks the available energy into Watts or Volts. The Watts or Volts which are arrested inside the power trackers and the energy is stored in the Batteries. The batters are connected to the Motor Controller. The Motor Controller maintains the speed or the acceleration of the Motor. The Motor Controller is connected to the motor. The motor rotates at the desired speed and is connected to the wheel. The wheel rotates at the desired speed and the car works. Generally if the car is in motion the converted sunlight is delivered directly to the Motor Controller, but there are times when there is more energy coming from the array then the Motor Controller needs, when this happens, the extra energy gets stored in the batteries for later use. When the solar array can't produce enough energy to drive the motor at the desired speed the array energy is supplemented with stored energy from the batteries.

Project: Solar Operated Car
Participants: Devendra S. SawantHarshal; B. ValviSiddheshwar; V. Madhey Mitesh; C. Patil
Institution: Government polytechnic Mumbai
Abstract: Connected to the solar array tracks the available energy into Watts or Volts. The Watts or Volts which are arrested inside the power trackers and the energy is stored in the Batteries. The batters are connected to the Motor Controller. The Motor Controller maintains the speed or the acceleration of the Motor. The Motor Controller is connected to the motor. The motor rotates at the desired speed and is connected to the wheel. The wheel rotates at the desired speed and the car works. Generally if the car is in motion the converted sunlight is delivered directly to the Motor Controller, but there are times when there is more energy coming from the array then the Motor Controller needs, when this happens, the extra energy gets stored in the batteries for later use. When the solar array can't produce enough energy to drive the motor at the desired speed the array energy is supplemented with stored energy from the batteries.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 403: Echo-friendly Vehicle
text:
Project: Echo-friendly Vehicle
Participants: Sanket Shrikant Warudkar; Sakharam Sharadra Deshmukhk; Sanket Dongaonkar; Nilesh Vasantrao Wankhede; Ganesh Kale
Institution: Gramin Polytechnic, Vishnupuri, Nanded
Abstract: The ECHO-FRIENDLY vehicle is the recent revolution in the field of automobile. In this area of petrol/Diesel crisis, electrical vehicle is going to be best alternative to the traditional IC engines. The IC Engines are having very low efficiency as compared to eves. Due to the high efficiency, CHO-FRIENDLY vehicle are very economical & hence preferred. The basic principal that we are gaining to use is use of kinetic energy (rotational) if the four wheels of vehicles up till now this rotational energy of wheels is not use of we change the design of wheels to generator then by using this energy generated the vehicle can driven with zero % fuel. A car can be an ideal vehicle for hospital campuses, large company premises, airports, amusement parks and measures, where there are definite roads for it to travel with little other traffic. Charging facilities are also at hand at these places. The noise less, emission less character of the car makes it the best option for safari park rides. Also they find there way to the golf club and children park easily.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 404: Automatic Car Lifter Acl
text:
Project: Automatic Car Lifter Acl
Participants: Shaikh Ubaid; Shaikh Hussain; Palaskar Ravikiran D; Prayag Niraj Kumar; Shaikh Abdul Saeed; Trimbake Mahesh S
Institution: Gramin Polytechnic, Vishnupuri, Nanded
Abstract: The operation of lifting the car requires, much more muscle power & human inputs. They are many cases, for which the car is lifted such as for dismantling gear box, suspension Assembly, Housing, Shock Absorbers, at the time of puncture, wheel alignment, Hub Greasing, Catalyst converter & silencer cleaning , detecting ball joint play etc.... Now we are going to introduce a new bracket in front of you people to provide an ultimate solution over all above described problems. This bracket will consist a 1.Ton capacity bottle type hydraulic jack say it ""Automatic CAR LIFTER"" (ACL) By incorporating this bracket you can easily operate the car & also your mechanic will perform his task without any fatigue & stress. He can put his concentration over the fault detection and remedies not over to lift the car by lifting it with manually operated screw jacks at different position. This may helpful in many emergency cases where the garages or workshops are too far to change the tires or to detect the noise or leakage from bottom assembly

text:

Participants: S. K. ChikaneD. S. Sakhare; P. S. Kawarkhe; G. S. Joshi
Institution: Government Polytechnic Risod Road
Abstract: Due to fuel crises and increasing pollution. There is a need of eco-friendly Vehicle. This lead to produce for bio-bike or to convert petrol bike into bio-gas bike with certain modification. Bio bike consist of four main component 1.Gas storage tank. 2.Regulation kit. 3.Filter. 4.Rubber tube 1.Gas storage tank:- it is simply a tank use to store gas and supply to engine. 2.Regulation kit:- it is a kit which regulate or to maintain the flow of gas continuous 3.Filter :- Filter is used for remove the moisture present in gas. 4.Rubber tube:- Rubber tubes are used to connect the various devices to engine cylinder.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 407: Newton Automatic Centrifugal Clutch
text:
Project: Newton Automatic Centrifugal Clutch
Participants: Sangramsingh F. Chouhan; Jaykumar S. Bhattad; Bharat S. Bhutada; Gururaj P. Jamma; Nachiket N. Joshi; Gururaj A. Utage
Institution: S. E. S. Polytechnic, Solapur
Institution as written in this record: S.E.S. Polytechnic Solapur
Abstract: The Newton automatic centrifugal clutch employees only one set of compression springs instead of the usual two seats, with this arrangement it is possible to reduce the weights of the centrifugal members. When the clutch is disengaged & the engine is running at idling speed the hinged bob weights rest against the lower or inward sides of holes in the flywheel. When the engine is accelerated above 700 to 800 r.p.m. , the weights fly outwards and in doing so their leers ends compress the spring, so as to engage the clutch plate. When the full engagement pressure between the clutch member has been attain any further increase in engine speed brings the bob weights against the outsides of the flywheel holes, thus limiting the pressure plate action.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 408: Design Of Quadracycle With Quadra Steering
text:
Project: Design Of Quadracycle With Quadra Steering
Participants: Amey Sawant; Rupesh D. Nathe; Pawan Painjane; Tushar Mokal
Institution: Thakur Polytechnic
Abstract: The design of quadra cycle consists of the mechanisms which helps the cycle to rotate in zero radius. It also consists of low radius turning mechanism. The transmission system is so made that we can obtain the normal movement & zero radius (360 turning about itself) simultaneously by just using differential of auto rickshaw. In zero radius movement the linkage are connected to both front and rear wheel so that the wheel can be turned in desired direction so as to obtain zero radius turning. In low radius two rack and pinion steering mechanism are used at front and rear wheel. Our cycle is a four wheel drive vehicle. It is driven by a pedal & the power from front pedal is given to the differential (transmission box) & then given to the wheels. This conceptual prototype's mechanism can be used in normal car heavy duty vehicles, SUVs & other off road vehicles.

In low radius two rack and pinion steering mechanism are used at front and rear wheel. Our cycle is a four wheel drive vehicle. It is driven by a pedal & the power from front pedal is given to the differential (transmission box) & then given to the wheels. This conceptual prototype's mechanism can be used in normal car heavy duty vehicles, SUVs & other off road vehicles.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 409: Mobile Control Pick And Place Vehicle.
text:
Project: Mobile Control Pick And Place Vehicle.
Participants: Nitu Ramdas Khedekar; Jyoti Gopinath Anap; Kavita Baban Gunjal; Archana Jaishing Rajbhoj
Institution: Padamshri Dr. Vitthalrao Vikhe Patil Institute of Technology and Engineering (Polytechnic)
Abstract: Mobile control pick and place vehicle. Vehicle arm require an ""arm controller"" to command motors to achieve a coordinated & predetermined motion in an external space with desired accuracy, efficiency & quick response to the controller. In same sense vehicle requires a vehicle controller to command the motor to achieve a linear motion. Specified in the X-Y direction. Today everyone can afford to have a cell phone. Hence using the cell phone users can controlled the arm and vehicle action in the forward, reverse, left & right direction. This system will be at prime importance where the manual fault diagnosis cannot take place the operation controls the vehicle motion via mobile phone. Many mobile vehicle move in straight line 'stop' & 'Go' manner, i.e., the vehicle could travel in a straight line for same distance & then stop while stopped it could run to a new heading once turning finished. The vehicle is then free to make another straight line displacement.

text:
Project: Air Powered Car
Participants: Yogesh Shantaram Shanbhag; Sujit Acchelal Sharma; Jiten Rameshbhai Parmar
Institution: K. J. Somaiya Polytechnic, Mumbai
Abstract: Introduction: Petroline, which has been the main source of fuel for the history of cars, is becoming more and more expensive and impractical (especially from an environmental standpoint). These factors are leading car manufactures to develop cars fueled by alternative energies. While petroline prices have not yet reached their highest point, they have climbed steeply in the past few years. But cost is not the only problem with using petroline as our primary fuel. It is also damaging to the environment, and since it is not a renewable resource, it will eventually run out.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 411: Design And Fabrication Of Car For Handicap Person
text:
Project: Design And Fabrication Of Car For Handicap Person
Participants: Chetan Thakre; Ganesh Palatkar; Kalpak Onkar; Amar Kathwate
Institution: G. H. Raisoni polytechnic, Nagpur
Abstract: No doubt that the techniques are developing every aspect of the living beings like telecommunications, aviations, automobiles more and more. But looking towards end users of these development, there are only high class customers. A common person cannot afford to enjoy these sophistications. Similarly there are sufficient amount of development for handicapped person also. But these are all untouched by the middle class customers. So providing these technologies to middle class customers with ease on their pockets is the basic concept going to demonstrate with this project. According to market survey the biggest problem is that the handicapped person cannot go inside the cars available for them; then need help of some other person. This makes them dependent on others. This develops the feeling of underestimation or guiltiness in them. Even if they go inside the car then it is not necessary that he will be comfortable while driving the car.

text:
Project: Advanced Gsm Car Security System
Participants: Sagar Krishna Dhande; Prashant R. Chavare; Sandesh Kathawate; Abhijit Nagare; Yuvraj Pavale; Gaurav Saxena
Institution: N.M.V. Polytechnic, Talegaon Dabhade, Vishnupuri, Tal: Maval
Abstract: GSM Advanced Car Security System is a very brand new car Alarm, it uses the mobile GSM communication networks to Transmit alarm signal and control instruction. It enables you to keep in touch with your car at all times. You could supervise and Control your lovely car at any time and anywhere, just by a phone. In this system, one password keyboard is fitted on the ignition lock. When Car owner leave away from the car the car ios under alert condition. If the password type by the burglar does not matches to the password of the car owner the car is under alert condition. An alarm signal will be sent out to the preset mobile number immediately and automatically. Meanwhile, the siren of the car alarm will warning the burglar by making a high voice.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 413: An Experimental Investigation Of Fasibility Of Acytylene As A Fuel For S I Engine
text:
Project: An Experimental Investigation Of Fasibility Of Acytylene As A Fuel For S I Engine
Participants: Kapil Tupkar; Rushikesh Kubitkar; Swapnil Nandanwar; Pratik Barhe; Sagar Jichkar; Anup Tadas
Institution: Priyadarshani Polytechnic
Abstract: In early stages, a few towns used acetylene for lighting, including Tata in Hungary where it was installed on 24th July 1897 & North Petherton in England in 1898. Now a days acetylene is used for carburization of steel acetylene lamp, fore cavers and mines, for gas welding and cutting, etc. Acetylene gas is also called as Ethyne and Ethine, was discovered in 1836 by Edmund Davy in England, who identified it as a " New carburet of hydrogen" French Chemist Marcellin Berthelot, who coined the name "Acetylene", rediscovered it in 1860. Now a day, the fuels used for S. I. engine are petrol, kerosene, C.N.G. and L.P.G., etc., which is likely to get exhausted in future and also the cost of the fuel is increasing day by day. It creates pollution; hence it is need of time to investigate an alternate fuel, which is suitable for S.I. engine. The alternative fuel should be easily available in market at low cost. Acetylene due to its good physical, chemical and thermodynamic properties would be used as an alternative fuel.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 414: Electromagnetic Shock Absorber
text:
Project: Electromagnetic Shock Absorber
Participants: Sanket Vivek Phalak; Sagar Subhashrao Raut; Hemchandra Ashok Rane; Amol Shridhar Nagpure; Vinit Kashinath Kolte
Institution: K.B.P. Polytechnic, Kopargaon
Institution as written in this record: K.B.P. POLYTECHNIC, KOPARGAON
Abstract: Every automotive suspension has two goals: passenger comfort and vehicle control. Comfort is provided by isolating the vehicle's passengers from road disturbances. Control is achieved by keeping the car body from rolling and pitching excessively, and maintaining good contact between the tire and the road. Unfortunately, these goals are in conflict. In a luxury sedan the suspension is usually designed with an emphasis on comfort, but the result is a vehicle that rolls and pitches while driving and during turning and braking. In sports cars, where the emphasis is on control, the suspension is designed to reduce roll and pitch. For this we are design this electromagnetic (EM) shock absorber.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 416: Mini Hoist
text:
Project: Mini Hoist
Participants: Aniket M. Anavkar; Apoorva V. Aathwale; Kirti L. Saka
Institution: Government polytechnic Pune
Abstract: This is the era of machines where number of activities found difficult by human beings are carried out efficiently by machines. Here we deal with a mini hoist used to lift loads which is a regular activity for numerous workshops, industries, etc. it is a useful machine tool for manufacturing and production operations. The need of such a machine tool arises from requirement of sufficient but small effort against heavy loads. The system uses a hoist drum with 12m long rope, a hook and pulley arrangement, 1440rpm motor, a gear train.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 417: Orbital Cutting Machine
text:
Project: Orbital Cutting Machine
Participants: Harsh B. Kansara; Shantanu S. Walavalkar; Nabil A. Solanki; Abhishek Waruskar
Institution: Thakur Polytechnic
Abstract: TITLE: Orbital Cutting machine (O.C.M.) WORKING PRINCIPLE: the main principle of the O.C.M. is to cut the weld around the periphery of the pipe welded on a flange. A cutting tool is mounted on a ring gear which is driven with pinion gear with the help of a motor (air or electric). APPLICATION OF THE MODEL AND ADVANTAGE OVER EXISTING VERSION OF THE MODEL: The main working principle is cut orbital around the pipe with accuracy and precision. The advantage of this machine is that it can be clamped from any part of the pipe even with obstructions.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 418: Development Of Charting System For Methods And Analysis Chartsys-1 0 Software
text:
Project: Development Of Charting System For Methods And Analysis Chartsys-1 0 Software
Participants: Anjali R. Dhiware; Madhuri C. Pardhe; Mohini N. Sakpal; Jyoti B. Sonawane
Institution: Government polytechnic Mumbai
Abstract: Industrial engineering deals with increasing the productivity of business resources. The critical analysis of process, resources utilization can be done by recording the exiting facts using various charting techniques. The charts can be outline process chart, Flow process chart or two-handed process chart. Charting is observation + recording of facts. Number of times the initial observations may required modification also. The software developed CHARTSYS-1.0 is the fast creating and editing solution to the conventional manual charting method.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 419: Sheet Rolling Machine With Beeding
text:
Project: Sheet Rolling Machine With Beeding
Participants: Shishendu S. Chakraborty; Anand S. Chamachi; Manoj M. Borde; Pradeep M. Borkar
Institution: Y.B. Patil Polytechnic, Akurdi, Pune - 44
Abstract: Introduction: The prime objective in the minds of industrialist is to reduce the work more manually, which consumes a lot of time and does not achieve accuracy. The industrialists prefer machines which facilities the work with higher accuracy. It would be of great intersect to know that in some fields the machines even substitute the man who, results in desired accuracy and faster of production rate. THEORY OF BENDING:- Whenever a bend has to be made i.e. whenever a tube or any section is forced from a straight course to an altered part the structure of undergoes a certain change because the inner & outer side of the machine are compressed & stretched respectively. In engineering practice the machine parts or structural member may subjected to static and dynamic loading which causes bending stress in section besides other types stresses such as tensile and compressive shear stresses.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 420: Wabiman Walking Biped Humanoid
text:
Project: Wabiman Walking Biped Humanoid
Participants: Pooja Rajan Tanawade; Shweta Sanjay Panwalkar; Geetanjali Pramod Vengurlekar
Institution: Premlila Vithaldas Polytechnic, SNDT Women's University
Institution as written in this record: Premlila Vithaldas Polytechnic S.N.D.T. Women's University
Abstract: WABIMAN Walking Biped Humanoid is a robot having LEGS. The inspiration of this project is a human being itself. Our goal is to develop biped humanoid robot that is capable of working stably in a human living and working space, with a focus on their physical construction and motion control. By observing the defects of the robots having wheels for locomotion this idea was popped up in our minds. The wheels can get stuck in the potholes or craters, thus it will create obstruction for completion of the desired task. If the robot is having legs, it will find its own way out of avoiding or overcoming an obstruction and it can complete the desired task in an estimated time.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 421: Fixture For Croos-hole Machining Operation Of Center Yoke
text:
Project: Fixture For Croos-hole Machining Operation Of Center Yoke
Participants: More Yogesh Sampat; Shirrsath Chetan Pandurang; Kothwade Bhushan B; Yalunj Chetan D
Institution: K. K. Wagh Polytechnic, Nashik
Institution as written in this record: K.K.Wagh Polytechnic, Nashik -3
Abstract: 'The name fixture is derived from the fact that it is always fastened to the machine in fixed position'. As two operations are to be performed on a component at a same dimensions, that are drilling and boring. These two operations are performed on two different CNC machines of same centre heights ( 114.7mm). So, we develop two fixtures, one for drilling and one for boring, considering the specifications of machine as well as the specifications of component. While designing these fixtures the method of location and clamping is such that the idle time on machine is very minimum. We had made the arrangement of fixture for easy and quick loading and unloading of the component. In these fixtures there are no chances for the improper loading of component. The sufficient clearance is provided to hold the component easily and to pass out the swarf (fine chips). The fixture is sufficiently rigid to secure the preset accuracy of machining. title: GIAN Nidhi record 422: Advanced Abrasive Cutting Machin
text:
Project: Advanced Abrasive Cutting Machin
Participants: Bhagavat Suraj Shrikant; Rathod Vipul Ramprasad
Institution: Amrutvahini Polytechnic, Sangamner
Institution as written in this record: Amrutvahini Polytechnic. Sangamner
Abstract: There are various types of cutter, which are used according to their requirement for the particular job. They are made from different material like CI, etc. But the abrasive disc cutter is the type of cutter made up of abrasive material. Our project is totally based on abrasive disc cutter & sliding motion of the motor slides on the disc plate in which the cutter is connected which reduces the manpower as in the older type cutters.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 423: Dhoop Stick Making Machine
text:
Project: Dhoop Stick Making Machine
Participants: Kamlesh V. Narnaware; Hrudainath P.Raut; Tushar P. Nagpure; Vivek A.Dhule
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Bramhapuri, Dist-Chandrapur
Abstract: The project name ""Dhoop Stick Making Machine" works on principle of extrusion of materials. This machine can be used for production of various sticks of material required for various applications. The machine can be manually power operated by making slight orientation of driver. unit. The extruded units is having material transfer unit having the stages of automatic material dosing system & the screw feeder system, followed by the extrusion die. There after the rotary cutter disc, driven by 1/4HP motor can be used to cut the pieces of finished product. The machine is simple in construction , safer in operation easy for maintenance & repairs & having less cost. Such a machine is very useful a entrepreneurs, for setting a tiny industry. This enterprises can be established in rural areas & it dose not require a highly skilled personnel. For self employment to start business this machine is very useful. By replacing the extrusion die & by attaching an elbow & noodles making dies. The machine can be used for noodles or other similar food products. Thereby this project is very useful for small scale / tiny industry.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 424: Magnetic Brake System
text:
Project: Magnetic Brake System
Participants: Shirsath Shivaji Bhagavat; Darkunde Ganesh Ashok; Gade Tushar Lalasaheb
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Ahmednagar
Institution as written in this record: Government Polytechnic, Ahmednager
Abstract: The magnetic brake system based on the principle of electromagnetism. When dc/ac current passes through the stator or field winding the iron core in the stator winding get magnetized. Magnetic flux is produced between the south & north pole of stator winding. Armature winding is provided on the slotted shaft & shaft is placed between stator winding. Armature winding does not carry current.

Considering the example of piping industry (manufacture of small pipes) where plastic are PVc pipes needed to be cut, shearing machines are used. There can be various types of shearing machines depending on parts to be cut process of cutting, requirement of cutting length, etc. now a days hydraulic shearing machines, pneumatic shearing machine and mechanical type shearing machine are popular type of shearing machines used in above industries. These machines are certainly good at work but as with almost all types of machines are certainly pros and prones association with them to for the purpose various work is being carried out to solve the dilemma.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 428: Eliminating Nonproductive Trolly Movement On The Shop Floor By Adopting Synchronised Hanger
text:
Project: Eliminating Nonproductive Trolly Movement On The Shop Floor By Adopting Synchronised Hanger
Participants: Sachin Pandurang Ingle; Vikas Shivaji Matkar; Jitesh Gajananrao Deshmukh; S. K. Khan; Mahesh Vithalrao Parankar
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Washim
Abstract: Its absolutely a new idea and can bring revolution in manufacturing organization. This concept is basically applied to manufacturing firms which are engaged in assembly line example. Automobile industries, Electronic industries, etc. While making assembly we need inventory. Inventories are brought to the assembly line by martial handling device mainly manual trolleys. Large manufacturing organization like Bajaj Auto, Hero - Honda, Tata motors, etc. required lot of space for this trolleys. Our focus is to eliminate this non-productive activity of trolley movement on the shop floor. What we are suggesting is the overhanding hander maximum possible inventory for each final product. These hanger are suppose to be ergonomically designed. These hangers are attached to overhead belt that would carry inventory needed for finish product. This hanger movement is synchronized with assembly line main belt movement.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 429: Tricycle Fitted With Windmill Reducing Effort Of Pedallers
text:
Project: Tricycle Fitted With Windmill Reducing Effort Of Pedallers
Participants: Vinayak Yeshwant Dr.D.Y.Patil poly.pimpri pune; Abhijeet Adhikrao Dr.D.Y.Patil poly.pimpri pune; Vikas Narayan Landge; Nitin Balaso Dubal; Nilesh Nivrutti
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Miraj
Abstract: In this project we have used wind energy to pull a tricycle having an additional attachment of vertical axis wind mill with Bevel gear to convert wind energy into mechanical movement of a tricycle. It consists two horizontal shaft front and rear shaft. On the front shaft which receives as a rotation from the wind mill through a pair of bevel gears. Sprocket is mounted on front shaft which transmit power to rear shaft by a chain driver. The another driver from pedals to rear shaft. The lever is attached to shaft of wind mill to engage or disengage gears by up and down motion.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 430: Novel Coupling
text:
Project: Novel Coupling
Participants: Sudhir Chandrakant Maid; Jayant Ashokrao Lasinkar; Rahul Dwarkadas Bajaj; Abhijit Purushottam Parsewar
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Nanded
Institution as written in this record: Government Polytechnic, Nanded
Abstract: There are various types of couplings available to transmit the power from one shaft to another broadly classified in two categories, one for transmit power between line shaft & another for offset shaft. For various offset distances, novel coupling is best suitable for joining two shafts. Novel coupling can be used for in line as well as offset shafts while working in loading condition. In this coupling, there are 3 discs connected by means of flexible novel linkages, parallel link connections between disks exactly duplicate motion input & output shafts. This is basic new principle used in coupling.

Project: Novel Coupling
