Institution as written in this record: Government Polytechnic, Nanded
Abstract: There are various types of couplings available to transmit the power from one shaft to another broadly classified in two categories, one for transmit power between line shaft & another for offset shaft. For various offset distances, novel coupling is best suitable for joining two shafts. Novel coupling can be used for in line as well as offset shafts while working in loading condition. In this coupling, there are 3 discs connected by means of flexible novel linkages, parallel link connections between disks exactly duplicate motion input & output shafts. This is basic new principle used in coupling.

Abstract: Most of the jobs machined on lathes are having coarse folerance on longitudinal axis but a fine folerance on transverse axis. title: GIAN Nidhi record 433: Wibration Based Deasel Filter Cleaner
text:
Project: Wibration Based Deasel Filter Cleaner
Participants: Kiran Tukaram Devkar; Anil Balu Bute; Nilesh Sampatrao Devkar; Chandrabhan Jalinder Mule; Milind Suryabhan Game; Sitaram Radhakrishna Gandole
Institution: SANJIVANI RURAL EDUCATION SOCIETY'S K. B.P. POLYTECHNICKOPERGAON DIST. A
Abstract: Working principle of our project is rotary motion is converted into oscillating motion. And oscillating motion is converted in to vibrating motion. First motor is rotated at a speed of 1440 rpm also same pulley is mounted on vertical shaft. Due to electric supply motor is rotated & power of motor is transmitted to vertical shaft through v-belt. Because of axis of motor and axis of vertical shaft is parallel to each other. Due to this arrangement vertical shaft rotate and produce oscillation. Oscillation are produced because of unbalanced weight provided at both the end of shaft. Oscillation produced are transfer to bearing housing.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 434: An Experimental Investigation Of Thermal Performance Of Graphic Water
text:
Project: An Experimental Investigation Of Thermal Performance Of Graphic Water
Participants: Sunil Sawarbandhe; Surendra Rawate; Sarang Gosewade; Roshan Jangam; Satish Mankar
Institution: Shri K. R. Pandav Polytechnic, Nagpur
Abstract: Graphite is a crystalline forms of carbon. In the graphite each carbon atom is covalently bounded to three carbon atoms to give trigonal geometry in graphite. The parallel layer arranged, which bounded into hexagonal structure after investigating, it is clearly found that the graphite material has outstanding heat transfer properties. The thermal conductivity of the graphite is high like parent material copper and Aluminum. The specific gravity of the graphite is much low as compared to copper. The graphite withstand temperature as high as 3000-degree centrigrade. The hexagonal structure of the graphite material gives open cellular form like foam. Due to such type of structure it posses high thermal conductivity & Thermal Diffusivity.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 435: Hydraulik Dressing Attachment For Grinder
text:
Project: Hydraulik Dressing Attachment For Grinder
Participants: Sunil Sawarbandhe; Surendra Rawate; Sarang Gosewade; Roshan Jangam; Satish Mankar
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Nashik
Institution as written in this record: Government Polytechnic, Nasik
Abstract: Problem in existing machine: dressing of grinding & regulating wheel is done by manually. It causes serrations on surface of th ewheel. It takes more time and more rejection of job. Alternative: manual operation is replaced by hydraulic system. Construction & Working: The input component of the system is vane pump and output component is hydraulic cylinder. Power source is electric motor. The liquid pumped by vane pump through a closed system of hoses which is called as hydraulic circuit. The liquid under pressure is forced into the hydraulic cylinder. The to and fro motion of the piston is obtained by pressurized liquid. For forward stroke of the piston is the pumped on the head end and for return stroke the liquid is pumped on the rod end so the actuation of dresser is done. The direction of flow of liquid is control by the use of direction control valve. The relief valve is used in the circuit to reduce damage during high pressure.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 437: Self Driven Water Pump
text:
Project: Self Driven Water Pump
Participants: Siddharth Suhas Sawant; Pankaj Ravindra Wadkar; Sachin Prahlad Khurpe; Pratik Parag Naik
Institution: Matushri Maniben Jethlal Shah Polytechnic Kasarvadavali Thane
Abstract: The Basic Idea of Our Project is to provide a water pump that uses "renewable energy" of flowing water for pumping some amount of the same water. It does not in any way require any kind of electrical supply or fuel supply for its working. The presence of these characteristics makes our project model to be applied in any field where there is a need for pumping water to a considerable height from a source of flowing water.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 438: Adujesttable Compression Ratio Compression Ignition Engine
text:
Project: Adujesttable Compression Ratio Compression Ignition Engine
Participants: Shirole Goraksha Nivrutti; Rahane Santosh Prabhakar; Sonawane Sanjay Rangnath; Walwe Mangesh Ramesh
Institution: Amrutvahini Polytechnic, SangamnerAmrutvahini Polytechnic, Sangamner
Abstract: There is no question that a two stroke internal combustion engine is infinitely simpler to manufacture, has less moving parts & it's principle of operation is less complicated than a four stroke internal combustion engine of equal power. A two stroke engine is timed so that the rotary crankshaft valve hole is opening when the position is going up & creating a negative suction pressure, which drows in air fuel mixture during the compression at top dead center (B.D.C.) creating a positive pressure in the crankshaft. The air fule mixture then travels up the bypass where it scavenges the remaining burnt gases trough exhaust port & files the top chamber of the cylinder ready for the next compression & consequent power stroke. It may be noted that all the four working operation viz-1)induction of air-fuel mixture 2) compression of the full charge. 3) power stroke 4) exhaust of the burnt gases are carried out in one revolution of the crankshaft.

Entities: Rahane Santosh Prabhakar; Shirole Goraksha Nivrutti; Sonawane Sanjay Rangnath; Walwe Mangesh Ramesh; Adujesttable Compression Ratio Compression Ignition Engine; Amrutvahini Polytechnic, SangamnerAmrutvahini Polytechnic, Sangamner
Project: Adujesttable Compression Ratio Compression Ignition Engine
Participants: Shirole Goraksha Nivrutti; Rahane Santosh Prabhakar; Sonawane Sanjay Rangnath; Walwe Mangesh Ramesh
Institution: Amrutvahini Polytechnic, SangamnerAmrutvahini Polytechnic, Sangamner
Abstract: There is no question that a two stroke internal combustion engine is infinitely simpler to manufacture, has less moving parts & it's principle of operation is less complicated than a four stroke internal combustion engine of equal power. A two stroke engine is timed so that the rotary crankshaft valve hole is opening when the position is going up & creating a negative suction pressure, which drows in air fuel mixture during the compression at top dead center (B.D.C.) creating a positive pressure in the crankshaft. The air fule mixture then travels up the bypass where it scavenges the remaining burnt gases trough exhaust port & files the top chamber of the cylinder ready for the next compression & consequent power stroke. It may be noted that all the four working operation viz-1)induction of air-fuel mixture 2) compression of the full charge. 3) power stroke 4) exhaust of the burnt gases are carried out in one revolution of the crankshaft.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 440: Rotating Solar Collector As A Steam Genrator
text:
Project: Rotating Solar Collector As A Steam Genrator
Participants: Pratik Mehta; Swapnil Borgaonkar; Ajaykumar Ray; Govindkumar; Lakhwinder Singh; Kirti Godbole
Institution: Priyadarshini Polytechnic, Nagpur
Institution as written in this record: Priyadarshini Polytechnic Nagpur
Abstract: Rotating solar collectors are a new type of solar collector. The boiler consists of two concentric tubes. The inner tube absorbs sunlight and boils water. Thi stube is called the absorber. The outer transparent tube is filled with air and called the cover. The cover is made from transparent plastic. The empty space created between the absorber and cover is called the air layer. The end caps are used to support the cover and insulate the absorber tube. The motor is used to rotate the boiler and the reflexors are used to maximize the sun rays incident on the absorber.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 444: Positional Control System Pcs Using Microcontroller Based Stepper Motor
text:
Project: Positional Control System Pcs Using Microcontroller Based Stepper Motor
Participants: Nilesh M. Wadile; Satyajeet R. Kapadane; Girish d. Bramhe Sagar S. Khambait; Prajakta P Ghule; Rekha P. Thorat
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Nashik
Institution as written in this record: Govt. Polytechnic, Nasik
Abstract: Control System plays an important role in development of science and technology. Hence control system may be define as an system whose o/p can be controlled. System is an arrangement of various componant in order to perform a specific task. The stepper motor is special type of synchronous motor electrical pulse, received from its control unit. In above project the use of micro controller at 89651 precise step control or position control is possible. The stepper motor receives the command from micro controller to turn a shaft to specific angle. The advantage is its compatibility with digital system. No sensors are needed for position and speed.

Institution: K. J. Somaiya Polytechnic, Mumbai
Institution as written in this record: K.J.Somaiya Polytechnic, Mumbai
Abstract: Power is the basic and most essential need of any country. Electrical power can be generated either by conventional or nonconventional sources. Conventional sources having it's limitations. All around the world the stage is set for a positive change. With ever increasing population the emand of goods has also been increasing, same is in the case for electrical energy where the demand is increasing and the generation is not capable for meeting the required demand. Today fossil fuels supply most of the energy consumed like Oil 40%, Natural Gas 22.5%, Coal 23.3%, Hydro-electric 7.0% etc. which are in the verge of extinct. So we have decided to make such kind of project which is optimally utilizing the non-conventional sources which is the future of electrical energy.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 448: Controlling Of Electrical Gadgets Using Cell Phone
text:
Project: Controlling Of Electrical Gadgets Using Cell Phone
Participants: Krunal Jagdish Gajjar; Shrikant Rangnath Gangurde; Babubhai Baria Dixit
Institution: Shri. H.H.J.B. Polytechnic, Chandwad
Abstract: Here is a controlling circuit, which enables switching "ON" & "OFF" appliances to telephone lines. It can be used to switch appliances from any distance, overcoming the limited range of infrared & radio remote controls. The circuit describe here can be used to switch up to 9 appliances. The DTMF signals on telephone instrument are used as control signals. The digit '0' in DTMF mode is used to toggle between the appliance mode & normal telephone operation mode. Thus the telephone can be used to switch "ON"or "OFF" the appliances also while being used for normal conversation. The circuit uses IC CM 8870P (DTMF to BCD converter.) AS 746 (4 to 16 line demultiplexer) & five CD 4013 (D-flip) Ics Once a call is established the ring detector circuit detects the ring and places 220 loops across the telephone line by energizing relay 1 (RL1). After that dial any number (0 to 9) on the keyboard. For consideration supose key 1 is pressed IC (CM8870P) decodes this as 0001 which is further demultiplexed by IC 2 as o/p 01 (ATPIN 2) off IC s. AS746.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 449: Speed Control Of Sky Bus Using Microcontroller
text:
Project: Speed Control Of Sky Bus Using Microcontroller
Participants: Kamble Varsha S; Pardeshi Arti V; Pagire Chaitali R; Savekar Vijaya; Prabhune Avantika V; Sambare Priyanka B
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Ahmednagar
Abstract: In our project we use ropes as a tracks, for bus. LEDS & IR sensors are placed on the rope in front of each other. When LED is exited by current it will emits the light of particular wavelength continuously, then IR sensor of matched wavelength senses this light and gives this pulse to micro-controller. When bogie comes in between path of light, IR sensor fails to sense light and this pulse is also given to micro Controller. Then micro controller provides required voltage of appropriate amplitude to motor. In this manner speed of bus will be controlled. Facilites like onstacle detetor and fire detector are also provided to avoid accidents.

text:

Participants: Sonar Hemant Vasudev; Shimpi Amol Dharmdas; Kurkarni Bhupendra Ramakant; Tames VarsalaSonar Hemant Vasudev; Shimpi Amol Dharmdas; Kurkarni Bhupendra Ramakant; Tames Varsala
Institution: K. K. Wagh Polytechnic, Nashik
Institution as written in this record: K.K. Wagh Polytechnic, NASIK
Abstract: In a modern power system,electical form the generating station is delivered to the ultimate consumers though a network of a transmission & distribution for the satisfactory opening operating motor lamps &other load it is desirable that consumer are supplied with the substantially constant voltage. Wide variation of voltage may cause erratic operation or even malfunctioning of consumer appliances. If lower voltage is applied either to motor or a compressor unit of refrigerator it may not be able to start rotor rotating & may lead to burning of the motor winding due to absence of back emf.

text:
Project: Embedded Webserver For Temperature Control
Participants: Pawar Kiran Subhash; Shedge Vaibhav Janardhan; Kane Dedar Shrikruhna; Sharma Vikas Narad; Kulkarni Parag Arvind
Institution: Pimpri – Chinchwad Polytechnic
Institution as written in this record: Pimpri - Chinchwad Polytechnic
Abstract: In our project front end module consist of PC connected to internet & running a web server such as internet explorer. The user can be authenticated via password. By sending control signal or information through internet we can control any appliance or equipment which is used in industry or at home or anywhere. We have used temperature sensor. These temperature sensor senses the temperature of room. This temperature sensors are connected to microcontroller via 12c bus. By using lamp and fan we can increase or decrease the temperature of room. And we can control this temperature via the internet.

text:
Project: Smart Security System
Participants: Joshi Swapnil Shrikant; Bhosale Vaibhav Dattatraya; Darange Rushikesh Madhukar; Langhe Pravin Prakash
Institution: All India Shri Shivaji Memorial Society's Polytechnic
Abstract: Now a days electronic security system is become more essential so that, we decide to do project in this field. Our system has there layer security system, first is key pad entry, then electronic lock & sensors. In this system if key & codeward match, with predetermined code ward then only individual can get entry. In this security system we use temperature sensor, metal sensor, smoke sensor & motion sensor. All this sensors are directly interface with microcontroller & microcontroller will take control action.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 466: Flood Intimation Weather Reporting System
text:
Project: Flood Intimation Weather Reporting System
Participants: Pachpande Purushottam Ramesh; Gayal Umesh Vilas; Munde Amol; Lahire Vinod S.Mamidwar Amit S
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Aurangabad
Abstract: Flood Intimation System works on Microcontroller based interface with computer & GSM Mobile Technology. Microcontroller is heart of the system. AT89c51 is low power high performance CMOS 8 bit micro controller. In this system previously there are three sensors are used to sensed water level of river. Namely high level sensor, medium level sensor, low level sensor. All these sensors have different functions. Because of voltage drop across wire & microcontroller understand only digital input, so we have to use signal conditioner.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 473: Remote Operated Stepper Motor
text:
Project: Remote Operated Stepper Motor
Participants: Yashwant Deshmukh; Pratik Gohel; Mukund Motwani; Ankush Jangam
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Khamgaon
Institution as written in this record: Govt. Polytechnic Khamgaon
Abstract: We are representing a stepper motor in which the direction of rotation of the stepper motor (in clockwise & anticlockwise direction) can be controlled remotely. The transmitter circuit, powered by a 6V battery, is built around timer NE555 (IC8), which is work as an astable multivibrator having a frequency of around 38 kHz. The frequency of the astable is decided by resistor R10, preset VR2 & capacitor C3. Preset VR2 is used to set the frequency to 38 kHz. The output of IC8 is fed to an infrared LED via current-limiting resistor R11. When switch S3 is pressed, the IR LED transmits 38 kHz modulated infrared signal. The transmitted 38 kHz modulated signal is received by infrared receiver module TSOP1738 (IC1) & it outputs a clock pulse to D-type flip CD4013 (IC2) via transistor T1.

The frequency of the astable is decided by resistor R10, preset VR2 & capacitor C3. Preset VR2 is used to set the frequency to 38 kHz. The output of IC8 is fed to an infrared LED via current-limiting resistor R11. When switch S3 is pressed, the IR LED transmits 38 kHz modulated infrared signal. The transmitted 38 kHz modulated signal is received by infrared receiver module TSOP1738 (IC1) & it outputs a clock pulse to D-type flip CD4013 (IC2) via transistor T1.

Here in our project due economy constraint we have used low capacity current inverting device, hence we will get single rpm because we are using the available current to its full extent. The d.c. current which drives the motor is delivered from the electric. We can drive the vehicle up to extent up to the charge holding capacity of the electric. Here we have used single electric. If we would have used couple of batteries we would have increased the capacity (ourâᅵᅵs being the low capacity sample model).

title: GIAN Nidhi record 478: Employee Attendance Using Rfid
text:
Project: Employee Attendance Using Rfid
Participants: Belekar Apurva; Bahirwade Punam; Chilwal Pradnya; Bhujbal Nita; Wasani Sneha; Kashid Shradha
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Ahmednagar
Abstract: RFID is the low-power, short-range communication devices that can embed into everyday objects to track location, monitor security, & record the status of events or even environmental conditions. It is a wireless communication technology that employs radio frequency to communicate through air. One can call Radio Frequency Identification tags as a different class of pervasive computers these days. RFID tags turn everyday objects into network nodes that uplink ID's & status data to enterprise databases, storing new information as needed. They literally vanish into commonplace objects such as library books, shipping containers or luggage tags offering efficiencies in handling, location & condition tracking.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 480: Pc Controlled Conductivity Meter
text:
Project: Pc Controlled Conductivity Meter
Participants: Joshi Anup; Rane Nikhil; Gunjal Mangesh; Nikam Manoj
Institution: Karmaveer Kakasaheb Wagh Polytechnic Panchavati, Nashik
Abstract: Serial Data Communication using Serial Port & RS - 232 standards. The project is based on the principle of controlling a Conductivity Meter through Computer. Whole of the programming is going to be carried out on the VB Net Platform. VB Net is used as the core programming language along with the RS - 232 cables which provides the physical connection for communication between the computer & the Conductivity Meter. The main purpose of the project is to implement the entire control of the Conductivity Meter on the computer in conjunction with more flexibility & facilities like Plotting Graph, Analysis, Calibration, etc. Along with these amenities, the software will also be capable of generating Reports for the given values & even store the recorded values in a database.

Abstract: Now a days Robot's are sent to explore surfaces of planets like Mars where human may not be capable of enduring the temperature extreme. This implies that the Robot's can replace human in more than one way's such Robot's can not be now just reprogrammable machines. They need to be extremely flexible & robust in their capabilities with their own added intelligence. Some common features that are desired are path retracing, path tracing, obstacle detection & remotely controllable etc.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 485: Path Recorder Retracer With 3-axis Robotic Arm
text:
Project: Path Recorder Retracer With 3-axis Robotic Arm
Participants: Shaheri Karan; Mangukia Viral; Kotecha harshil; Vartik Akhil
Institution: Thakur Polytechnic
Abstract: WORKING PRINCIPLE: The working principle is such that the computer is interfaced with electronic circuit to drive mechanical parts by motors. The 8 bit data from the parallel port is transmitted & converted into serial form with the help of parallel to serial converter (encoder). The serial data is received by the receiver & converted into parallel form (decoder). The data is then given to motor driving circuit to drive the motors. The circuit contains microcontroller & is programmed in such a way that the path followed by the robot is stored & when it is retraced it becomes an autonomous robot. The robot also consists of camera so as to capture surrounding images & transmit it on T.V.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 487: Automatic Foll Tax System Using Rfid Technology
text:
Project: Automatic Foll Tax System Using Rfid Technology
Participants: Sartape Niyati; Warke Bharti; Piyush Deo; Vinod Gupta; Rupalin Mane
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Bandra, Mumbai – 400051
Abstract: The process of automatic toll collection at toll stations can be accomplished with the help of RFID technology. For automatic toll collection, the RFID tag is attached in the remote area of vehicle. This passive R/W (Read/Write) tag has in it stored all the unique details of the vehicle viz. the chassis no., engine no., registration no., etc. & the prepared amount with these R/W tags, one call write over existing information or add information to them. These tags usually have a serial no. that can't be written over. It can thus be recharged by writing into the tag some amount of rupees using an RFID writer. RFID detectors are employed at toll stations, which are attached to the Microcontroller. These detectors continuously unit electromagnetic waves through air which activate the tag. When tag activates it transmits the data to the detector. The microcontroller checks for the validity & details of the vehicle. It deducts the prepaid amount on bases of the size of the vehicle (for which it is already programmed) & displays the balance amount on LED display.

text:
Project: Remotic Device Control Using D T M F
Participants: Krupal Tarun; Sachin Datir; Aditya Rambole; Rupesh Dhake
Institution: G. H. Raisoni polytechnic, Nagpur
Institution as written in this record: G.H. Raisoni Polytechnic, Nagpur
Abstract: Controlling devices using switches are common. From a few decades controlling devices using remote control switches like infrared remote control switch, wireless remote control switches, light activated switches are becoming popular. But these technologies have their own limitations. Laser beams are harmful to mankind. Some technologies like IR remote control are used for short distance applications. In such case if we have system which does not require any radiations or which is not harmful, long remote control switch!! Yes here is the solution. Here I am introducing such a system which does not require any radiations, any laser beam which has no limitation of range, I mean it can be used from any distance form meters to thousand kilometers using a simple telephone line or mobile phone.

Participants: Shah Priyank; Rathod Snajay; Varma Rambabu
Institution: Shree Mahavir Education Society's Institute of Technology Polytechnic, Na
Abstract: In this circuit the input signal are processed digitized & imputed to pc via printer port & this data is then displayed on screen. This circuit conditions different signals of frequency below 1 kHz. The input is applied to driver & ZCD. The ZCD detects whether the cycle is positive or negative. When it crosses zero the signal transits from positive to negative side. The ZCD informs the pc by taking pin no 15 of 25 pin D - connector.

text:
Project: Braille Transformation Tool For Blind
Participants: Aher Sachin; Joshi Urmit; Wale Ajit
Institution: Amrutvahini Polytechnic, Amrutnagar, Sangamner, A.Nagar
Abstract: In today's world mobile phone has become the most simplest & effective way of communication. What to do if we want to send a message to our friend. Simple, we write a sms & send it to our friend. That's very cool & handy for us. But, what if one of our friends is blind. Being blind does not mean he should be deprived of the simplest facility available on mobile phone. There should be some way that blind people can also read messages, isn't it? So basically our project aims at enabling blind to read sms.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 493: Microcontroller Based Explosive Detector
text:
Project: Microcontroller Based Explosive Detector
Participants: Shah Hardik; Amita Yenji; Dipali Gosawi; Tushar Sartape
Institution: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Polytechnic
Abstract: The motive behind this project is protection from terrorism. In a light of heightened risk of terrorism, all people are worried about their security of their life. The explosive uses some sort of substances - such as dry ice - that turns into gas, building up pressure in container & eventually exploding in its inert state. It is divided into two parts. 1) Transmitter section:- In this we are using two sensor, one is metal detector & another is gas detector. This both sensor detects the data & passes to the encoder. In this project we have used Holtek encoder (HT 12E). Employing RF principle encoder has 8 address & another 4 data lines. The data set on these 12 lines is serially transmitted through RF transmitter i.e. transmitter antenna.

Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Arvi
Institution as written in this record: Govt. Polytechnic, Arvi, Dist. Wardha
Abstract: Many a times it is required to monitor & control the audio level as in public address system. Traditionally, the human operator does the job of monitoring, & controlling the volume. In home environment also it is required to control the volume as the high sound level is disturbing & has ill effect on the health. The circuit provides the opportunity to monitor & control audio level within preset limits, without human intervention.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 496: Pc - Based Equipment Switching
text:
Project: Pc - Based Equipment Switching
Participants: Jadhav Surekha; hinde anita; Kalyanakar Ashvini; Birajadar Deepali
Institution: Govt. Residential Women's Polytechnic, Latur
Abstract: A windows based program written in C language controls the switching of 8 different devices, connected through PC's parallel port (LPT). The switching pulse is generated using software and associated hardware is used to use this pulse properly for switching ON any type of device just by pressing the number of device to be controlled, on keyboard. The same number is pressed once again for switching OFF the same device.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 506: Pc Access Controller And Task Scheduler Package
text:
Project: Pc Access Controller And Task Scheduler Package
Participants: Pwara Kent; Mamidi Naresh
Institution: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Polytechnic
Abstract: In a fast developing country like India, it is very important to have access to a PC. Still, not everyone can afford to have his or her own PC. Thus, many a times, groups of people use a single PC in offices, schools, etc.... Thus, it is important to have Access Control and Security of the PC. PACATS aims at making the PC more Controllable, Secure & personalized again:- by setting user specific Scheduled Task, Messages for yourself or send them to other users in a network, etc....

text:

Participants: Patel Mihir; Patel Rajan; hemali Desai; Khokhari Peeyush
Institution: K. B. P. Polytechnic, Ahmednagar
Abstract: With identity fraud in our society reaching unprecendented proportions and with an increasing emphasis on the emerging automatic personal identification applications, biometrics based verification, especially fingerprint-based identification, is receiving a lot of attraction. The proposed filter-based algorithm uses a bank of gabor filters to capture both local and global details in a fingerprint as a compact fixed length finger code.

Institution: G. H. Raisoni polytechnic, Nagpur
Institution as written in this record: G H Raisoni Polytechnic, Nagpur
Abstract: Our project will be an attempt to solve much of the problems which the software industry faces today regarding the optimization and recognition of 3-D object images. title: GIAN Nidhi record 510: Task Reminder & Manager
text:
Project: Task Reminder & Manager
Participants: Powar Ranjeet D; Wadekar Manoj S; Yewale Sopan B
Institution: Ekalavya Shikshan Sanstha Polytechnic, Pune
Abstract: The software helps Elite to store the complete database of the client organization. The employee information is acquired from the client organization in the form of excel sheet. The software converts the information into tables in MS-Access. It is this transformed information that helps the software to schedule the task. The Computerised system provides excellent GUI through which the user can store as well as access any required information in the most user friendly form. The system also stores the address details of each employee including the city & location at which he stays and the total time in the days that will be required for the courier to reach the destination. Depending upon the total time required for the package to reach the destination, the system decides itself when to remind the said task to the user. So that the user begins with the execution of the task in the time and the desired service is rendered in the time to the client.

Institution: Ekalavya Shikshan Sanstha Polytechnic, Pune
Abstract: The software helps Elite to store the complete database of the client organization. The employee information is acquired from the client organization in the form of excel sheet. The software converts the information into tables in MS-Access. It is this transformed information that helps the software to schedule the task. The Computerised system provides excellent GUI through which the user can store as well as access any required information in the most user friendly form. The system also stores the address details of each employee including the city & location at which he stays and the total time in the days that will be required for the courier to reach the destination. Depending upon the total time required for the package to reach the destination, the system decides itself when to remind the said task to the user. So that the user begins with the execution of the task in the time and the desired service is rendered in the time to the client.

text:

Participants: Neurgaonkar Kapil; Rakade Rahul; Dharmadhikari Kanchan
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Jalana
Abstract: During operation on the kit students need reference notes, which are not available within the hardware. Over these problems, the major problem faced is that, the kit has certain limitations for operation and may face hardware failure. This decreases then efficiency and increases the cost of the training kit. All these problems are readily recovered by the software based kit.Futher it is more advantageous than the hardware kit with respect to the following points: 1.Several students can use single software which was not possible in hardware. 2. It focuses more on interactivity between user and the system . Thus it is user friendly. This increases the efficiency of training kit for students

title: GIAN Nidhi record 518: Remote Operated Magnetic Train
text:
Project: Remote Operated Magnetic Train
Participants: Surani Tausif; Singadiya Samar; Vishwakarma Shyamasundar; Ramdhani
Institution: K. J. Somaiya Polytechnic, Mumbai
Abstract: High speed magnetically levitated ground transportation (maglev) is a new surface mode of transportation in which vehicles glide above their guide ways, suspended, guided, and propelled by magnetic forces. Capable of traveling at speeds of 250 to 300 miles-per-hour or higher, maglev would offer an attractive and convenient alternative for travelers between large urban areas for trips of up to 600 miles. It would also help relieve current and projected air and highway congestion by substituting for short-haul air trips, thus releasing capacity for more efficient long-haul service at crowded airports, and by diverting a portion of highway trips.

text:
Project: Control Flood Save City
Participants: Ringe Harish; Shingavi chetan; joshi Dhanashree; Arshiya njum
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Aurangabad
Abstract: Water is that thing which save the human life or it can work as a disaster if it goes beyond our control and makes the unimagined losses of human & animals life and also disturbs number of villages and cities. Proper planning will helps us to save the life of number of human beings, animals, trees and properties and hence with the help of model we are trying to show how to get controlled on this problem with the help of following remedies. 1. By making water conservation project 2. By providing internal lakes on Nalla's 3. By providing small diversions to river or by increasing width of river. 4. y decreasing volume of flood by above methods. 5. By restricting the constructions on river bank area.

Abstract: Green building is generally defined as a building, which utilizes less external energy and is capable of producing ample amount of energy for its intended use itself without causing harm to the environment. title: GIAN Nidhi record 521: Working Model Of Pollution Control And Generation Of Electricity From Speed Breakers At Junction Of Road Squire
text:
Project: Working Model Of Pollution Control And Generation Of Electricity From Speed Breakers At Junction Of Road Squire
Participants: Balaji Bhalerao; Santosh Chanchalwad
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Nanded
Abstract: Now a days air pollution is a serious problem in Industrialised, congested cities, heavy traffic in such area further, contributes to pollution. Pollutants include gases such as Co2, Co, So2, No, No2 etc, smoke from the vehicles. Once in the air all the pollutants dispersed over grater area some of thus pollutants reacts with moisture from the air and make them more hazardous, such as a lungs asthma, Cancer, Heart problem in person living around it. So the working model is under our consideration as a for project the smoke created from the vehicles at the junction of roads. This smoke is collected through ducts below the road divider and the gas will be accumulated in the containing Calcium chloride. Thus air pollution is controlled.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 523: Plc Based Automatic Dam Gate Controller
text:
Project: Plc Based Automatic Dam Gate Controller
Participants: Neha Shinde; Khodankar Neha; Moharir Harshada; Roy Abhinav
Institution: G. H. Raisoni polytechnic, Nagpur
Institution as written in this record: G. H. Raisoni Polytechnic, Nagpur
Abstract: To control the dam discharge through gates, we have adopted close loop feed back system with PLC controllers. The water level in dam is sensed using float type, resistive sensor, the output of which is use as a basic information about water level in dam. This signal is fed to PLC controller, which ultimately drives the driver of the gate controlling motor. The system is programmable and can be interacted with nominally trained operator. The geared motor is used with rope and pulley arrangement to control the vertical position of a gate.

Participants: Neha Shinde; Khodankar Neha; Moharir Harshada; Roy Abhinav
Institution: G. H. Raisoni polytechnic, Nagpur
Institution as written in this record: G. H. Raisoni Polytechnic, Nagpur
Abstract: To control the dam discharge through gates, we have adopted close loop feed back system with PLC controllers. The water level in dam is sensed using float type, resistive sensor, the output of which is use as a basic information about water level in dam. This signal is fed to PLC controller, which ultimately drives the driver of the gate controlling motor. The system is programmable and can be interacted with nominally trained operator. The geared motor is used with rope and pulley arrangement to control the vertical position of a gate.

text:
Project: Coating Powder Wastage Reducing Machine Cyclone Separator
Participants: Mali Hitendra Moreshwar; Dhake Dipak Vasudev; Baviskar Amit Suresh; Nale Vishal Shalik; Chaudhari Lokesh Kamlakar
Institution: K.B.P. Polytechnic, Kopargaon
Institution as written in this record: K.B.P.Polytechnic, Kopargaon
Abstract: Coating powder Cyclone Collector main used for collecting the coating powder. A cyclone collector works on a similar principle where by mechanically forced air is introduced in to the top of the cylinder with cone shaped base. The swirling motion of the air creates a negative pressure drop across the top of the cylinder. This provides a pressure gradient the higher pressure of air in the lower levels of the cone are pulled upward through the exist duct, moving from a region of relative high pressure to the low pressure. At a same time particulate matter in the moving air stream will fall out in accordance with specific gravity is the density of a material divided by the density of standard reference material.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 529: Mini Biodiesel Processor
text:
Project: Mini Biodiesel Processor
Participants: Joshi Vikrant Anant; Date Jayant; Varkhede Sandeep; Kaka Prakash; Mahajan Parag; Bhole Nilesh
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Khamgaon
Abstract: The generation process of the Biodiesel is simple, it can be easily produced from edible and non-edible oil. In addition to being an extremely efficient and eco-friendly fuel, Biodiesel can run any diesel engine with few or no modification. This factor is sufficient to tell the important of the Biodiesel. The main benefit of Biodiesel is that it is 'CARBON NEUTRAL'. It is rapidly biodegradable and completely non-toxic fuel. To make aware the people about the generation of Biodiesel from edible and non-edible oil we take this an opportunity to prepare the Biodiesel generation plant during our final year project.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 530: Sewage Water Treatment Using Plc
text:
Project: Sewage Water Treatment Using Plc
Participants: Ptil Mandira; Khamakar Sampada; jatre Medha; Sinalakar Harshada; telakhade Sampada
Institution: Government polytechnic Mumbai
Institution as written in this record: Govt. Polytechnic Mumbai
Abstract: Our project comprises of pH control & conductivity monitoring pH is one of the essential element of water which is to be controlled. In our project PLC does the controlling process pH and conductivity sensors sense pH and conductivity of sewage water. Transmitter converts respective signal from sensors into 4-20 MA current which is required by PLC. PLC takes the signal executes the given program and accordingly relays & valves get operated thus opening acidic or basic solution, tank valves. Acidic tank valve is opened when pH is more than 7 & basic tank valve is opened when pH is less than 7. Thus controlling pH. In entire process conductivity is only monitored. Our project is fully automatic, it helps to control water pollution. It is applicable at all places where water is to be treated before leaving into natural water bodies & all chem. Processes where pH control is essential for max. yield. By incorporating data logger in system data can be stored for further use

title: GIAN Nidhi record 531: Electric Bus Transist System With Anticollision Technology
text:
Project: Electric Bus Transist System With Anticollision Technology
Participants: Gaikawad amol; mishra Sujit; Jayesh Shintre; Sammit Shukla; Raunak Patel; Kalpesh Panchal
Institution: K. J. Somaiya polytechnic, Vidyanagar, Mumbai
Abstract: For supporting and controlling the electric bus system we are providing control circuit, which contain micro controller that have four ports i.e. port A, port B, port C, port D. In this module port A has an system programming, in port B there is LCD display in which we can indicate the position of the bus. In port C we connect the relay and in port D the receiver is connected.

text:

Participants: Kumbhakarna Darhsani; Dharmadhikari Snehnkita; Muske Sangeeta
Institution: Govt. Residential Women's Polytechnic, Latur
Abstract: Now a days we all are facing a hazardous problems like air pollution, unsafe drinking water and so many to overcome these problems Ozone is the best solution on it. A complete disinfection of water in any impure form is realized with an Ozone content of 4 mg/litre. Ozone generator presented here has a capacity of producing 10mg/min. ozone. It is small & handy unit which can be used in domestic purpose safely. We can use it in industrial applications also.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 534: Water Turbine And Disaster Management System
text:
Project: Water Turbine And Disaster Management System
Participants: Kothwala; Ranjan Ashihs; Yadav Ravikumar
Institution: Thakur Polytechnic, Mumbai
Abstract: Our project mainly deals with the production of electrical energy using the kinetic energy of water. By converting this kinetic energy of water into electrical energy we will be driving an entire village. The street lamps, sprinkler in the farm, fans, tubelights etc. will be run by using this electrical energy produced. Part of the project is the disaster management system. Using the microcontroller IC89c51 and four switches the various calamities like fire, earthquake, flood and drought will be displayed at the main human resource centre in the city. This further immediate action can take place in the rural areas.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 536: Microprocessor Based Solar Concentrator Using D C Motor Microprocessor Based Solar Concentrator Using D C Motor
text:
Project: Microprocessor Based Solar Concentrator Using D C Motor Microprocessor Based Solar Concentrator Using D C Motor
Participants: Antakarane Shreekant; Gagade Milind; Yengade Shradha; Bhujade Priyanka
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Arvi
Abstract: Here this project introduced a system that produces electrical energy from solar energy. In this system solar panel or the concentrator is allowed to move perpendicular with the sun in order to collect the maximum solar energy from the sun for effective conversion in other form. Here, total system is available automatic with the help of the microprocessor. Solar concentrator may be put in synchronous with SUN track manually or by using discrete electronics circuit. This may have less efficiency. Hence, we have presented a system based on microprocessor solar concentrator. In this project, we use d. c. motor for the project to rotate the panel synchronous with the speed of SUN.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 538: Electricity Generation By Using Human Pressure
text:
Project: Electricity Generation By Using Human Pressure
Participants: Akansha Arora; Swati Jagadhane; Vilas Solanke; Vitthal Jonawal; Machindra Khandagaure; Anil Muliya
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Aurangabad
Abstract: Human is assumed around 80 kg maximum as an individual pressure; so pressure plate area is restricted to be exposed for one human only and corresponding design of mechanism is done. We are using racks and pinion arrangement to convert human pressure into rotational motion. This rotational motion is fed to dynamo generator. This dynamo generator will in turn charge the battery; this de supply is converted into ac.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 539: Biogas As Alternate Fuel For Automobile
text:
Project: Biogas As Alternate Fuel For Automobile
Participants: Knadekar Rahul; Mahajan Rohit; Raut Yogesh; Bhakare Sagar; Pawar Daulat
Institution: Amrutvahini Polytechnic, Automobile dept., A. Nagar
Abstract: A gas kit has 3 diaphragms that work on pressure difference, which is due to engine suction stroke and pressure inside the high-pressure cylinder. Gas is supplied between first & middle diaphragm. Middle diaphragm has a arm which is magnetically operated, keeps diaphragm closed & avoid gas to pass towards third diaphragm. At suction stroke vaccum is produced inside the engine. As gaskit outlet is connected to engine through air cleaner, a magnetically operated arm moves & gas is passed to air cleaner through third diaphragm. After suction stroke there is no vaccum in inlet manifold, so arm moves to it's original position by closing transformation of gas to third diaphragm with this movement gaskit sucks excess gas from manifold to gaskit through vaccum pipe. The one end of this vaccum pipe is connected to vaccum inlet of gaskit & other end of this pipe is connected to inlet manifold through a drilled hole. This mechanism is repeated continuously at suction stroke

title: GIAN Nidhi record 542: Solar Based Inverter
text:
Project: Solar Based Inverter
Participants: Shahu nirav; Vora Chintan; Dedhiya Chintan; yadav Jyaprakash
Institution: Shri Bhagubhai Mafatlal Polytechnic, Mumbai
Abstract: The most commonly solar cell is configured as a large area P-N junction made from silicon. When this cell is exposed to sunlight the photons striking the surface of the cell allows electrons to be knocked out of their orbits & released. The electric field in the solar cell pull these free electrons in a directional current from which metal contact, in the solar cell can generate electricity. This electricity is in the form of DC which can be stored in rechargeable batteries. A PWM Inverter is used to convert this DC voltage to AC and can be connected to any AC load.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 543: Portable Ozone Generator
text:
Project: Portable Ozone Generator
Participants: Sneha Hingankar; Suchana Rangari; Ashwini Wasnik; Ashwini Chavan
Institution: Priyadarshini Polytechnic, Nagpur
Institution as written in this record: Priyadarshini polytechnic, Nagpur
Abstract: Ozone generators invariable make use of a discharge tube which a high electric field. Is applied so as to break down the oxygen present in the air. This phenomenon occurs at or near field strength of 25KV/cm, and the resulting discharge that takes place is knows as corona. The corona has a light bluish glow. It is in this corona field that, Oxygen becomes ozone (03). The discharge tube is supplied air from an air group, which is built in to the unit. The unit produces ozoneted air at a pressure head of 15-20 cm. of water via its outlet. So the exit tube can be let into water containers with water up to a level of 10-15 cm.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 548: Two Row Seed Cum Fertilizer Planter
text:
Project: Two Row Seed Cum Fertilizer Planter
Participants: Rohit S. Kadam; Anup R. Nair; Zameer I. Pathan; Chetan Borse
Institution: D.Y. Patil Pratisthan's Y. B. Patil polytechnic
Abstract: The seeds and fertilizers are put in the seed cum fertilizers box which is equally divided into four different parts. As the bullocks draw the planter the Driving wheel is rotated. The driving wheel and the shaft are linked to each other through its chain mechanism. The shaft consists of two Bevel gears and as the driving is rotated it transmits motion to the shaft thorough its chain mechanism and the Bevel gears are also rotated through motion in the Bevel gears, the seed and fertilizer are discharge through seed cum fertilizer box. These seeds and fertilizers flow from the pipe which is attached to Shank And Shovel assembly. The Shovel is grounded and the seed is discharged through the pipe when the Shovel moves forward.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 549: Agro Seed Flow Controlle
text:
Project: Agro Seed Flow Controlle
Participants: Grishma V. Devatar; Krishna B. Bhavsar; Bhranti B. Mehta; Komal V
Institution: Premlila Vithaldas Polytechnic, SNDT Women's University
Abstract: Agro seed flow controller is an electronic machine to plant seed. This machine helps to control flow of seed while planting. The distance between two seeds can be varied and controlled. The micro controller will adjust the seed rate based on the tractor ground speed. The rate will be adjusted to match to preset plant population allowing a great efficiency when planting.

text:
Project: Watershed Development
Participants: Nitin Dawange; Kuber Bhusal; Bhushan Pawar; Ashish Khode; Gaurang
Institution: K. K. Wagh Polytechnic, Nashik
Institution as written in this record: K.K.W. Polytechnic, Nasik - 3
Abstract: India is rich in water with an average rainfall 1150mm. This translates into water availability of 10000 liter per person per day. However, domestic water consumption is 100 lit per person per day. Do we have 10 times more water then we need? Obviously not. The food we eat requires a huge quantity of water to agriculture. In future demand for food, and water will grow because of population increase. How could we to tackle this?

text:
Project: Multipurpose Tillage Impliment
Participants: Dharmapal Ashokkumar Baitule; Kalpak Sureshrao Dagwar; Sachin Madhukarrao neware; Devanand Vijayrao Ghate; Gavrav Vinodrao Deshmukh; Nilesh Marotrao Tiwas
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Arvi
Institution as written in this record: Government Polytechnic, Arvi, Dist-Wardha
Abstract: This multipurpose tillage implements is used in all the kinds of soil its process is very easy to understand and its price portable to each and every farmer. The farmer can plough the field as per his desired depth and distance as it has adjustable pierces so, it is useful for seed drilling and fertidrilling together at a time in this way farming activities like, harrowing, ploughing and sowing can be done without use of fuel and electricity providing saving time, money and labour charges. Besides this as compare to indeneous harrow, this implements is used in well foil weed soil where indigenous implements can not work properly.

text:
Project: Computer Controlled Electrical System
Participants: Sohil Dilip Beniwal; Sudarshan N.Bachchav; Umesh R. Jachak; Pavan U. Pagar; Vipul G. Chaudhari
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Nashik
Institution as written in this record: Government Polytechnic Nashik
Abstract: In the design of our project, we have tried to incorporate a Transformer, an Inverter, a Storage Device controlled by a Microprocessor which is programmed according to the electrical consumption of various devices. It also consist of a representation program which represents the past electrical consumption. The life of an electronic device mainly depends on the proper amount of current supply given to it. In our project, we are trying to organize and co-ordinate supply and even check the consumption of electricity periodically.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 559: An Experimental Performance Evolution Of Vortex Tube
text:
Project: An Experimental Performance Evolution Of Vortex Tube
Participants: Mungale Abhay; Vitonde Pratik; Dhoble Pravin; Dhakite Pravin; Dhote Nitin; Chaple Rahul
Institution: Priyadarshini Polytechnic, Nagpur
Abstract: With nothing more than a few pieces of plumbing & a source of compressed air , we build a remarkable simple device for attaining moderately low temperature. Vortex tube is a simple device operating as a refrigerating machine without any moving part e.g. rotating shafts or piston cylinder. It consists of a principle tube, which a high pressure gas streams enters tangegentially, & splits in to low pressure hot & cold temperature. Cold gas stream lives the tube through a central orifice near the entrance nozzle, while hot gas stream flows towards regulating valve & leaves the tube

title: GIAN Nidhi record 560: Smart Irrigation System
text:
Project: Smart Irrigation System
Participants: Gaiwad Dilip Prakash; Pangavhane Prmod Dinkar; Gadekar Pravin Rangnath; Pathade Amit Sunil
Institution: K.B.P. Polytechnic, Kopargaon
Abstract: Today the world is moving rapidly towards automation. Be it in industries or institution or other work areas the need of automation is becoming essential. Understanding need of same in the agriculture sector. We have thought to design a product so that irrigation can be done without human interaction & hence be automated. This is basic aim of our project, the SMART IRRIGATION SYSTEM. The product is basically a control unit which can be switch ON/ OFF the required equipment specially in 'Real time system' & anther made 'Time base System' such mode used in mountains areas while soils not uniform which provides equally water to field. Thus instrument also takes care of excessive water feeding by sensing water level by after sufficient water had been supplied. As farmers need to supply water to crops for different duration depending on crop & season. This device can be useful as it contains all these features & be handled very easily.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 561: Electricity From Noise Polution
text:
Project: Electricity From Noise Polution
Participants: Rajnish S. Zha; Hemant N. Rampuriya; Bharat M.Kansara
Institution: K. J. Somaiya Polytechnic, Mumbai
Institution as written in this record: K.J.Somaiya Polytechnic, Mumbai
Abstract: Sound energy is well known to have a healing potential on physical, mental & spiritual aspect of the individual to retire in the state of harmony & thought when the use of sound frequency is within tolerable limits. But sound created by huge machine above a particular level becomes noise pollution which is harmful to health & we people are affected by such atmosphere. It is possible that sound waves at the noisy sites referred here would carry enough energy to generate economically useful amount of electricity for everyday situation. Moreover, There are situation where small amounts of electricity generated from sound would of value.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 565: Sprash A Touch Of Help
text:
Project: Sprash A Touch Of Help
Participants: Kudav Mithila J; Patil Deepali M; Oza Prachi H
Institution: Premlila Vithaldas Polytechnic, SNDT Women's University
Institution as written in this record: Premlila Vithaldas Polytechnic, SNDT Woman's University
Abstract: SPARSH is an adaptive device that has been designed to meet the needs of blind & blind- deaf students in today's environment. It is also a complete Braille device for Braille learners & their teacher. The basic idea of our project is that whatever a normal person will type on its personal computer will be converted in the Braille on the board made by us, which the blind -deaf students will be able to sense. For students who are only blind, text will be converted into sound.

Participants: Sonawne Rajesh Sopan; Surwade Kiran Bhagwat; Thete Nitin Ramdas; Shinde Shrinivas Rajan; Padhi Debasis Govardhan
Institution: K. K. Wagh Polytechnic, Nashik
Institution as written in this record: K.K.Wagh Polytechnic, Nashik
Abstract: In this project, research on biogas utilization for residential power generation is discussed. The objective of this project is to design a prototype which can assist biogas produced in back house septic tank or traditional biogas plant for power generation using motor cycle/IC engine. The design of a crude oil based, low fuel consuming, low emissions GEN-SET will lead to an unaffordable solution for Indian rural as well as other middle class communities. Moreover a module like this providing multi-solutions such as treatment of sewage/waste/organic matter, providing bio-fertilizer, preventing global warming due to methane trapping, fulfilling electricity demands at very low cost, reducing emissions and more has always been welcome by nature. This project is presented mostly considering present Indian electricity crisis. The design of this unit is very simple and can be designed by any individual having basic technical knowledge using all domestic equipments. A full-scale prototype when produced in collaboration with commercial manufacturer will take it more precise and efficient. Th

title: GIAN Nidhi record 567: Chainless Bicycle
text:
Project: Chainless Bicycle
Participants: Gunatit Patel; Vikram Sarma; Kaustubh deshmukh; Yash Shah
Institution: Thakur Polytechnic, Mumbai
Institution as written in this record: Thakur Polytechnic Mumbai
Abstract: A chainless bicycle is a bicycle that uses a drive shaft instead of chian to transmit power from pedals to the wheel. Chainless bicyle have a large Bevel gears where a conventional bike would have its chaining. This would mesh with another bevel gear mounted on the drive shaft. The use of bevel gears drive from pedals to be turned through 90 degrees. The drive shaft then has another bevel gear near the near wheel hub which mesh to a bevel gear on be on a conventional bike. The 90 degree change of plane for the drive that occurs at the bottom rocket and again at the rear hub requires the use of bevel gears.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 568: Folding Car
text:
Project: Folding Car
Participants: Pratik Mistri; Tanay Navelkar; Prem Tiwari
Institution: Thakur Polytechnic
Abstract: The car has a two wheeler engine installed in the car. The chassis is assembled with the help of hinge arrangement so that it can be folded along the longitudinal member. The car has a rear wheel drive. The seating arrangement is provided in front half of the car with a spring shock absorber on the front wheel.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 570: Advanced Pneumatic Rivef Manufacturing M C
text:
Project: Advanced Pneumatic Rivef Manufacturing M C
Participants: Shrikant Anna Vispute; Pravin Pandurang Navarkar; Pankaj Ramesh Nere; Sangram Jabbulal Gupta; Manoj V. Patil
Institution: K.B.P. Polytechnic
Abstract: When the knob of the valve is on, the compressed air from the compressor is rushes into the cylinder on the extreme left side and exerts the force on the piston. The piston moves towards right side and die is adjusted on the table. After that when the second knob of the valve is on, the compressed air from the compressor rushes into cylinder from upper portion and exerts a downward force which is transferred to the punch by piston rod. When the punch makes an impact on the material a river head is made. When the valve is released the air is release in the atmosphere the piston rod is moves upward with the punch when the air first valve is released the air is exhaust in atmosphere the piston rod moves away from the fixed support of die and we can obtain rivet very easily.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 574: Oil Charcoal Silencer
text:
Project: Oil Charcoal Silencer
Participants: Khule Praveen Jaggnath; Jadhav manoj Vinod; Jadhav Sachin Gorakhnath; Salunke Jagdish Anilrao; Kaklij Manish Madhukar
Institution: K.B.P. Polytechnic, Kopargaon
Abstract: As the gas liberated from exhaust value valve passes through exhaust manifold first it reaches into charcoal casing from the perforated tube where the CO is absorbed by charcoal powder. Charcoal and granular charcoal after breaking down into small mass. Then after the gas passed through the convergent portion to tube which is immersed in the oil as shown in Fig. then gas reaches in to oil chamber where the bubbles are found and high mass bubbles are contains in to low mass as the gas passes through the the liquid by forming bubble. In this process as burnt oil is used to absorb the amount of carbon monoxide (CO) and hydrocarbon (HC) as well as sound is dumped. Then gas is passed through wool chamber. The glass wool absorbs the sound.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 578: Betel Nut Grinding Machine
text:
Project: Betel Nut Grinding Machine
Participants: Mistri Samir Bhailalbhai; Mistri Rahul Bhailalbhai; Patel Divyesh Chandrakant; Mistri Chintan Maheshbhai; Tandel Jignesh Maganbhai; Karbhari Harshad Pandit
Institution: K.B.P. Polytechnic, Kopargaon
Abstract: It works on the principle of "double angle scissor type cutting action". So our machine requires less power i.e., two blades applying the force in opposite direction non the raw material. The working and construction of the machine is also simple. Complete machine is made up of mild steel only the blades are of carbon steel. When the betel nuts are inserted into the Hooper, it falls into the cutting chamber in between the rotating blades and fixed blades and are cutted into the small pieces. Then the grinded betel nuts will pass from the grill and get collected into the container and thus we get the continuous production of the crushed betel nuts.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 579: Spring Jack
text:
Project: Spring Jack
Participants: Gawali Ajit Ramesh; Devkar Rajendra Dadasaheb; Chandgude Amol Shriram; Deshmukh Rahul Ashokrao; Pawar Sagar Vijay; Dhakane Shrikant Ambadas
Institution: K.B.P. Polytechnic, Kopargaon
Abstract: Spring jack is used to lift vehicle for maintenance the work. To work under the vehicle or to change the wheels, it is necessary to left the vehicle. For a spring jack is used which is mechanically operated. It is used to lift light vehicle. The jack is designed in such a way that there is always sufficient compression and expansion of the spring to lift a load. The spring jack is easy to handle than other jacks such as screw jack, scissor jack, trolley jack, heavy-duty bottle type jack, etc. the main advantage of spring jack is its less weight, easy operation with having less cost.

Institution: K.B.P. Polytechnic, Kopargaon
Abstract: Spring jack is used to lift vehicle for maintenance the work. To work under the vehicle or to change the wheels, it is necessary to left the vehicle. For a spring jack is used which is mechanically operated. It is used to lift light vehicle. The jack is designed in such a way that there is always sufficient compression and expansion of the spring to lift a load. The spring jack is easy to handle than other jacks such as screw jack, scissor jack, trolley jack, heavy-duty bottle type jack, etc. the main advantage of spring jack is its less weight, easy operation with having less cost.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 581: Microcontroller Based Weighing Machine
text:
Project: Microcontroller Based Weighing Machine
Participants: Tejas N.Varsekar; Nitin D. Shetty; Amit C. Shukla; Sudhanshu A. Upadhay
Institution: Sardar Vallabhbhai patel Polytechnic, Boriwali West, Mumbai
Institution as written in this record: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Polytechnic, Boriwali West, Mumbai
Abstract: Working of this system is based on the transducers called Load cell. The strain gage is the heart of a load cell. A strain stage is the device that changes resistance when it is stressed. The gage are developed from an ultra-thin heat - treated metallic foil and are chemically bonded to a thin dielectric layer. Positioning of the gage, mounting procedure and materials used all have a measurable effect on performance of the load cell. Multiple strain gages are connected to create the four legs of a Wheatstone-bridge configuration. When an input voltage is applied to the bridge, the output becomes a voltage proportional to the force on the cell. This voltage is then processed to show the exact amount of weight as well as the cost of that quantity on display.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 591: Effect Of Oxygenated Fuel With Diesel On Diesel Engine Performance And Emission
text:
Project: Effect Of Oxygenated Fuel With Diesel On Diesel Engine Performance And Emission
Participants: Thakrar Jatinkumar Jagdishbhai
Institution: Government Polytechnic, Bhuj
Abstract: This work aims to find the Effect of Oxygenated fuel On Diesel Engine performance and emission For the substitute of Diesel in to CI engine. Engine used was stationary type With constant speed in experiment ethanol was used with diesel as a oxygenated fuel up to 20% ethanol in to CI engine without any modification it has been observed that ethanol can be used as a partial substitute in to the CI engine Bsfc increased by adding of ethanol blend as the percentage of ethanol increase bsfc increases. There is no significant difference in the efficiency of the engine by using ethanol up to 20% The emission of HC and CO decreases with use of ethanol as a blend and it is found minimum by using 10% ethanol in to the diesel engine.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 594: Performance And Emissoin Analysis Of Diesel Engine Using Different Fuel Additives Blend
text:
Project: Performance And Emissoin Analysis Of Diesel Engine Using Different Fuel Additives Blend
Participants: PATEL ANKITKUMAR K
Institution: Vidyabharti Trust Polytechnic, Umrakh, Bardoli, Surat
Abstract: In most of diesel engine, emission comes out is dangerous to human being. So as possible as minimize the emission content is necessary to upcoming future. This study evaluates the effect of additives in diesel and of on the properties of density, volatility, viscosity, characteristics at cold temperatures, cetane number and performance in engine tests. Fuel additives improved properties of diesel fuels, such as pour point and viscosity values is found from the literature review. Diesel fuels are to be tested in an unmodified direct injection 2-cylinder 4 stroke diesel engine at different load condition. Specific fuel consumption of diesel fuels increased, it showed trend of decreasing with adding of additives. Exhaust emission profile of diesel fuels improved. CO emissions and smoke opacity decreased by the expected outcome. Low NOx emission would be also observed in general for the diesel fuel.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 595: Cost Analysis Of Sub Base And Base In Flexible Pavement Using Geosynthetic Material On Poor Sub Grade Soil
text:
Project: Cost Analysis Of Sub Base And Base In Flexible Pavement Using Geosynthetic Material On Poor Sub Grade Soil
Participants: Patel Jigar kumar Jayantilal
Institution: Govt. Polytechnic, Himmatnagar
Abstract: Geosynthetics have been used successfully to reinforce unpaved roads on soft subgrade for many years. In recent years, geosynthetics have been proposed and used in roadway design are simple and compelling: to reduce construction time; to reduce construction materials; to reduce construction costs; improve the bearing capacity, diminish deformations, and delay rut formation and to increase the usable life of the roadway. Where the main goal is to save aggregate material the use of geosynthetics to reinforce unpaved roads on soft subgrade. Cost saving benefits should be quantified using Cost analysis. This dissertation highlights on the calculation of economic minimum depth required for base course with respect to adequate soil bearing capacity of sub grade. These designing the base and sub-base thickness using concept based on I.R.C 37-2001 method for an unreinforced unpaved road. The required aggregate thickness for a reinforced unpaved road is calculated using as per Federal Highway Administration design by using non woven geotextile.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 596: 3-phase Mesurement Protection Monitering Equipment Using M
text:
Project: 3-phase Mesurement Protection Monitering Equipment Using M
Participants: 2.MODI ROSHAN M; 3.RATHOD SIDDHARTH L; 4.KOTHARI SARTHAK B
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: When looking at consumer and industrial applications today, it is easy to focus on the functionality of the device and take for granted the reliability of the power system. However, design engineers must consider that the features that help create their competitive advantage are at risk due to internal and external electrical threats to their systems. Our project is to measure, protect of instruments and monitoring parameters on computer system can be a big boon for various Industrial as below mentioned parameters are very critical at such places as well as its compact in size. The Project is based on PIC microcontroller which is built in with ADC / PROGRAM / MEMEORY / RAM / EPROM power supply which is helpful in finding various parameter of our project. It's basically for protection and monitoring of various circuits such as 3 phase measurement protection, which in turn measures parameters such as over voltage, over current, over frequency as well as under voltage, under current, under frequency and earth leakage.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 597: Attendace Recording System
text:
Project: Attendace Recording System
Participants: 2.ATRE HITESH A; 3.RAHANE NITESH S; 4.SHINGADIYA KETAN C
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: Time attendance system and access control systems have become the most important part of the companies and large-scale industries including educational institutions. In conventional system musters were used for keeping in and out records of different employees and students respectively. Now a day's automation of this system has been done and punched cards or swapped cards are used for the purpose. But the problem with these cards is it needs to be inserted properly. It may get locked into the system. To overcome such problems we are designing the system of Attendance Monitoring Using RFID & Distributed Control System using RFID concept. Here RFID receiver is connected to the system and the RFID cards are used as input to the system. These cards need not to be inserted in the system. When the card is placed in the vicinity of the RFID receiver it will automatically sense the card and access is allowed

title: GIAN Nidhi record 598: Cell Phone Base Industrialapplience
text:
Project: Cell Phone Base Industrialapplience
Participants: 2.CHAMPANERIA PARTH P; 3.HARSORA PARTH K; 4.BHAVSAR KEVAL B
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: The human mind always needs information of interest to control systems of his/her choice. In the age of electronic systems it is important to be able to control and acquire information from everywhere. Remote management of Several home and office appliances are a subject of growing interest and in recent years we have seen many systems providing such controls. In this study, we have developed an interface which is a phone based home/Industry remote controller equipped with power to turn ON/OFF and receive STATUS of Electrical appliances remotely located. This project basically employs a mobile phone for controlling which got interfaced to micro-controller through DTMF Decoder. The Main Aim of Cell Phone Operated Industrial Appliances is to develop a system, which Keeps Control of the Various Equipment, and will control the operations of these equipment's in Home or industries. Different equipment's automatically and to gain remote access of different units using mobile technology.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 599: Industrial Safety Using Gsm System
text:
Project: Industrial Safety Using Gsm System
Participants: 2.NAKARANI NIKUNJ L; 3.NATHANI KAPIL G; 4.KHENI UDDHAV A
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: Industrial safty has been a major issue where crime is increasing and everybody wants to take proper measures to prevent in-trusion. In addition there is a need to automate Industry so that user can take advantage of the technological advancement in such a way that a person getting off his Industry does not need to think of his Industry security again and again. It is therefore the purpose of this invention to provide a security device, which gives immediate notification to the owner and security services like police station or fire brigade at the moment the unauthorized event occurs. This purpose is accomplished via use of some modules and a controller which activates a GSM (Global System for Mobile) module to send one or more Call to the owner and corresponding security services at the time of break in. This system is low cost as it does not contain expensive sensors to detect emergencies and it is also easy to implement as the security modules will take very low space for installation.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 603: Tunnel Breakage Indication System
text:
Project: Tunnel Breakage Indication System
Participants: 2. PARMAR SMITH R; 3. PATHAN MO. SHAHIL G
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: Tunnel Breakage Identification system We Can Use This System for Security As well As Breakage Identification System In Tunnels. By Using the system we can identify the stone falling and breaking also big obstacles in tunnels for reduction the accidents in the tunnels. An infrared sensor is a device (usually with supporting circuitry) that can detect infrared light (Which is below the optical spectrum) for use to a many purpose. Most of the controls for TVs and other entertainment equipment use infrared energy as the transmission medium to carry information between the control and the equipment to be operated. Infrared sensors also have important scientific, military, security and rescue applications since they can "see" the "radiant heat energy" which is infrared radiation. This electromagnetic energy is in the wavelength s from about 750 mm, which is the lower end of the optical spectrum, to well over 10,000 nm, deep in the infrared.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 604: Variable Frequency Drive
text:
Project: Variable Frequency Drive
Participants: 2. CHAPANERIA VATSAL B; 3. GOTAWALA HARSHIL D; 4. KHANTHARIYA NIKUNJ S
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: Variable speed drives are gaining popularity as an efficient way to power industrial motors. They collect and compute a large number of signals, normally used for control and operation purposes (for example, current, torque, speed, frequency, power, flux, etc.). This data is available and can be used for diagnostic purposes. These signals can be analyzed for their spectral content, for monitoring the operating point, for examining cyclic processes, etc. On the down side, the format, quality and quantity of data is determined by the hardware. Further complication arises from the fact that variable speed drives change the output frequency to follow desired process parameters. Methods for circumventing these difficulties are presented along with actual results from various drive-powered processes. These results prove that a variable speed drive can be a valuable source of diagnostic data not only for the drive itself, but also for the entire driven process.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 612: Online Banking System Bob
text:
Project: Online Banking System Bob
Participants: Ghevariya Ravi; Patel Harsh; Sandish Manish
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: The number of malicious applications targeting online banking transactions has increased dramatically indecent years. This represents a challenge not only to the customers who use such facilities, but also to the institutions who offer them, as evidenced by an ongoing trail in the US.These malicious applications employ two kinds of attack vector – local attacks which occur on the local computer, and remote attacks, which redirect the victim to a remote site. The possibility also exists that both approaches will be combined. Some attacks may be foiled by adopting security measures such as transaction numbers (TAN). However, it is likely that the risks associated with online banking transactions will remain until new transaction methods, such as PKI based methods (public key infrastructure), are widely introduced.We are going to use Asp.Net technology and C# as our front end and Ms Access as our back end to develop our website.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 613: Online Shopping Cart
text:
Project: Online Shopping Cart
Participants: Amrolia Nekshan; Jasmitya Nisha; Patel Pinal
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: An online shopping system that permits a customer to submit online orders for items and/or services from a store that serves both walk-in customers and online customers. The online shopping system presents an online display of an order cutoff time and an associated delivery window for items selected by the customer. The system accepts the customer's submission of a purchase order for the item in response to a time of submission being before the order cutoff time. The online shopping system does not settle with a credit supplier of the customer until the item selected by the customer is picked from inventory but before it is delivered. Therefore, the customer can go online and make changes to the order. In addition, available service windows are presented to the customer as a function of customer selected order and service types; and further, the order picking is assigned in accordance with a picker's preference.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 614: Online Help Desk
text:
Project: Online Help Desk
Participants: Solanki Jitendra; Vaghasiya Vishal; Prajapati Rajendra
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: Help Desk is a widely-implemented strategy for managing a company's interactions with customers, clients and sales prospects. Customer relationship management describes a company-wide business strategy including customer-interface departments as well as other departments. Successful development, implementation, use and support of customer relationship management systems can provide a significant advantage to the user, but often, there are obstacles that obstruct the user from using the system to its full potential. Instances of a Help Desk attempting to contain a large, complex group of data can become cumbersome and difficult to understand for an ill-trained user. In a web-focused marketing Help Desk solution, organizations create and track specific web activities that help develop the client relationship. Help Desk offers fully customizable reports in all the modules (Sales, Marketing, Support ) with more flexible options. Help Desk reports in sales, marketing, customer support, and inventory modules. Help Desk Create cross-link reports spanning across multiple modules.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 619: Pc Integrated Gsm Model Based Ballot Voting System With Auto Reply
text:
Project: Pc Integrated Gsm Model Based Ballot Voting System With Auto Reply
Participants: Patel Chintak; Thaker Jay
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: Project Complies of Developing the Modem based voting system using c# with the auto replier. All the Mobile devices except CDMA mobiles have a GSM modem inbuilt so we are going to use it as a modem to receive a SMS from the people on inserted SIM card. Modem will be connected to the computer via Bus cable so and continuous monitoring of incoming messages will be done using c#. And it will be stored in the database sql server as per the specific conditions and will be added to particular category and counting will be done automatically. Bar Chart will be modified at particular time interval or when count gets changed when voting is received. Graphics will be done by using GD library. We will provide admin module for the dynamic creation of the voting options. Admin can create new voting options as per requirement and can place the time and date restrictions on it.Admin will also create template for the auto responder. Admin will be able to add database for the auto responder for the stock market price or mutual fund price. We can also implement time based voting restriction if needed
