title: GIAN Nidhi record 620: Construction Mamagment
text:
Project: Construction Mamagment
Participants: PUWAR MAYURSINH JAYDIPSINH; MISTRY SANKET SHASHIKANTBHAI; BADGUJAR VIJAY SHANKAR
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: This system manages the complete functioning of a Construction Company having its site at different locations. It has modules like CRM- which will take care of all the inquiries & bookings of the respective flat, bungalows or office. Follow-ups, confirmation records will be kept. Site-Master --Details of different sites, their maps with photographs & site details. Site Task Management -- Task of all the sites, which will keep a track of all the task, approximate time of completing a particular task. Gantt chart which can be tallied through actual completion. Contractor Module -- contractor details, labor details, payout etc & all the building material requisition, raw material inward, consumption, supply & payment details can be checked & monitored. All the partners can check the work of each site & can instruct accordingly.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 622: Rfid
text:
Project: Rfid
Participants: VAGHELA BHAUTIKKUMAR NITINBHAI; VORA JAYDEEP JEEVRAJBHAI; CHOVATIYA YOGESH PARSHOTTAMBHAI
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: Radio frequency Identification Device (RFID)is a generic term that issued to describe a system that transmit the identity(in the form of unique serial number)of an object or person wirelessly,It use in ASP.NEt with c#. Radio-frequency Identification Device(RFID)is the use of a wireless non-contact radio system to transfer data from a tag attched to an object,for the purpose of automatic identification and tracking.Some tags Require no battery and are powerd by the radio waves used to read them. This project can be used for the parking of the house,we are going to use rfid device and rfid tags to detect whether car or vehicle is incoming or outgoing to use tag at the both end of the car. Others use of a local power source. The tag contains electronically stored information which can be read from up to several meters away. Our plan is to automate gate operating system too so that we can control gate via system. RFID tags will detect the movement of the incoming and outgoing as per the conditions specified in the program.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 635: Geo Fencing
text:
Project: Geo Fencing
Participants: SARANG MAYUR CHETANBHAI; GONDALIYA NIRAVKUMAR GIRISHBHAI
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: A geo-fence could be dynamically generated—as in a radius around a store or point location. Or a geo-fence can be a predefined set of boundaries, like school attendance zones or neighborhood boundaries. Geofencing in a security strategy model provides security to wireless local area networks. This is done by using predefined borders, e.g., an office space with borders established by positioning technology attached to a specially programmed server. The office space becomes an authorized location for designated users and wireless mobile devices. Geo-Fencing uses the Global Positioning System (GPS). Developing Language is Java and the project will develop under the ANDROID platform using eclipse tool.

Entities: GONDALIYA NIRAVKUMAR GIRISHBHAI; SARANG MAYUR CHETANBHAI; Geo Fencing; Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Project: Geo Fencing
Participants: SARANG MAYUR CHETANBHAI; GONDALIYA NIRAVKUMAR GIRISHBHAI
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: A geo-fence could be dynamically generated—as in a radius around a store or point location. Or a geo-fence can be a predefined set of boundaries, like school attendance zones or neighborhood boundaries. Geofencing in a security strategy model provides security to wireless local area networks. This is done by using predefined borders, e.g., an office space with borders established by positioning technology attached to a specially programmed server. The office space becomes an authorized location for designated users and wireless mobile devices. Geo-Fencing uses the Global Positioning System (GPS). Developing Language is Java and the project will develop under the ANDROID platform using eclipse tool.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 636: The Online Stock Marketing
text:
Project: The Online Stock Marketing
Participants: CHAUHAN HARDEE JAYESH
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Abstract: The virtual live stock management system is the miniature replication of the real-time stock market. This application follows in the stock market trends some extend. User also gets some knowledge of the stock market trends. The Virtual Live Stock Management System created based up on buying and selling some virtual (imaginary) products. The price factor of product is very by time constraints. The user creates his/her profile and start the trending of the products. The profit and loss is counted based upon the overall transaction of the user. User are rated based upon his overall profit and let them do compaction with each other.

title: GIAN Nidhi record 640: Induced Draft Pulling Tower System
text:
Project: Induced Draft Pulling Tower System
Participants: Patel Rakesh; Sandhansi Pradeep; Shah Milan; Tambhake Mayur
Institution: Bhagvan Mahavir Polytechnic
Institution as written in this record: Bhagvan Mahavir polytechnic
Abstract: A cooling tower is a heat rejection device which extracts waste heat to the atmosphere through cooling off water stream to lower temperature cooling tower make use of evaporation whereby some of water is evaporated in to moving air stream and subsequently discharge into the atmosphere . cooling tower can be used in manufacturing process ,air, conditioner , power plants ,petroleum refineries etc .cooling tower performance is affected b cooling capacity heat load ,wet bulb temperature scale deposit ,poor air flow ,pump performance , corrosion etc. the cooling tower is one of important parts of all the power plants to fullfil the continuos water require water requirement of condenser ,cooling towers are employed in the power plants to take care of cooling out of the condensate to be re circulated in it this is vital specially when some water is required to be used again and again continuously.
